original: yadi hi loke vede vā kutrāpi vivṛto'kāro bhavet tadā ākārasya sthāne bhavan ḍhaddhaṭhṭhaḍanasvaḥ sthānita āntaryāt vivṛto bavet | na hi vivṛto'kāraḥ kutrāpyasti | api tu saṃvṛta evāsti | tathā ca saṃvṛta eva akāro bhaviṣyati iti "a a' iti sūtraṃ na atikhaṭva ityādau ḍhaddhaṭhṭhaḍanasvasya saṃvṛtatvaphalakam |
analyzed: yadi hi loke vede vā kutra api vivṛta ukāraḥ bhavet tadā ākārasya sthāne bhavan sthānitaḥ āntaryāt vivṛtaḥ na hi vivṛta ukāraḥ kutra api asti api tu saṃvṛtaḥ eva asti tathā ca saṃvṛtaḥ eva akāraḥ bhaviṣyati iti a a iti sūtram na ati khaṭvaḥ ityādau ḍhaddha ṭhṭhaḍana svasya saṃvṛta tva phalakam

original: tataśca śāstrānte prakriyāsiddhyanantaramakārasya saṃvṛtatvaṃ vidadhatsūtraṃ pūrvasūtreṣu vivṛto'kāra evopadiṣṭaḥ pratyetavya iti jñāpayati | tataścopadiṣṭasyaiva vivṛtasya prayojanamanvākhyāyate vārtikakāreṇeti siddham | pratyāpattiḥ---svabhāvataḥ saṃvṛtasya vivṛtatvaṃ prāptasya punaḥ svasvabhāvabhūtasaṃvṛtatvaprāptiḥ |
analyzed: tatas ca śāstra ante prakriyā siddhi anantaram akārasya saṃvṛta tvam vidadhat sūtram pūrva sūtreṣu vivṛta ukāraḥ eva upadiṣṭaḥ pratyetavyaḥ iti jñāpayati tatas ca upadiṣṭasya eva vivṛtasya prayojanam anvākhyāyate vārtikakāreṇa iti siddham pratyāpattiḥ svabhāvataḥ saṃvṛtasya vivṛta tvam prāptasya punar sva svabhāva bhūta saṃvṛta tva prāptiḥ

original: "prakriyādaśāyāmakāro vivṛta upadiṣṭa ityatra a a iti pratyāpattivacanaṃ jñāpakamityanvayaḥ | jhrjñāṭa ṛlṛk || 2 || prakṛtivadanukaraṇaṃ bhavati | "kṣiyaḥ'(sū.6-4-59) ityādāviyaṅnirdeśāt | jhrvi.ṭa ṛlṛk iti sūtre lṛkāropadeśaprayojanakathanāvasare aśaktijānukaraṇamekaṃ prayojanamuktaṃ bhāṣye |
analyzed: prakriyā daśāyām akāraḥ vivṛtaḥ upadiṣṭaḥ iti atra a a iti pratyāpatti vacanam jñāpakam iti anvayaḥ jhrjñāṭaḥ prakṛti vat anukaraṇam bhavati ityādau iyaṅ nirdeśāt jhrviṭaḥ ṛ lṛk iti sūtre lṛkāra upadeśa prayojana kathana avasare aśakti ja anukaraṇam ekam prayojanam uktam bhāṣye

original: tathāhi - kayācit brāhmaṇyā ṛtaka iti prayoktavye aśaktyā yo lṛtaka iti prayogaḥ tasya yat
analyzed: tathā hi kayācid brāhmaṇyā ṛtakaḥ iti prayoktavye aśaktyā yaḥ lṛtakaḥ iti prayogaḥ tasya yat

original: brāhmaṇylṛtaka ityāha ityanukaraṇaṃ tadaśaktijānukaraṇamityucyate | tatra brāhmaṇīalṛtaka iti sthite lṛkārasyāctvāt tasmin parataḥ "iko yaṇaci' (sū.6-1-77) iti sūtreṇa īkārasya yaṇi brāhmaṇylṛtaka iti bhavati | yadi tu ṛlṛksūtre lṛkāro nopadiśyeta ṛk ityevocyeta tadā lṛkārasyāctvā bhāvāt iko yaṇacīti sūtraṃ na pravarteta |
analyzed: brāhmaṇī lṛtakaḥ iti āha iti anukaraṇam tad aśakti jā anukaraṇam iti ucyate tatra brāhmaṇī a lṛtakaḥ iti sthite lṛkārasya a c tvāt tasmin paratas i kaḥ ya ṇ a ci sū6177 iti sūtreṇa īkārasya ya ṇi brāhmaṇī lṛtakaḥ iti bhavati yadi tu ṛ lṛk sūtre lṛkāraḥ na upadiśyeta ṛc iti eva ucyeta tadā lṛkārasya a c tvā bhāvāt i kaḥ ya ṇ a ci iti sūtram na pravarteta

original: ato lṛkāropadeśaḥ kartavyaḥ ityuktvā tasya pratyākhyānaṃ kṛtam | tathāhi "prakṛtivadanukaraṇaṃ bhavati' iti paribhāṣā bhavati | tasyāśca, anukaraṇaṃ prakṛtivat anukāryatulyaṃ bhavati, anukārye yatkāryaṃ bhavati anukaraṇe'pi tadbhavati ityarthaḥ | atra cānukārya ṛtakaśabdaḥ anukaraṇamlṛtakaśabdaḥ |
analyzed: atas lṛkāra upadeśaḥ kartavyaḥ iti uktvā tasya pratyākhyānam kṛtam tathā hi prakṛti vat anukaraṇam bhavati iti paribhāṣā bhavati tasyāḥ ca anukaraṇam prakṛti vat anukārya tulyam bhavati anukārye yat kāryam bhavati anukaraṇe api tat bhavati iti arthaḥ atra ca anukāryaḥ ṛtaka śabdaḥ anukaraṇam lṛtaka śabdaḥ

original: anukārya ṛtaśabde parataḥ ṛkārasyāctvāt "iko yaṇaci (sū.6-1-77) iti sūtraṃ yathā pravartate tathā anukaraṇe lṛtakaśabde'pi tatsūtraṃ pravartate iti yaṇādeśasiddhayā lṛkāropadeśo māstu iti bhāvaḥ | "prakṛtivadanukaraṇaṃ bhavati' ityatra jñāpakaṃ tu "kṣiyodīrghāt'(sū.7-2-46) ityādāviyaṅ‌nirdeśaḥ |
analyzed: anukāryaḥ ṛta śabde paratas ṛkārasya a c tvāt i kaḥ ya ṇ a ci sū6177 iti sūtram yathā pravartate tathā anukaraṇe lṛtaka śabde api tat sūtram pravartate iti ya ṇ ādeśa siddhayā lṛkāra upadeśaḥ mā astu iti bhāvaḥ prakṛti vat anukaraṇam bhavati iti atra jñāpakam tu ityādau iyaṅ nirdeśaḥ

original: tathā hi sūtrasthaḥ "kṣi' śabdaḥ dhātupāṭhasthasya kṣi ityasyānukaraṇam | anukaraṇaśabdasya kriyāvācitvābhāvena dhātutvābhāvāt "aciśnudhātubhruvām'(sū.6-4-77) iti sūtreṇeyaṅ durlabhaḥ | iyaṅ tu nirdiṣṭaḥ pāṇininā | tenedaṃ jñāyate yat prakṛtivadanukaraṇaṃbhavatīti |
analyzed: tathā hi sūtra sthaḥ śabdaḥ dhātu pāṭha sthasya iti asya anukaraṇam anukaraṇa śabdasya kriyā vāci tva abhāvena dhātu tva abhāvāt iti sūtreṇa iyaṅ durlabhaḥ iyaṅ tu nirdiṣṭaḥ pāṇininā tena idam jñāyate yat prakṛti vat anukaraṇam bhavati iti

original: tathā ca kṣidhātorbhavan iyaṅ tadanukaraṇāt kṣiśabdādapi bhavitumarhatīti svāṃśe caritārthatāḥ | pacantu pacantu iti dvivāraṃ kenacidukte tasyānukaraṇaṃ "dviḥ pacantu' iti |
analyzed: tathā ca kṣi dhātoḥ bhavan iyaṅ tad anukaraṇāt kṣi śabdāt api bhavitum arhati iti sva aṃśe pacantu pacantu iti dvi vāram kenacid ukte tasya anukaraṇam dvis pacantu iti

original: asya pacantuśabdasya kriyāsādhanādyavācakatvāktiṅantatvaṃ nāstīti "tiṅṅatiṅaḥ'(sū.8-1-27)iti sūtreṇa atiṅantāt paraṃ tiṅantamanudāttamityarthakena vidhīyamānaḥ nighātasvaraḥ na syāt | prakṛtivadanukaraṇaṃ bhavatīti vacane svīkṛte tu anukārye pacantu iti tiṅante nighātavat anukaraṇe pacantuśabde'pi sa svaraḥ setsyatīti | jhrjñādṛṭa eoṅ || 3 ||
analyzed: asya pacantu śabdasya na asti iti tiṅ ṅ atiṅaḥ sū 8127 iti sūtreṇa a tiṅ antāt param tiṅ antam anudāttam iti arthakena vidhīyamānaḥ nighāta svaraḥ na syāt prakṛti vat anukaraṇam bhavati iti vacane svīkṛte tu anukārye pacantu iti tiṅ ante nighāta vat anukaraṇe pacantu śabde api sa svaraḥ setsyati iti jhrjñādṛṭaḥ eoṅ 30 eva anukaraṇe pacantu śabde api sa svaraḥ setsyati iti jhrjñādṛṭaḥ eoṅ 30

analyzed: gonau grahaṇāt jñāpakāt na avyapavṛktasya avayavasya tad vidhiḥ iti ṭha e oṃ ṅ iti sūtre ye ete ākara ādiṣkāra sadṛśāḥ avayavāḥ ṛkāra lṛkārayoḥ repha lakāra sadṛśau avayavau sandhi akṣareṣu e o ai au iti eteṣu akāra ikāra ukāra sadṛśāḥ avayavāḥ tatra kevala varṇānām akāra dīnām vidhīyamānam kāryam bhavati na vā iti vicāre yadi varṇa avayavān varṇa grahaṇena gṛhītvā avayavān varṇa grahaṇena gṛhītvā avayavān varṇa

original: tatravarṇakāryaṃ kriyeta tadā agne indram vāyo udakamityādau ekārottarabhāgasya ikārasya ikāragrahaṇena grahaṇāt tasya indramiti savarṇa-ikāraparakatvāt okārasthasya ukārasya savarṇokāraparakatvācca "akaḥ savarṇe dīrghaḥ' (sū.6-1-101) iti dīrghaḥ prāpnotīti doṣamāśaṅkya tatparihārāya idaṃ vacanamupāttam "nāvyapavṛktasyāvayasya tadvidhiriti |'
analyzed: tatravarṇa kāryam kriyeta tadā agne indram vāyo udakam ityādau ekāra uttara bhāgasya ikārasya ikāra grahaṇena grahaṇāt tasya indram iti savarṇa ekāra paraka tvāt okāra sthasya ukārasya savarṇa ukāra paraka tvāt ca a kaḥ savarṇe dīrghaḥ sū 61101 iti dīrghaḥ prāpnoti iti doṣam āśaṅkya tad parihārāya idam vacanam upāttam na a vyapavṛktasya avayasya tad vidhiḥ iti

analyzed: avyapavṛktasya yaḥ vayavaḥ tasya iti vyadhikaraṇe avyapavṛktasya abhinna buddhi viṣayasya ekatva viṣayaka buddhi grāhyasya ekam iti ākāraka buddhi viṣayasya samudāyasya yaḥ vayavaḥ tasya tad vidhiḥ pṛthak bhūta varṇa vidhiḥ na bhavati iti ukta vacanasya arthaḥ

original: evaṃ ca "e ityakṣaramekaṃ' iti buddhigṛhīte e iti samudāye'vayavaḥ ya ikārastasya, samudāyāghaṭakasya ikārasya yo vidhiḥ savarṇadīrghādiḥ sa na bhavatīti agne indramityādau savarṇadīrghāpattidoṣo netyarthaḥ | uktavacane jñāpakamāha gonaugrahaṇāditi |
analyzed: evam ca e iti akṣaram ekam iti buddhi gṛhīte e iti samudāya ivayavaḥ yaḥ ikāraḥ tasya samudāya āghaṭakasya ikārasya yaḥ vidhiḥ savarṇa dīrgha ādiḥ sa na bhavati iti agne indram ityādau savarṇa dīrgha āpatti doṣaḥ na iti arthaḥ ukta vacane jñāpakam āha go nau grahaṇāt iti

original: anyathā śatāni sahastrāṇītyādau numiṃ kṛte nakārāntatvāt ṣaṭsaṃjñāyāṃ "ṣaḍḍḍatdh;bhyo luk' (sū.7-1-22) iti jasśasorlugāpatteḥ |
analyzed: anyathā śatāni sahastrāṇi ityādau kṛte nakāra anta tvāt ṣaṣ saṃjñāyām iti jas śasoḥ luk āpatteḥ

original: aṣṭānāmityatra aṣṭan ām iti sthite paratvānnityatvācca "aṣṭana ā vibhaktau' (sū.7-2-84) iti nakārasya ātve kṛte nakārāntatvābhāvena ṣaṭsaṃjñāyā aprāptau "ṣaṭcarturbhyaśca' (sū.7-2-55) iti nuḍho'nupapatteśca ityākṣipya, śatāni sahastrāṇītyādau sannipātaparibhāṣayā ṣaṭsaṃjñāṃ vārayitvā aṣṭānāmityatra ātve kṛte'pi ṣaṭsaṃjñā jñāpakamahimnā sādhitā
analyzed: aṣṭānām iti atra aṣṭan ām iti sthite paratvāt nitya tvāt ca aṣṭanaḥ ā vibhaktau sū7284 iti nakārasya ātve kṛte nakāra anta tva abhāvena ṣaṣ saṃjñāyāḥ aprāptau sū7255 iti iti ākṣipya śatāni sahastrāṇi ityādau sannipāta paribhāṣayā ṣaṣ saṃjñām vārayitvā aṣṭānām iti atra ātve kṛte api ṣaṣ saṃjñā jñāpaka mahimnā sādhitā

original: bhāṣyavārtikayoḥ | tadāha-aṣṭano dīrghagrahaṇamiti | "aṣṭano dīrghat' (sū.6-1-182) iti sūtreṇa dīrghāntādaṣṭanśabdāt parasyāḥ śasādivibhakterudāttatvaṃ vidhīyate | tatra ca dīrghagrahaṇam aṣṭasu ityatra supa udāttatvanivṛttyarthaṃ kriyate |
analyzed: bhāṣya vārtikayoḥ tat āha aṣṭanaḥ dīrgha grahaṇam iti aṣṭanaḥ sū 61182 iti sūtreṇa dīrgha antāt aṣṭan śabdāt parasyāḥ śas ādi vibhakteḥ udātta tvam vidhīyate tatra ca dīrgha grahaṇam aṣṭasu iti atra supaḥ udātta tva nivṛtti artham kriyate

original: yadi ca kṛtātvasya ṣaṭsaṃjñā na syāt tadā aṣṭasu ityatra "aṣṭana' (sū.6-1-182) iti sūtrāpekṣayā paratvāt "jhalyupottamam' (sū.6-1-180) iti sutereṇa ṣaṭtricaturbhyo yā jhalādivibhaktistadante pade upottamamudāttaṃ syādityarthakena upottamasvareṇa ṭakārottarākāra udātta iti iṣṭasvarasiddhyā kiṃ dīrghagrahaṇena |
analyzed: yadi ca kṛta ā tvasya ṣaṣ saṃjñā na syāt tadā aṣṭasu iti atra iti sūtra apekṣayā paratvāt jha li upottamam sū61180 iti sūtra apekṣayā paratvāt jha li upottamam sū61180 iti ṣaṣ tri caturbhyaḥ yā jha l ādi vibhaktiḥ tad ante pade upottamam udāttam syāt iti arthakena upottama svareṇa ṭakāra uttara akāraḥ udāttaḥ iti iṣṭa svara siddhyā kim dīrgha grahaṇena

original: cāpavādatvāt aṣṭasu ityatra "jhalyupottamam' iti svaraṃ bādhitvā "aṣṭanaḥ' iti sūtravihito vibhaktisvara eva syāditi vācyam | ātvapakṣe aṣṭāsu ityatra bhavadrītyā kṛtātvasya
analyzed: ca apavāda tvāt aṣṭasu iti atra jha li upottamam iti svaram bādhitvā aṣṭanaḥ iti sūtra vihitaḥ vibhakti svaraḥ eva syāt iti vācyam ātva pakṣe aṣṭāsu iti atra bhavat rītyā kṛta ātvasya

original: ṣaṭsaṃjñā'bhāvena upottamasvarāpravṛttyā tatra "aṣṭana' iti sūtrasya cāritārthyona tasyāpavādatvāsambhavāt | tataśca paratvāt aṣṭasu ityatra upottamasvara eva bhaviṣyatīti vibhaktisvarāprasaktyā tadvāraṇārthaṃ kriyamāṇaṃ dīrdhagrahaṇaṃ vyarthameva| kṛtaṃ ca tat kṛtātvasyāpyaṣṭanśabdasya ṣaṭsaṃjñāṃ jñāpayati |
analyzed: ṣaṣ saṃjñā bhāvena upottama svara apravṛttyā tatra aṣṭanaḥ iti sūtrasya tasya apavāda tva asambhavāt tatas ca paratvāt aṣṭasu iti atra upottama svaraḥ eva bhaviṣyati iti vibhakti svara aprasaktyā tad vāraṇa artham kriyamāṇam dīrdha grahaṇam vyartham eva kṛtam ca tat ṣaṣ saṃjñām jñāpayati

original: tataśca kṛtātvasthale'pi "jhalyupottamam' iti ṣaṭsvare prāpta eva "aṣṭano dīrghāt' iti sūtrārambhāt yena nāprāptinyāyena aṣṭana iti sūtramevāpavādatvātpravartate tathā aṣṭasu ityatrādīrghapakṣe'pi apavādatvāt vibhakteḥ svaraḥ syāditi tadvāraṇārthaṃ dīrghagrahaṇaṃ kartavyamiti svāṃśe caritārthatā |
analyzed: tatas ca kṛtātva sthale api jha li upottamam iti ṣaṣ svare prāpte eva aṣṭanaḥ dīrghāt iti sūtra ārambhāt yena na aprāpti nyāyena aṣṭanaḥ iti sūtram eva apavāda tvāt pravartate tathā aṣṭasu iti atra adīrgha pakṣe api apavāda tvāt vibhakteḥ svaraḥ syāt iti tad vāraṇa artham dīrgha grahaṇam kartavyam iti sva aṃśe caritārtha tā

original: anyatra prayojanaṃ tu aṣṭānāmityatra kṛtātvasyāpi ṣaṭsaṃjñāstīti "ṣaṭcaturbhyaśca' (sū 8-1-55) iti nuṭsiddhiriti tātparyārthaḥ | jhrjñā.ṭa sarvādīni (sū. 1-1-28) || sarvanāmasaṃjñāyām ata eva nipātannna ṇatvam| purāṇapurātanau satatasaṃtatau ca pṛṣodarāditvātsiddhau |
analyzed: anyatra prayojanam tu aṣṭānām iti atra ṣaṣ saṃjñā asti iti ṣaṣ caturbhyaḥ ca sū 8155 iti nuṭ siddhiḥ iti tātparya arthaḥ sarva ādīni sū 1128 sarvanāma saṃjñāyām atas eva ṇa tvam purāṇa purātanau satata saṃtatau ca pṛṣodara ādi tvāt siddhau

original: jhrvi.ṭa ṭhasarvādīni sarvanāmāni' iti sūtre sarvanāmaśabde "pūrvapadātsaṃjñāyāmagaḥ' (sū.8-403) iti ṇatvaṃ prāpnotītyāśaṅkya, nipātanāṇṇatvābhāva iti samādhāya, tadupari nipātanādaṇatvaṃ bhavatu yathāpraptaṃ ca ṇatvamapyastu, nipātanasya hi tadrūpasādhutvapratipādane tātparyam, na tu rūpāntaranivṛttāvityākṣipya, nāprāpte ṇatve nipātanamārabyate
analyzed: jhrviṭa ṭhasarva ādīni sarvanāmāni iti sūtre sarvanāma śabde pūrva padāt saṃjñāyām agaḥ sū 8403 iti ṇa tvam prāpnoti iti āśaṅkya nipātanāt a ṇa tva abhāvaḥ iti samādhāya tad upari nipātanāt a ṇa tvam bhavatu yathāpraptam ca ṇa tvam api astu nipātanasya hi tad rūpa sādhu tva pratipādane tātparyam na tu rūpa antara nivṛttau iti ākṣipya na aprāpte ṇa tve nipātanam ārabyate

original: tadbādhakaṃ bhaviṣyati iti samāhiṃta bhāṣye | tadāha-sarvanāmasaṃjñāyāmiti | tanu sam-tata iti sthite makārasya lopena satataśabdaḥ "aparasparāḥ kriyāsātatye' (sū.6-1-144) iti nipātanāt sādhuritīṣyate | nāprāpte alope ārabhyamāṇamidaṃ lopanipātanaṃ alopasya bādhakaṃ bhavet | tataśca saṃtatamiti rūpaṃ na sidhyet |
analyzed: tat bādhakam bhaviṣyati iti bhāṣye tat āha sarvanāma saṃjñāyām iti tanu samtataḥ iti sthite makārasya lopena satata śabdaḥ aparasparāḥ kriyā sātatye sū 61144 iti nipātanāt sādhuḥ iti iṣyate na aprāpte alope ārabhyamāṇam idam lopa nipātanam a lopasya bādhakam bhavet tatas ca saṃtatam iti rūpam na sidhyet

original: tathā "purāṇaprokteṣu' (sū.4-3-104) ityatra nipātitena purāṇaśabdena purātanaśabdasya bādhaḥ prāpnoti | tataśca purātanaśabdasya sādhutvaṃ na sidhyediti āśaṅkyāha-purāṇapurātanāviti | evaṃ ca saṃtatasatatayoḥ purāṇapurātanayośca pṛṣodarādigaṇe pāṭhādeva sādhutvam, na tu nipātanāt | ato noktadoṣāvasara iti bhāvaḥ |
analyzed: tathā purāṇa prokteṣu iti atra nipātitena purāṇa śabdena purātana śabdasya bādhaḥ prāpnoti tatas ca purātana śabdasya sādhu tvam na sidhyet iti āśaṅkya āha purāṇa purātanau iti evam ca saṃtata satatayoḥ purāṇa purātanayoḥ ca pṛṣodara ādi gaṇe pāṭhāt eva sādhu tvam na tu nipātanāt atas na ukta doṣa avasaraḥ iti bhāvaḥ

original: paribhāṣenduśekhare "bādhakānyeva nipātanāni' iti paribhāṣā paṭhyate | jhrjñā.ṭa pūrvaparā (sū.1-1-34) || pūrvaṃ gaṇapāṭhaḥ paścātsūtrapāṭhaḥ | "pūrvādibhyo vā' (sū.8-1-16) iti navagrahaṇāt jñāpakāt | sūtrapāṭhe navaiva hi pūrvādīni |
analyzed: paribhāṣā induśekhare bādhakāni eva nipātanāni iti paribhāṣā paṭhyate pūrva parā sū1134 pūrvam gaṇa pāṭhaḥ paścāt sūtra pāṭhaḥ pūrva ādibhyaḥ vā sū8116 iti nava grahaṇāt jñāpakāt sūtra pāṭhe nava eva hi pūrva ādīni

original: jhrvi.ṭa ṭhapūrvaparāvaradakṣiṇottarāparadharāṇi vyavasthāyāmasaṃjñāyām ' iti sūtre kimarthaṃ pratipadaṃ pūrvādīni jasi vibhāṣārthaṃ paṭhitāni, yāvatā gaṇa evarthaviśeṣeṇa viśiṣṭāni nityaṃ sarvanāma - saṃjñārthaṃ paṭhyante | tatra pūrvādīni navetyevaṃ sūtraṃ paṭhitavyam |
analyzed: ṭha pūrva para avara dakṣiṇa uttara apara dharāṇi vyavasthāyām asaṃjñāyām iti sūtre kimartham pratipadam pūrva ādīni jasi vibhāṣā artham paṭhitāni yāvatā gaṇe eva artha viśeṣeṇa viśiṣṭāni nityam sarvanāma saṃjñā artham paṭhyante tatra pūrva ādīni nava iti evam sūtram paṭhitavyam

original: prāptavabhiāṣā ceyaṃ bhaviṣyati ityāśaṅkya, bhavedevaṃ yadi gaṇapāṭhaḥ pūrvaḥ syāt paścācca pāṇinisūtrapāṭhaḥ syāt | na tvetadasti, pramāṇābhāvāditi samādhāya, pāṇinisūtrāpekṣayā gaṇapāṭhasya prākkālikatvaṃ jñāpakena samarthitaṃ bhāṣye--- "evaṃ tarhyācāryapravṛttirjñāpayati sa pūrvaḥ pāṭhaḥ ayaṃ punaḥ pāṭha iti |
analyzed: ca iyam bhaviṣyati iti āśaṅkya bhavet evam yadi gaṇa pāṭhaḥ pūrvaḥ syāt paścāt ca pāṇini sūtra pāṭhaḥ syāt na tu etat asti pramāṇa abhāvāt iti samādhāya pāṇini sūtra apekṣayā gaṇa pāṭhasya prākkālika tvam jñāpakena samarthitam bhāṣye evam tarhi ācārya pravṛttiḥ jñāpayati sa pūrvaḥ pāṭhaḥ ayam punar pāṭhaḥ iti

original: yadayaṃ pūrvādibhyo navabhyo veti navagrahaṇaṃ karoti | navaiva hi pūrvādīni ' iti| tadāha-pūrvaṃ gaṇapāṭha iti | pūrvādibhyo navabhyo veti sūtre navagrahaṇaṃ navādhikatyadādinirāsārthaṃ kriyate | yadi ca niyatasaṃniveśo gaṇapāṭhaḥ pūrvaḥ tadā pūrvādibhya ityanena tyadādīnāmapi grahaṇaṃ syāditi tadvyavacchedāya navagrahaṇaṃ kartavyaṃ bhavati |
analyzed: yat ayam pūrva ādibhyaḥ navabhyaḥ vā iti nava grahaṇam karoti nava eva hi pūrva ādīni iti tat āha pūrvam gaṇa pāṭhaḥ iti pūrva ādibhyaḥ navabhyaḥ vā iti sūtre nava grahaṇam nava adhika tyad ādi nirāsa artham kriyate yadi ca niyata saṃniveśaḥ gaṇa pāṭhaḥ pūrvaḥ tadā pūrva ādibhyaḥ iti anena tyad ādīnām api grahaṇam syāt iti tad vyavacchedāya nava grahaṇam kartavyam bhavati

original: yadā tu pāṇinisūtraṃ gaṇapāṭhātpūrvaṃ tadā pāṇinisūtre pūrvādīnāṃ navānāmeva pūrvaparetyādibhiḥ tribhiḥ sūtrairviśiṣya nirdeśāt navādhikānāṃ tyadādīnāṃ pūrvādibhya ityanena grahaṇaprasaktyabhāvāt nabagrahamaṃ vyarthaṃ syāditi gaṇapāṭhasya prācīnatvamanumīyata iti bhāvaḥ| sūtrapāṭha iti | pāṇinisūtrapāṭha ityarthaḥ |
analyzed: yadā tu pāṇini sūtram gaṇa pāṭhāt pūrvam tadā pāṇini sūtre pūrva ādīnām navānām eva pūrva para ityādibhiḥ tribhiḥ sūtraiḥ viśiṣya nirdeśāt nava adhikānām tyad ādīnām pūrva ādibhyaḥ iti anena grahaṇa prasakti abhāvāt vyartham syāt iti gaṇa pāṭhasya prācīna tvam anumīyate iti bhāvaḥ sūtra pāṭhaḥ iti pāṇini sūtra pāṭhaḥ iti arthaḥ

original: jhrjñā.ṭa ṭhapūrvatrāsiddham' (sū.8-2-1) ityāderjñāpakāt pūrvādīnāṃ dvyādiparyudāsena paryudāso na | jhrvi.ṭa
analyzed: ṭha pūrvatra asiddham sū821 ityādeḥ jñāpakāt pūrva ādīnām dvi ādi paryudāsena paryudāsaḥ na

original: tatraiva sūtre pūrvādīni navetyevaṃ lāghavena paṭhitavye kimiti pūrvaparāvaretyādinā viśiṣya trisūtrīpāṭhaḥ kriyata ityāśaṅkāyāḥ samādhānamuktam--- "idaṃ tarhi prayojanam--dvyādiparyudāsena paryudāso mā bhūditi' iti bhāṣye | tasyāśayamevaṃ kaiyaṭa āha--tyadādīni paṭhitvā gaṇe kaiścit pūrvādīni paṭhitāni |
analyzed: tatra eva sūtre pūrva ādīni nava iti evam lāghavena paṭhitavye kim iti pūrva para avara ityādinā viśiṣya trisūtrī pāṭhaḥ kriyate iti āśaṅkāyāḥ samādhānam uktam idam tarhi prayojanam dvi ādi paryudāsena paryudāsaḥ mā bhūt iti iti bhāṣye tasya āśayam evam kaiyaṭaḥ āha tyad ādīni paṭhitvā gaṇe kaiścid pūrva ādīni paṭhitāni

original: tatra "kiṃsarvanāmabakahubhyo'dvyādibhyaḥ' (sū.5-3-2) iti pūrvāṃdibhyastasilādīnāṃ pratiṣedhaḥ prāpnoti | tatra pūnaḥ sarvanāmasaṃjñayā tasilādirvidhīyate | tena dhdyādiparyudāso bādhyata iti | tadanantaraṃ samādhānamidaṃ dūṣayannāha bhāṣyakāraḥ--- "etadapi nāsti prayojanam | ācāryapravṛtirjñāpayati naiṣāṃ dvyādiparyu- dāsena paryudāso bhavatīti |
analyzed: tatra sū 532 iti pūrva āṃdibhyaḥ tasil ādīnām pratiṣedhaḥ prāpnoti tatra pūnar sarvanāma saṃjñayā tasil ādiḥ vidhīyate tena dhdyādi paryudāsaḥ bādhyate iti tad anantaram samādhānam idam dūṣayan āha bhāṣyakāraḥ etat api na asti prayojanam ācārya pravṛtiḥ jñāpayati na eṣām dvi ādi paryu dāsena paryudāsaḥ bhavati iti

original: yadayaṃ pūrvatrāsiddhamiti nipātanaṃ karoti' iti | yadi ca dvyādiparyuṃdāsena paryudāsāt pūrvādibhyastasilādīnāṃ pratiṣedhaḥ syāt tadā "pūrvatra' iti tralantatayā pūrvaśabdanirdeśo'pramāṇaṃ syāt | nirdeśamahimnā pūrvādīnāṃ dvyādiparyudāsena paryudāso neti jñāpyata ityarthaḥ | tadetatsarvaṃ manasi nidhāyāha--pūrvatrāsiddhamityāderjñāpakāditi |
analyzed: yat ayam pūrvatra asiddham iti nipātanam karoti iti yadi ca dvi ādi paryuṃdāsena paryudāsāt pūrva ādibhyaḥ tasil ādīnām pratiṣedhaḥ syāt tadā pūrvatra iti syāt nirdeśa mahimnā pūrva ādīnām dvi ādi paryudāsena paryudāsaḥ na iti jñāpyate iti arthaḥ tat etat sarvam manasi nidhāya āha pūrvatra asiddham ityādeḥ jñāpakāt iti

original: ādipadena ca--"jaśbhāvāditi ceduttaratra ḍhasyābhāvādapavādaprasaṅgaḥ' iti vārtikasthaṃ uttaratra iti nipātanaṃ parāmṛśyate | jhrjñā.ṭa "kṛnmejantaḥ " (sū.1-1-39) kṛdantaṃ yanmāntamiti pakṣe praśānśabdasya svarādiṣu pāṭhāt jñāpakānna pratyayalakṣaṇenāvyayasaṃjñā |
analyzed: ādi padena ca ja ś bhāvāt iti ced uttaratra ḍhasya abhāvāt apavāda prasaṅgaḥ iti vārtika stham uttaratra iti nipātanam parāmṛśyate sū1139 kṛt m e c antaḥ sū1139 kṛt antam yat ma antam iti pakṣe praśān śabdasya svara ādiṣu pāṭhāt jñāpakāt na pratyaya lakṣaṇena avyaya saṃjñā

original: jhrvi.ṭa ṭhakṛnmejanta' iti sūtrasya dvedhā vyākhyānaṃ kṛtam-kṛdyo mānta ejantaśca tadantamavyayaṃ syādityekaṃ vyākhyānam | kṛdantaṃ yanmāntaṃ tadavyayasaṃjñakaṃ syāditi dvitīyaṃ vyākhyānam |

analyzed: nanu taddhita vibhaktau tu s mānām it saṃjñā niṣedhaḥ na pravartate iti jñāpane idānīm iti atra dānīm ca sū5318 iti sūtreṇa vihitaḥ yaḥ dānīm pratyayaḥ tad antya makārasya it saṃjñā prāpnoti iti āśaṅkya āha dānīm tu ya antaḥ kariṣyate iti yakāra antaḥ eva pratyayaḥ

original: sa ca cakāraḥ sūtre cakārarūpe vali pare "lopo vyorvali' (sū.6-1-66) iti luptatvānna śrūyate | tathā copadeśe makārasyāntyatvaṃ nāstīti netsaṃjña | na ca pratyayasya yathārāntatve idānīmityādau yakāraśravaṇāpattiriti vācyam | "saṃyogāntasya lopaḥ' (sū.8-2-23) ita yakārasya lopādityāśayaḥ luptanirdiṣṭayakāreṇeti | lopo vyorvalītyaneneti śeṣaḥ |
analyzed: sa ca cakāraḥ sūtre cakāra rūpe pare lopaḥ v yoḥ va li sū6166 iti lupta tvāt na śrūyate tathā ca upadeśe makārasya antya tvam na asti iti na id saṃjña na ca pratyayasya yathā āra anta tve idānīm ityādau yakāra śravaṇa āpattiḥ iti vācyam saṃyoga antasya lopaḥ yakārasya lopāt iti āśayaḥ lupta nirdiṣṭa yakāreṇa iti lopaḥ v yoḥ va li iti anena iti śeṣaḥ

original: jhrjñā.ṭa tasya lopaḥ (sū.1-3-9) "dadātidadhātyorvibhāṣā' (sū.3-1-139) iti jñāpakāt nānubandhakṛtamasārūpyam | "śitsarvasya' (sū.1-1-55) iti jñāpakāt nānubandhakṛtamanekāltvam | "udīcāṃ māṅaḥ' (sū.3-4-19) iti sānubandhakasyātvabhūtasya nirdeśāt nānubandhakṛtamanejantatvam | ekāntā anubandhā ityeva nyāyyam | sahetukatvāt |
analyzed: tasya lopaḥ sū139 dadāti dadhātyoḥ vibhāṣā sū31139 iti jñāpakāt na anubandha kṛtam asārūpyam ś it sarvasya sū1155 iti jñāpakāt na anubandha kṛtam aneka a l tvam udīcām māṅaḥ sū3419 iti sa anubandhakasya ā tva bhūtasya nirdeśāt na anubandha kṛtam aneka anta tvam ekāntāḥ anubandhāḥ iti eva nyāyyam sa hetuka tvāt

original: anudāttaṅitaḥ (sū.1-3-12) "anupasargādvā' (sū.1-3-43) iti vikalpavidhānaṃ jñāpakam vikaraṇebhyo niyamo balīyānityasya | vikaraṇavyavadhāne'pi niyamapravṛtterjñāpakamiti "śadeḥ śitaḥ' (sū.1-3-60) iti sūtre bhāṣye dhvanitam | iti prathamādhyāyasya tṛtīyaḥ pādaḥ |
analyzed: anudātta ṅ itaḥ sū an upasargāt vā sū iti vikalpa vidhānam jñāpakam vikaraṇebhyaḥ niyamaḥ balīyān ityasya vikaraṇa vyavadhāne api niyama pravṛtteḥ jñāpakam iti śadeḥ ś itaḥ sū iti sūtre bhāṣye dhvanitam iti prathama adhyāyasya tṛtīyaḥ pādaḥ

analyzed: vipratiṣedhe sū142 asiddham bahiraṅgam iti asyām vā aha sū64132 sū64132 iti ūṭh grahaṇam jñāpakam indre dvau acau tatra ekaḥ yasya iti aparaḥ eka ādeśena aparaḥ eka ādeśena tatas nackaḥ indraḥ saṃpannaḥ tatra vṛddheḥ prasaṅga abhāvāt na ṣedhaḥ vyarthaḥ sanujñāpakaḥ pūrva uttara padayoḥ tāvat kāryam bhavati na eka ādeśaḥ antaraṅgaḥ iti

original: yasmātpratyayavidhiḥ (sū.1-3-13) "gatiranantaraḥ' (sū.6-2-49) ityanantaragrahaṇaṃ kṛdgrahaṇe gatikārakapūrvasyāpītyasyāḥ jñāpakam | suptiṅantam (sū.1-4-14) idamantagrahaṇaṃ saṃjñāvidhau pratyayagrahaṇe tadantagrahaṇaṃ na ityasyā jñāpakam | jhrvi.ṭa etāni sarvāṇyapi paribhāṣārūpāṇi vacanāni paribhāṣenduśekhare vivṛtānīti neha vivriyante |
analyzed: yasmāt pratyaya vidhiḥ sū1313 gatiḥ anantaraḥ sū6249 iti anantara grahaṇam kṛt grahaṇe gati kāraka pūrvasya api iti asyāḥ jñāpakam sup tiṅ antam sū1414 idam anta grahaṇam saṃjñā vidhau pratyaya grahaṇe tad anta grahaṇam naḥ iti asyāḥ jñāpakam jhrviṭaḥ etāni sarvāṇi api paribhāṣā rūpāṇi vacanāni paribhāṣā induśekhare vivṛtāni iti na iha vivriyante

original: evaṃjātīyakānāṃ kāsāṃcitparibhāṣāṇāmapi jñāpakasaṃgrahe'smin samāveśaḥ kathamupajāta iti na jānīmaḥ | jhrjñā.ṭa bahuṣu bahuvacanam (sū.1-4-21) bahuvacananirdeśo jñāpako nānādravyavācibahuśabdasya grahaṇaṃ na vaipulyavācina iti | jhrvi.ṭa nanu bahuṣu bahuvacanamiti sūtreṇa bahutve'rthe bahuvacanaṃ vidhīyate |
analyzed: evaṃjātīyakānām kāsāṃcid paribhāṣāṇām api jñāpaka saṃgrahe asmin samāveśaḥ katham upajātaḥ iti na jānīmaḥ bahuṣu bahuvacanam sū1421 bahuvacana nirdeśaḥ jñāpakaḥ nānā dravya vāci bahu śabdasya grahaṇam na vaipulya vācinaḥ iti nanu bahuṣu bahuvacanam iti sūtreṇa bahu tva ṛthe bahuvacanam vidhīyate

original: tatra ca bahutvaṃ vaipulyaṃ saṃkhyāviśeṣaśceti dvividham | tatra viśeṣakābhāvāt dvayorapyarthayorbahuvacanaṃ prāpnoti | tataśca bahurodana ityatra vaipulyasya prakṛtito vivakṣitatvāt bahuvacanaprasaṅgaityāśaṅkyāha--bahuvacananirdeśa iti |
analyzed: tatra ca bahu tvam vaipulyam saṃkhyā viśeṣaḥ ca iti dvividham tatra viśeṣaka abhāvāt dvayoḥ api arthayoḥ bahuvacanam prāpnoti tatas ca bahu rodanaḥ iti atra vaipulyasya prakṛtitaḥ vivakṣita tvāt bahuvacana prasaṅgaḥ iti āśaṅkya āha bahuvacana nirdeśaḥ iti

original: bahutvasyaikatvāt bahau bahuvacanamiti nirdaiṣṭavye sati yat bahuṣu iti bahuvacananirdeśanaṃ tajjñāpayati nānādravyavācī yo bahuśabdaḥ sa eva bahuṣu ityatropātto na vaipulyavācī bahuśabda iti | ayamāśayaḥ--sūtre bahutvasyaikatve'pi bahutvāśrayasya bahutvāt āśrayagataṃ bahutvaṃ bahutve āropya bahuṣu iti bahuvacananirdeśaḥ kṛtaḥ |
analyzed: bahutvasya ekatvāt bahau bahuvacanam iti sati yat bahuṣu iti bahuvacana nirdeśanam tat jñāpayati nānā dravya vācī yaḥ bahu śabdaḥ saḥ eva bahuṣu iti atra upāttaḥ na vaipulya vācī bahu śabdaḥ iti ayam āśayaḥ sūtre bahutvasya ekatve api bahutva āśrayasya bahutvāt āśraya gatam bahutvam bahutve āropya bahuṣu iti bahuvacana nirdeśaḥ kṛtaḥ

original: tena ca yasya bahutvasyāśrayo bahurbhavati tasmin bahutve bahuvacanaṃ bhavatīti sūtrārthaḥ saṃpadyate | vaipulyarūpasya bahutvasyāśraya eka iti ekāśrite vaipulyātmake bahutve bahuvacanaṃ na bhavati | saṃkhyārupasya bahutvasyāśrayo nāneti saṃkhyārupe bahutva eva bahuvacanamiti |
analyzed: tena ca yasya bahu tvasya āśrayaḥ bahuḥ bhavati tasmin bahu tve bahuvacanam bhavati iti sūtra arthaḥ saṃpadyate vaipulya rūpasya bahu tvasya āśrayaḥ ekaḥ iti eka āśrite vaipulya ātmake bahu tve bahuvacanam na bhavati saṃkhyā rupasya bahu tvasya āśrayaḥ nānā iti saṃkhyā rupe bahu tve eva bahuvacanam iti

original: jhrjñā.ṭa tatraiteṣu prapatyayaniyame avyayānāṃ padatvāprāpterarthaniyamo vaktavyaḥ | prakṛtārthāpekṣo vā pratyayaniyamaḥ | jhrviṭa ṭhavdyekayordvivacanaikavacane' "bahuṣu bahuvacanam' (sū.1-4-21) ityādīnāṃ niyamārthatvamāśrīyate | niyamaśva dvividhaḥ pratyayaniyamaḥ arthaniyamaśveti |
analyzed: tatra eteṣu avyayānām pada tva aprāpteḥ artha niyamaḥ vaktavyaḥ prakṛta artha apekṣaḥ vā pratyaya niyamaḥ ṭhavdi ekayoḥ dvivacana ekavacane bahuṣu bahuvacanam sū1421 ityādīnām niyama artha tvam āśrīyate dvividhaḥ pratyaya niyamaḥ artha niyama śva iti

original: ekasminnevaikavacanam, dvayoreva dvivacanam, bahūṣveva bahuvacanamiti pratyayaniyamaḥ ekasminnekavacanameva, dvayordvivacanameva, bahuṣu bahuvacanameveti cārthaniyamaḥ | tatra pratyaniyamāśrayaṇe uccais nīcais ityādīnāmavyayānāṃ padasaṃjñā na prapnoti, asubantatvāt |
analyzed: ekasmin eva ekavacanam dvayoḥ eva dvivacanam bahūṣu eva bahuvacanam iti pratyaya niyamaḥ ekasmin ekavacanam eva dvayoḥ dvivacanam eva bahuṣu bahuvacanam eva iti ca artha niyamaḥ tatra pratya niyama āśrayaṇe uccais nīcais ityādīnām avyayānām pada saṃjñā na prapnoti a sup anta tvāt

original: pratyayā hi viśiṣṭāyāṃ saṃkhyāyāṃ niyatā iti niḥ saṃkhyebhyo'vyayebhyaḥ subanutpatteḥ subantatvaprayuktā padasaṃjñā na syāt |padatvābhāve ca rutvādyabhāvaprasaṅga ityāśaṅkya, ata evānupapatteḥ pratyayaniyamaṃ parityajya arthaniyama āśrayaṇīya ityāha--tatraiteṣu iti | eteṣu bahuvacanādiṣu | pratyayaniyamapakṣe'pi na doṣaḥ |
analyzed: pratyayāḥ hi viśiṣṭāyām saṃkhyāyām niyatāḥ iti niḥ saṃkhyebhyaḥ vyayebhyaḥ sup anutpatteḥ sup anta tva prayuktā pada saṃjñā na syāt pada tva abhāve ca ru tva ādi abhāva prasaṅgaḥ iti āśaṅkya atas eva anupapatteḥ pratyaya niyamam parityajya artha niyamaḥ āśrayaṇīyaḥ iti āha tatra eteṣu iti eteṣu bahuvacana ādiṣu pratyaya niyama pakṣe api na doṣaḥ

original: prakṛtārthānapekṣya niyamaḥ kriyate | ekatvādayaśca prakṛtāḥ | tataśca ekasminnevaikavacanamiti pratyayaniyamena saṃkhyātvena ekatvasajātīyayordvitvabahutvayorekavacanavyāvṛttirlabhyate | tāvatā niḥ saṃkhyebhyo'vyayebhyaḥ prātipadikārtha ekavacanaṃ na vyārvatyate |
analyzed: prakṛta arthān apekṣya niyamaḥ kriyate ekatva ādayaḥ ca prakṛtāḥ tatas ca ekasmin eva ekavacanam iti pratyaya niyamena saṃkhyā tvena ekatva sajātīyayoḥ dvitva bahutvayoḥ ekavacana vyāvṛttiḥ labhyate tāvatā niḥ saṃkhyebhyaḥ vyayebhyaḥ prātipadika arthaḥ ekavacanam na

original: tataścāvyayebhyo'pi svādyatpattisiddheḥ padatvamaviruddhamityāśayenāha--prakṛtārthāpekṣo veti | pūrvoktaniyamadvayapratipādakaṃ vārtikaṃ paṭhati--- jhrjñā.ṭa sūpāṃ karmādayo'pyarthāḥ saṃkhyā caiva tathā tiṅām | prasiddho niyamastatra niyamaḥ prakṛteṣu vā || jhrvi.ṭa niyamastatreti | arthaniyama ityarthaḥ | niyamaḥ prakṛteṣu veti |
analyzed: tatas ca avyayebhyaḥ api sva ādi atpatti siddheḥ pada tvam aviruddham iti āśayena āha prakṛta artha apekṣaḥ vā iti pūrva ukta niyama dvaya pratipādakam vārtikam paṭhati karma ādayaḥ api arthāḥ saṃkhyā ca eva tathā tiṅām prasiddhaḥ niyamaḥ tatra niyamaḥ prakṛteṣu vā niyamaḥ tatra iti artha niyamaḥ iti arthaḥ niyamaḥ prakṛteṣu vā iti

original: pratyayaniyama ityarthaḥ | jhrjñā.ṭa tatrārthe "avyayādāpsupaḥ' (sū.2-4-82) iti jñāpakādvā avyayebhyaḥ supaḥ | avyayebhya autsargikamekavacanamiti pakṣantaraṃ "tadvitaśca'(sū.1-1-31) iti sūtre bhāṣye | jhrvi.ṭa bhavatu sāmānyapekṣaḥ pratyaniyamaḥ ekatva evaikavacanaṃ nānyasmin kasmiṃścidaśyartha iti |
analyzed: pratyaya niyamaḥ iti arthaḥ jhrjñāṭa tatra arthe avyayāt āp supaḥ sū2482 iti jñāpakāt vā avyayebhyaḥ supaḥ avyayebhyaḥ autsargikam ekavacanam iti pakṣa antaram iti sūtre bhāṣye jhrviṭa bhavatu sāmānya apekṣaḥ eka tve eva ekavacanam na anyasmin kasmiṃścid aśi arthaḥ iti

original: tathāpi jñāpakādavyayebhyaḥ svādyutpattiḥ sidhyatītyāha--tatrārtha iti | ekatvādyartha evaikavacanādikamiti pakṣe'pītyarthaḥ | pratyayaniyamena niḥ saṃkhyebhyo'vyayebhyo yadisupo vyārvatyante tarhi avyayebhyaḥ supāmanutpattyā teṣām "avyādāpsupaḥ' (sū.2-4-82) iti lugvidhānamanarthakaṃ syāt | kṛtaṃ ca tat avyayebhyaḥ subutpattirastīti jñāpayati |
analyzed: tathā api jñāpakāt avyayebhyaḥ sva ādi utpattiḥ sidhyati iti āha tatra arthaḥ iti ekatva ādi arthe eva ekavacana ādikam iti pakṣe api iti arthaḥ pratyaya niyamena saṃkhyebhyaḥ vyayebhyaḥ tarhi avyayebhyaḥ supām anutpattyā teṣām iti luk vidhānam anarthakam syāt kṛtam ca tat avyayebhyaḥ sup utpattiḥ asti iti jñāpayati

original: ato na padatvānupapattiriti bhāvaḥ | avyayebhyaḥ supa iti | supa iti prathamābahuvacanam | utpadyanta iti śeṣaḥ | vastutastu - avyayānna sarvavacanānyutpadyante, kiṃ tvekavacanamevetyāha-- avyayebhya iti |
analyzed: atas na pada tva anupapattiḥ iti bhāvaḥ avyayebhyaḥ supaḥ iti supaḥ iti prathamā bahuvacanam utpadyante iti śeṣaḥ vastutas tu avyayāt na sarva vacanāni utpadyante kim tu ekavacanam eva iti āha avyayebhyaḥ iti

original: "taddhitaścāsarvavibhaktiḥ' iti sūtrabhāṣye "dhdyekayordvivacanaikavacane' "bahuṣu bahuvacanam' iti sutranyāsaṃ bhaṅūktvā "ekavacanam' "dvayordvivacanam' "bahuṣu bahuvacanam' iti sūtravinyāsaṃ kṛtvā ekavacanamutsargataḥ kariṣyate, dvibaḍhaddhaṭhṭhaḍavorarthayostasya dvivacanabahuvacane bādhake ityuktam |
analyzed: taddhitaḥ ca a sarva vibhaktiḥ iti sūtra bhāṣye dh di ekayoḥ dvivacana ekavacane bahuṣu bahuvacanam iti sutra nyāsam bhaṅūktvā ekavacanam dvayoḥ dvivacanam bahuṣu bahuvacanam iti sūtra vinyāsam kṛtvā ekavacanam utsargataḥ kariṣyate dvi baḍha ddha ṭh ṭha ḍavoḥ arthayoḥ tasya dvivacana bahuvacane bādhake iti uktam

original: tataśca ekavacanamiti sāmānyavidhinā dvitbabahutvābhāve ekavacanamiti labhyate | ato'saṃkhyānāmavyayānāṃ dvitvabahutvābhāvāt sāmānyasutroktamekavacanameva bhaviṣyatīti bhāvaḥ | kiṃ sāmānyasūtreṇa prathamāyā evaikavacanaṃ bhavati, uta sarvavibhaktyekavacanamiti tvanyat | jhrjñā.ṭa adhiparī anarthakau (sū.1-4-93)||
analyzed: tatas ca ekavacanam iti sāmānya vidhinā dvitva bahutva abhāve ekavacanam iti labhyate atosaṃkhyānām avyayānām dvitva bahutva abhāvāt sāmānya sutra uktam ekavacanam eva bhaviṣyati iti bhāvaḥ kim sāmānya sūtreṇa prathamāyāḥ eva ekavacanam bhavati uta sarva vibhakti ekavacanam iti tu anyat jhrjñāṭa adhiparī anarthakau sū 1493

original: etajjñāpayati anarthakānāmapi nipātānāmarthavat kṛtamiti | idaṃ hi gatyupasargasaṃjñābādhena karmapravacanīyasaṃjñārtham | yadvā arthāntarābhāvādanarthakau dhātunoktāṃ kriyāmāhatuḥ | uktārthānāmapi prayoga ityarthajñāpakam| jhrvi.ṭa nanu "adhiparī anarthakau' iti sutreṇānarthakayoḥ adhiparyoḥ karmapravacanīyasaṃjñālijhānamanakchatam |
analyzed: etat jñāpayati anarthakānām api nipātānām arthavat kṛtam iti idam hi gati upasarga saṃjñā bādhena karmapravacanīya saṃjñā artham yat vā artha antara abhāvāt anarthakau dhātunā uktām kriyām āhatuḥ ukta arthānām api prayogaḥ iti artha jñāpakam nanu adhi parī anarthakau iti sutreṇa anarthakayoḥ adhi paryoḥ karmapravacanīya saṃjñā ali jhāna manak śatam

original: na ca gatyupasargasaṃjñābādhanārthaṃ tadvidhānam iti vācyam | kriyoyogo hi gatisaṃjñopasargasaṃjñā ca vidhīyate | anarthakayośca
analyzed: na ca gati upasarga saṃjñā bādhana artham tat vidhānam iti vācyam kriyaḥ yogaḥ hi gati saṃjñā upasarga saṃjñā ca vidhīyate anarthakayoḥ ca

original: kriyānvitārthakatvarūpakriyāyogābhāvāttayoḥsaṃjñayoraprasakteḥ ityāśaḍhaddhaṭhṭhaḍakya jñāpanārthatayā sūtrasārthakyāmāha--etajjñāpayatīti | anarthakānāmapyādhiparyādīnāmarthavataḥ śabdasya yatkāryaṃ bhavati tadbhavatīti jñāpyate | arthavataḥ kriyoyoganimittake gatyupasargasaṃjñe bhavataḥ |
analyzed: kriyā anvita arthaka tva rūpa kriyā yoga abhāvāt tayoḥ saṃjñayoḥ aprasakteḥ iti āśaḍhaddhaṭhṭhaḍakya jñāpana arthatayā sūtra sārthakyām āha etat jñāpayati iti anarthakānām api ādhi paryādīnām arthavataḥ śabdasya yat kāryam bhavati tat bhavati iti jñāpyate arthavataḥ kriyaḥ yoga nimittake gati upasarga saṃjñe bhavataḥ

original: te anarthakayoradhiparyorapi bhavetāmiti tadvāraṇārthaṃ karmapravacanīyasaṃjñāvidhānam | jñāpanaphalaṃ tu "nipātasyānarthakasyāpi prātipadikasaṃjñā vaktavyā' iti arthavatsūtre proktaṃ vacanamanāvaśyakamiti | vastutastu adhiparī api nānarthakau | "sarve'pyupasargā dhātvarthadyotakāḥ' iti hi matam |
analyzed: te anarthakayoḥ adhi paryoḥ api bhavetām iti tad vāraṇa artham karmapravacanīya saṃjñā vidhānam jñāpana phalam tu nipātasya anarthakasya api prātipadika saṃjñā vaktavyā iti arthavat sūtre proktam vacanam anāvaśyakam iti vastutas tu adhi parī api na anarthakau sarve api upasargāḥ dhātvartha dyotakāḥ iti hi matam

original: tatra dhātvarthakriyāgataviśeṣadyotakatvamanyeṣāmupasargāṇām | adhiparī tu dhātuvācyāṃ kriyāṃ dyotayataḥ na tu tadgataṃ viśeṣam | etadabhiprāyeṇauva "anarthakā' viti sūtre uktam |tathā ca kriyādyotakatvameva kriyāyogaḥ |
analyzed: tatra dhātu artha kriyā gata viśeṣa dyotaka tvam anyeṣām upasargāṇām adhi parī tu dhātu vācyām kriyām dyotayataḥ na tu tad gatam viśeṣam anarthakāḥ iti sūtre uktam tathā ca kriyā dyotaka tvam eva kriyā yogaḥ

original: tasya cādhiparyorapi sadbhāvāt prāptāṃ gatisaṃjñāmupasargasaṃjñāṃ ca bādhitumanena karmapravacaniyasaṃjñāvidānamiti na sūtravairyathyam | ata eva ca noktavacanajñāpakatvamapītyāśayenāha --yadvā arthāntarābhāvāditi | dhātuvācyakriyāvyatiriktasya tadgataviśeṣarūpasya dyotyārthasyābhāvādityarthaḥ | āhaturiti | dyotayata ityarthaḥ |
analyzed: tasya ca adhi paryoḥ api sadbhāvāt prāptām gati saṃjñām upasarga saṃjñām ca bādhitum anena karmapravacaniya saṃjñā vidānam iti na sūtra vairyathyam atas eva ca na ukta vacana jñāpaka tvam api iti āśayena āha yat vā artha antara abhāvāt iti dhātu vācya kriyā vyatiriktasya tad gata viśeṣa rūpasya dyotya arthasya abhāvāt iti arthaḥ āhatuḥ iti dyotayataḥ iti arthaḥ

original: nanu dhātūktamevārthaṃ yadyadhiparī āhatustarhi tayoḥ prayogo vyarthaḥ, uktārthānāmaprayoga iti nyāyādityata āha--uktārthānāmapīti | ata evoktārthānāmapi prayogo'stīti jñāpyata iti bhāvaḥ |
analyzed: nanu dhātu uktam eva artham yadi adhi parī āhatuḥ tarhi tayoḥ prayogaḥ vyarthaḥ ukta arthānām aprayogaḥ iti nyāyāt iti atas āha ukta arthānām api iti atas eva ukta arthānām api prayogaḥ ūsti iti jñāpyate iti bhāvaḥ

original: yathā brāhmaṇau dvāvānayetyatra dvivacanenaiva dvitve'vagate sphuṭatarapratipattyarthaṃ punaḥ prayogastadvat punaḥ prayogo na virudhyata iti "adhiparī anarthakau' iti sūtraṃ jñāpayatīti yāvat | jhrjñā.ṭa ṭhalaḥ parasmaipadam' (sū.1-4-99)|| sici vṛddhau parasmaipadagrahaṇaṃ jñāpakaṃ puruṣasaṃjñā parasmaipadasaṃjñāṃ na bādhata iti |
analyzed: yathā brāhmaṇau dvau ānaya iti atra dvivacanena eva dvi tva iva gate sphuṭatara pratipatti artham punar prayogaḥ tadvat punar prayogaḥ na virudhyate iti adhi parī anarthakau iti sūtram jñāpayati iti yāvat jhrjñāṭaḥ ṭhalaḥ parasmaipadam sū1499 sici vṛddhau parasmaipada grahaṇam jñāpakam puruṣa saṃjñā parasmaipada saṃjñām na bādhate iti

original: jhrvi.ṭa nanu "laḥ parasmaipadam' ityatra parasmaipadagrahaṇaṃ na kartavyam | kiṃ tu "lasya' (sū.3-4-77) ityatraiva prakaraṇe parasmaipadagrahaṇaṃ kartavyam | iha prathamādhyāye parasmaipadasaṃjñāvacane ekasaṃjñādhikārāt tiptasjhiprabhṛtīnāṃ puruṣasaṃjñāyā api vidhānāt parabhūtā sā parasmaipadasaṃjñāṃ bādheta |
analyzed: nanu laḥ parasmaipadam iti atra parasmaipada grahaṇam na kartavyam kim tu lasya iti atra eva prakaraṇe parasmaipada grahaṇam kartavyam iha prathama adhyāye parasmaipada saṃjñā vacane eka saṃjñā adhikārāt tip ta sjhi prabhṛtīnām puruṣa saṃjñāyāḥ api vidhānāt parabhūtā sā parasmaipada saṃjñām bādheta

original: parasmaipadasaṃjñāvidhānaṃ tu śatṛkvasvoḥ sāvakāśamityāśaṅkyāha--sici vṛddhāviti | yadi hi puruṣasaṃjñayā parasmaipadasaṃjñāyastibādiṣu bādhaḥ syāttadā "sici vṛddhiḥ parasmaipadeṣu' (sū.7-2-1) iti sūtre parasmaipadaśabdena tibādīnāṃ nirdeśo'saṃgataḥ syāt| ataḥ puruṣasaṃjñayā parasmaipadasaṃjñā na bādhyata iti jñāpyata iti bhāvaḥ |
analyzed: parasmaipada saṃjñā vidhānam tu śatṛ kvasvoḥ sa avakāśam iti āśaṅkya āha sici vṛddhau iti yadi hi puruṣa saṃjñayā parasmaipada saṃjñā yaḥ tip ādiṣu bādhaḥ syāt tadā sici vṛddhiḥ parasmaipadeṣu iti sūtre parasmaipada śabdena tip ādīnām nirdeśaḥ usaṃgataḥ syāt atas puruṣa saṃjñayā parasmaipada saṃjñā na bādhyate iti jñāpyate iti bhāvaḥ

original: jhrjñā.ṭa vibhaktiśca (sū.1-4-104)|| trīṇi trīṇītyanuvṛttau "aṣṭanaā' (sū.7-2-84) ityādivacanād bhavati | tannivṛttau "tasmācchaso naḥ puṃsi' (sū.5-2-203) iti natvavidhānāt, aujasoriti vaktavye prathamayorityuktyā ca pūrvasavarṇadīrghavidhau trikagrahaṇamiti jñāpyate |
analyzed: vibhaktiḥ ca sū14104 trīṇi trīṇi iti anuvṛttau sū7284 iti ādi vacanāt bhavati tad nivṛttau tasmāt śasaḥ naḥ puṃsi sū52203 iti na tva vidhānāt aujasoḥ iti vaktavye prathamayoḥ iti uktyā ca pūrva savarṇa dīrgha vidhau trika grahaṇam iti jñāpyate

original: jhrvi.ṭa nanu "vibhaktiśca' (sū.1-4-104) iti sūtre "tiṅastrīṇitrīṇi' (sū.1-4-100) iti sūtrāt trīṇi trīṇi ityanuvartate na vā ? yadyanuvartate tadā trikasyaiva vibhaktisaṃjñā bhavati naikasyeti labhyate | tathā sati aṣṭanśabdasya jasādau ekaikasmin parataḥ ātvaṃ na syāt |
analyzed: nanu vibhaktiḥ ca sū14104 iti sūtre tiṅaḥ trīṇi trīṇi sū14100 iti sūtrāt trīṇi trīṇi iti anuvartate na vā yadi anuvartate tadā trikasya eva vibhakti saṃjñā bhavati na ekasya iti labhyate tathā sati aṣṭan śabdasya jas ādau ekaikasmin paratas ā tvam na syāt

original: "aṣṭana ā vibhaktau, (sū.7-2-84) iti sūtreṇa hi vibhaktau parata ātvaṃ vidhīyate | na hyaṣṭan śabdātparaṃ yugapattrikamastīti doṣaḥ | yadi trīṇi trīṇīti nānuvartate tadā svādīnāṃ pratyekaṃ vibhaktisaṃjñakatvaṃ labhyata ityekaikasmin parato'pyātvamaṣṭanaḥ sidhyati |
analyzed: aṣṭanaḥ ā vibhaktau sū 7284 iti sūtreṇa hi vibhaktau paratas ātvam vidhīyate na hi aṣṭan śabdāt param yugapad trikam asti iti doṣaḥ yadi trīṇi trīṇi iti na anuvartate tadā sva ādīnām pratyekam vibhakti saṃjñaka tvam labhyate iti ekaikasmin sidhyati

original: tathāpi "prathamayoḥ pūrvasavarṇaḥ' (sū.6-1-102) ityatra prathamayorvibhaktyorityanena samudāyasyāgrahaṇāt vibhaktisaṃjñakayoḥ prathamayoḥ su au ityanayoreva acītyanuvṛttyā aujasoreva vā parataḥ pūrvasavarṇadīrgho bhavet jasādau parato na bhavet iti pakṣadvaye'pi doṣamāśaḍhaddhaṭhṭhaḍakya samāghate-- trīṇa trīṇītyanuvṛttāviti | anuvṛttipakṣe
analyzed: tathā api prathamayoḥ pūrva savarṇaḥ iti atra prathamayoḥ vibhaktyoḥ iti anena samudāyasya agrahaṇāt vibhakti saṃjñakayoḥ prathamayoḥ su au iti anayoḥ eva a ci iti anuvṛttyā vā paratas pūrva savarṇa dīrghaḥ bhavet jas ādau paratas na bhavet iti pakṣa dvaye pi doṣam āśaḍhat dhaṭhṭhaḍakya samāghate trīṇi trīṇi iti anuvṛttau iti anuvṛtti pakṣe

original: trikātmakasamudāyasyaiva vibhaktisaṃjñakatve'pi trikasya yugapatprayogābāvāt ātvavacanasārmathyāt vibhaktiśabdo vibhaktyavayave varti iti vibhattayavayave parata ātvavidhānāt ekaikasmin parato'pyātvaṃ sidhyatīti na doṣaḥ | bhavatīti | aṣṭana ātvamiti śeṣaḥ |
analyzed: trika ātmaka samudāyasya eva vibhakti saṃjñaka tve pi trikasya yugapad prayoga abāvāt ātva vacana sārmathyāt vibhakti śabdaḥ vibhakti avayave varti iti vibhattay avayave paratas ātva vidhānāt ekaikasmin paratas upi ātvam sidhyati iti na doṣaḥ bhavati iti aṣṭanaḥ ātvam iti śeṣaḥ

original: trīṇi trīṇīti nānuvartata iti pakṣe pratyekaṃ vibhaktisaṃjñāyāmapi "prathamayoḥ pūrvasavarṇaḥ' iti sūtre prathamayostrikayoreva grahaṇaṃ na pratyayayoriti pratipādayati--tannivṛttāviti | trīṇi trīṇītyasyānanuvṛttāvityarthaḥ |
analyzed: trīṇi trīṇi iti na anuvartate iti pakṣe pratyekam vibhakti saṃjñāyām api prathamayoḥ pūrva savarṇaḥ iti sūtre prathamayoḥ trikayoḥ eva grahaṇam na pratyayayoḥ iti pratipādayati tad nivṛttau iti trīṇi trīṇi iti asya ananuvṛttau iti arthaḥ

original: "tasmācchaso naḥ puṃsi' iti sūtraṃ hi nacchabdena pūrvasavarṇadīrghaṃ parāmṛśya tataḥ parasya śasavayavasya sakārasya natvaṃ vidhatte |
analyzed: tasmāt śasaḥ naḥ puṃsi iti sūtram hi na c śabdena pūrva savarṇa dīrgham parāmṛśya tatas parasya śa sa vayavasya sakārasya na tvam vidhatte

original: tatra tasmādityasyānupādāne etān gāḥ pasyetyatra go a śas iti sthite "auto'mśasoḥ ' (sū.6-1-93) iti sūtreṇa okāra - akārayoḥ ākāre ekādeśe gās ityavasthāyāṃ sakārasyāpi natvaṃsyāditi tadvāraṇārthaṃ tasmādityucyate | gās ityatratya ākāraḥ na pūrvasavarṇadīrgha iti pūrvasavarṇadīrghātparatvaṃ sakārasya nāstīti na natvam |
analyzed: tatra tasmāt ityasya anupādāne etān gāḥ pasya iti atra go a śas iti sthite sū6193 iti sūtreṇa okāra akārayoḥ ākāre eka ādeśe iti avasthāyām sakārasya api natvam syāt iti tad vāraṇa artham tasmāt iti ucyate iti atratyaḥ ākāraḥ na pūrva savarṇa dīrghaḥ iti pūrva savarṇa dīrghāt para tvam sakārasya na asti iti na natvam

original: yadi ca "prathamayoḥ pūrvasavarṇaḥ' ityanena prathamayoḥ pratyayayoḥ aujasoreva pūrvasavarṇadīrghātparo na bhaviṣyatīti kiṃ tasmādityanena | tatkriyamāṇaṃ prathamayorityanena trikadvayameva gṛhyata iti jñāpayati | ataḥ amśasorapi pūrvasavarṇadīrghasiddhyā na ko'pi doṣaḥ |
analyzed: yadi ca prathamayoḥ pūrva savarṇaḥ iti anena prathamayoḥ pratyayayoḥ aujasoḥ eva pūrva savarṇa dīrghāt paraḥ na bhaviṣyati iti kim tasmāt iti anena tat kriyamāṇam prathamayoḥ iti anena trika dvayam eva gṛhyate iti jñāpayati atas am śasoḥ api pūrva savarṇa dīrgha siddhyā na kaḥ api doṣaḥ

original: na ca vikalpena samāsavidhānārthaṃ tat, tena samāsābhāvapakṣe pāraṃ gaṅgāyā iti vākyasyāpi sādhutvaṃ labhyata iti vācyam | mahāvibhāṣādhikāradeva vikalpasiddheḥ |

original: na ca mahāvibhāṣayā etatsamāsābhāvapakṣe vākyāsya sādhutvalobhe'pi "ṣaṣṭhī' iti sūtraviṅitaṣaṣṭhītatpuruṣasya sādhutvaṃ na labhyata iti gaṅgapāramiti samāsasādhutā na syāditi ṣaṣṭhīsamāsasādhutvabodhanārtha vāgrahaṇamiti vācyam |
analyzed: na ca mahāvibhāṣayā etad samāsa abhāva pakṣe vākya asya sādhutva lobhe pi ṣaṣṭhī iti sūtra viṅ ita ṣaṣṭhī tatpuruṣasya sādhu tvam na labhyate iti gaṅga pāram iti samāsa sādhu tā na syāt iti ṣaṣṭhī samāsa sādhutva bodhana artha vā grahaṇam iti vācyam

original: ṣaṣṭhīsamāsasūtre "pāremadhye' iti sūtre cobhayatra mahāvibhāṣānuvṛttyā ṣaṣṭhīsamāsāpavādasyāpi "pāremadhye' ityavyayībhāvasamāsasya mahāvibhāṣādhikārāt vikalpena bādhakatvamiti etadabhāvapakṣe ṣaṣṭhīsamāsaḥ, tasyāpi vaikalpikatvāt tadabhāvapakṣe vākyasyāpi sādhutvamitīṣṭasiddhaḥ |
analyzed: ṣaṣṭhī samāsa sūtre pāre madhye iti sūtre ca ubhayatra mahāvibhāṣā anuvṛttyā ṣaṣṭhī samāsa apavādasya api pāre madhye iti avyayībhāva samāsasya mahāvibhāṣā adhikārāt vikalpena bādhaka tvam iti etad abhāva pakṣe ṣaṣṭhī samāsaḥ tasya api vaikalpika tvāt tad abhāva pakṣe vākyasya api sādhu tvam iti iṣṭa siddhaḥ

original: ato vāgrahaṇaṃ vyarthamityāśaṅkya vacanaviśeṣajñāpakatayā sārthakyamāha--vetyetaditi | pūrvoktarītyā vyarthaṃ sat vāgrahaṇaṃ evaṃ jñāpayati yat samāsavṛttirmahāvibhāṣayā vikalpena bhavati | tatra yadi kaścidapavādo bhavati sa utsargasamāsasya nityamevāpanādaḥ bhavatīti |

original: tenāpavādasūtre mahāvibhāṣānuvṛttāvapi pakṣe vākyasya sādhutvamevānumanyate, na tu utsargasamāsasya | tathā ca prakṛte'pi vāgrahaṇābhāve mahāvibhāṣānuvṛtāvapi ṣaṣṭhī samāsāpavādabhūtasya etasyābhāvapakṣe vākyasādhutvameva labhyeta, na tu ṣaṣṭhīsamāsasya | tadarthaṃ vāgrahaṇam |
analyzed: tena apavāda sūtre mahāvibhāṣā anuvṛttau api pakṣe vākyasya sādhu tvam eva anumanyate na tu utsarga samāsasya tathā ca prakṛte api vā grahaṇa abhāve mahāvibhāṣā anuvṛtau api ṣaṣṭhī samāsa apavāda bhūtasya etasya abhāva pakṣe vākya sādhu tvam eva labhyeta na tu ṣaṣṭhī samāsasya tad artham vā grahaṇam

original: sati ca tasmin mahāvibhāṣayā vākyāsādhutvaṃ, vāgrahaṇena utsargo'pi pakṣe'bhyanujñāyate iti vākyasya ṣaṣṭhīsamāsasya avyayībhāvasyeti trayāṇāmapi sādhutvaṃ sidhyati | itthaṃ ca mahāvibhāṣādhikāramadhyapatite'pavādasūtre vāgrahaṇaṃ nāsti cet tat utsargasya nityaṃ bādhakatvāt utsargaśāstraṃ nānumanyata iti niṃrṇayo labhyata ityavadheyam |
analyzed: sati ca tasmin mahāvibhāṣayā vākya asādhu tvam vā agrahaṇena utsargaḥ upi pakṣebhyaḥ anujñāyate iti vākyasya ṣaṣṭhī samāsasya avyayībhāvasya iti trayāṇām api sādhu tvam sidhyati ittham ca mahāvibhāṣā adhikāra madhya patita ipavāda sūtre vā agrahaṇam na asti ced tat utsargasya nityam bādhaka tvāt utsarga śāstram na anumanyate iti niṃrṇayaḥ labhyate iti avadheyam

original: atra ṣaṣṭhīsamāsāpavādabhūtaḥ vaikalpiko'pi pakṣevākyasādhutvamanumanyamānaḥ naṣaṣṭhīsamāsamanumanyata iti ca jñāpanaphalamavaseyam | kṛte tvasminniti | vāgrahaṇe kṛta ityarthaḥ | tathā ca vibhāṣā vā iti vikalpavācakapadadvayasadbhāvāt tatraikena samāsaḥ vikalpena vidhīyate | tena vākyamapi pakṣe sādhu iti labhyate |

original: jhrvi.ṭa nanu "yāsuṭ parasmaipadeṣūdātto ṅicca' iti sūtre udāttagrahaṇaṃ kimartham? pratyayasvareṇaiva pratyayabhaktasya yāsuṭo'pyudāttatvasiddheḥ | na ca liṅādeśāānāṃ pitāṃ tipsipmipāṃ "anudāttau suppitau'(sū.3-1-4) iti sūtreṇānudāttatvāt tadbhaktasya yāsūṭo'pi anudāttatve prāpte tadbādhanārthamudāttavacanamiti vācyam |
analyzed: nanu yāsuṭ parasmaipadeṣu udāttaḥ ṅ it ca iti sūtre udātta grahaṇam kimartham pratyaya svareṇa eva pratyaya bhaktasya yāsuṭaḥ upi udātta tva siddheḥ na ca anudāttau iti sūtreṇa anudāttau anudātta tve prāpte tad bādhana artham udātta vacanam iti vācyam

original: tathā sati "yāsuṭ parasmaipadeṣvapicca liṅ' ityeva sūtrayet tatra apicca liṅ ityanena liṅādeśānāṃ sarveṣāmapittvātideśena pittvaprayuktānudāttatvāsiddheḥ pratyayasvareṇodāttatvasyaiva prāpteḥ udāttagrahaṇavairyathyāt ityāśaṅkya, "āgamā anudāttāḥ' iti vacanajñāpakatayā sārthakyamāha--yāsuḍiḍḍatdh;ti |

original: tathā cāgamānāmanudāttatvāt yāsuṭo'pyanudāttatvaṃ mā prasāṅkṣīditi udāttavacanaṃ kṛtamiti bhāvaḥ | idamevetyādi | jñāpakamuktamiti | "ādyudāttaśca' (sū.3-2-3) iti sūtre iti śeṣaḥ | yāsuḍḍḍatdh;viśiṣṭasyaiva pratyayatvena pratyayādyudāttasvareṇaiva yāsuṭa udāttatve siddhe yāsuṭa udāttavacanaṃ āgamā avidyamānavadityarthajñāpakam |

original: sati cāvidyamānatve tadrahitapratyayasyaivādyudāttatve śeṣanighātenāgamānāmanudāttatvaṃ siddhamiti tatra pratipāditam | tathā ca śeṣanighātaprāptānudāttatvavyāvṛttaye udāttagrahaṇaṃ caritārthamiti tadāśayaḥ |
analyzed: sati ca avidyamāna tve tad rahita pratyayasya eva ādi udātta tve śeṣa nighātena āgamānām anudātta tvam siddham iti tatra pratipāditam tathā ca śeṣa nighāta prāpta anudātta tva vyāvṛttaye udātta grahaṇam caritārtham iti tad āśayaḥ

original: nanu yāsuṭaḥ parasmaipadanimittakatvāt lādeśottaraṃ pravṛttyā pūrvamevāntaraṅgatvātparatvādvā pratyayādyudāttatve tataḥ yāsuḍaḍḍatdh;svarako vā syāt śeṣanighātenānudātto veti udāttasiddhyarthaṃ kriyamāṇamudāttavacanaṃ caritārthaṃ kathaṃ jñāpakamiti āśaṅkya ata eveyamekadeśyuktirityāha--idaṃ dvayamapīti | jhrjñā.ṭa supa ātmanaḥ kyac (sū.3-1-8)||
analyzed: nanu yāsuṭaḥ parasmaipada nimittaka tvāt la ādeśa uttaram pravṛttyā pūrvam eva antaraṅga tvāt paratvāt vā pratyaya ādi udātta tve tatas vā syāt śeṣa nighātena anudāttaḥ vā iti udātta siddhi artham kriyamāṇam udātta vacanam caritārtham katham jñāpakam iti āśaṅkya atas eva iyam eka deśī uktiḥ iti āha edam dvayam api iti supaḥ ātmanaḥ kyac sū 318

original: "aśvāghasyāt' (sū.7-4-37) iti kyaci ītvabādhanārthākāravidhānāt jñāpakāt aghaśabdācchandasi parecchāyāṃ kyajiti | jhrvi.ṭa nanu "supa ātmanaḥ kyat' iti sutre ātmanaḥ ityetat supa ityatrānveti | tataśca ātmasaṃbandhyarthabodhakaṃ yat subantaṃ tataḥ icchāyāmarthe kyacpratyayo bhavatīti sutrārtho labhyate |
analyzed: iti kyaci ī tva bādhana artha ākāra vidhānāt jñāpakāt agha śabdāt chandasi para icchāyām kyac iti nanu supaḥ ātmanaḥ kyat iti sutre ātmanaḥ iti etat supaḥ iti atra anveti tatas ca ātma saṃbandhi artha bodhakam yat sup antam tatas icchāyām arthe kyac pratyayaḥ bhavati iti sutra arthaḥ labhyate

original: evaṃ sati chandasi "mā tvā vṛkā agāyavaḥ' ityatra aghamicchanta ityarthe aghaśabdātkyac na syāt vṛkā hi na ātmasaṃbandhi aghamicchanti kintu parasyāgham | tathā ca aghaśabdasya eṣitṛvṛkasaṃbandhyaghaboghakatvābhāvāt kathaṃ tataḥ kyajityāśaṅkyāha--aśvāghasyāditīti | chandasi paraṃ parasaṃbandhiviṣayakecchāyāmapi kyac bhavati |
analyzed: evam sati chandasi mā tvā vṛkāḥ agāyavaḥ iti atra agham icchantaḥ iti arthe agha śabdāt kyac na syāt vṛkāḥ hi na ātma saṃbandhi agham icchanti kintu parasya agham tathā ca agha śabdasya eṣitṛ vṛka saṃbandhi agha boghaka tva abhāvāt katham tatas kyac iti āśaṅkya āha aśva aghasya iti iti chandasi param para saṃbandhi viṣayaka icchāyām api kyac bhavati

original: tatra jñāpakaṃ tu "aśvāghasyāt ' iti sutram | tasya ca sūtrasya aśva agha ityetayoḥ kyaci parataḥ ākāradeśe bhavatītyarthaḥ | tatrāghaśabdāt parecchāyāmeva kyac saṃbhavati | yate loke na ko'pyātmanaḥ aghamicchet | kiṃ tu parasyaivāghamicchati | evaṃ ca kyaci parataḥ aghaśabdasya ākāraṃ vidadhat pāṇiniḥ aghaśabdāt kyacamanumanyate |
analyzed: tatra jñāpakam tu aśva aghasya iti sutram tasya ca sūtrasya aśva agha iti etayoḥ paratas ākāra deśe bhavati iti arthaḥ tatra agha śabdāt para icchāyām eva kyac saṃbhavati yate loke na kaḥ api ātmanaḥ agham icchet kim tu parasya eva agham icchati evam ca kyaci paratas agha śabdasya ākāram vidadhat pāṇiniḥ agha śabdāt kyacam anumanyate

original: ato jñāpakāt aghaśabdāt chandasi parasyāghamicchatītyarthe'pi kyac bhavatīti sidhyatīti bhāvaḥ | jhrjñā.ṭa ṭhanamovarivaḥ' (sū.3-1-19)|| kyajādyantāḥ kriyāvacanāḥ | "sanādyantāḥ' (sū.3-1-32) iti dhātusaṃjñāvidhānāt jñāpakāt | tatprayojanaṃ ca tatkāryatavyadādayaḥ | sādhane ca tavyadādayaḥ | kriyāyā eva ca sādhanam | bhāvo'pi kriyaiveti |
analyzed: atas jñāpakāt agha śabdāt chandasi parasya agham icchati iti arthe pi kyac bhavati iti sidhyati iti bhāvaḥ sū3119 sū3119 ādi antāḥ kriyā vacanāḥ san ādi antāḥ sū3132 iti dhātu saṃjñā vidhānāt jñāpakāt tad prayojanam ca tad kārya tavyat ādayaḥ sādhane ca tavyat ādayaḥ kriyāyāḥ eva ca sādhanam bhāvaḥ api kriyā eva iti

original: parasādhane tu naiṣāmutpattiḥ |sādhana iti sasaṃbandhikatvāt | yasya dhātoryat sādhanaṃ tatra taddhātoreva pratyayotpatteḥ | jhrvi.ṭaṭhanamovarivaśvitraṅaḥ kyac' iti sutre "kyajādiṣu pratyayārthanirdeśa'
analyzed: para sādhane tu na eṣām utpattiḥ sādhane iti sa saṃbandhika tvāt yasya dhātoḥ yat sādhanam tatra tad dhātoḥ eva pratyaya utpatteḥ kyac iti sutre kyac ādiṣu pratyaya artha nirdeśaḥ

original: iti vārtikakāreṇoktam | tasya cāyamarthaḥ--namasśabdāt pūjāyāmarthe kyac, varivasśabdāt saparyāyāmarthe kyac, citraṅaḥ āścarye'rthe kyac bhavatītyevaṃ kyacpratyayasyārthe'pi nirdeṣṭavyaḥ | anyathā kyajantasya kriyāvācakatvaṃ na bhavet iti | idaṃ ca vārtikaṃ pratyāciśyāsunā bhāṣyakṛtā jñāpakena kyajādyantasya kriyāvācakatvaṃ samarthitam |
analyzed: iti vārtikakāreṇa uktam tasya ca ayam arthaḥ namaḥ śabdāt pūjāyām arthe kyac varivaḥ śabdāt saparyāyām arthe kyac citraṅaḥ āścarya ṛthe kyac bhavati iti evam kyac pratyayasya arthe api nirdeṣṭavyaḥ anyathā kyac antasya kriyā vācaka tvam na bhavet iti idam ca vārtikam bhāṣyakṛtā jñāpakena kyac ādi antasya kriyā vācaka tvam samarthitam

original: tadāha--kyajādyantāḥ iti | ādiśabdena ṇiṅparigrahaḥ | "sanādyantā dhātavaḥ' (sū.3-1-32) iti sūtreṇa kyajādyantasya dhātusaṃjñā vidhīyate | tatprayojanaṃ ca dhātorityaghikṛtya vihitānāṃ tavyadādīnāṃ siddhiḥ | karmādirūpe sādhane ca tavyadādayo vidhīyante | sādhanaṃ ca kriyāyāḥ |
analyzed: tat āha kyac ādi antāḥ iti ādi śabdena ṇiṅ parigrahaḥ san ādi antāḥ dhātavaḥ sū iti sūtreṇa kyac ādi antasya dhātu saṃjñā vidhīyate tad prayojanam ca dhātoḥ iti aghikṛtya vihitānām tavyat ādīnām siddhiḥ karma ādi rūpe sādhane ca tavyat ādayaḥ vidhīyante sādhanam ca kriyāyāḥ

original: tadyadi kyajādyantasya kriyāvācakatvaṃ na syāt tadvācyakriyāyā abhāvāt kriyāsādhane vidhīyamānāḥ tavyadādayaḥ kyajādyantebhyo na bhaveyuḥ | tataśca tavyadādiphalakadhātusaṃjñāvidhānamanarthakaṃ syāt | yato dhātusaṃjñā uktā ataḥ kriyāvācakatvaṃ kyajādyantasya jñāyata iti bhāvaḥ | nanu sādhane tavyadādaya iti katham |
analyzed: tat yadi kyac ādi antasya kriyā vācaka tvam na syāt tad vācya kriyāyāḥ abhāvāt kriyā sādhane vidhīyamānāḥ tavyad ādayaḥ kyac ādi antebhyaḥ na bhaveyuḥ tatas ca tavyad ādi phalaka dhātu saṃjñā vidhānam anarthakam syāt yatas dhātu saṃjñā uktā atas kriyā vācaka tvam kyac ādi antasya jñāyate iti bhāvaḥ nanu sādhane tavyad ādayaḥ iti katham

original: "tayoreva kṛtyaktakhalarthāḥ' (sū.3-4-70) iti sutreṇa bhāve'pi tavyadādīnāṃ vidhānāt ityāśaṅkya, astvevam | tathāpi bhāvaśabdasya yaduttaraṃ tavyādayo bhavanti tadvācyakriyāparatvāt kyajādyantasya kriyāvācakatvābhāve taduttaraṃ bhāve'pi tavyadādirdurlabha iti bhāve tavyadādividhānaṃ tatphalakadhātusaṃjñāvidhānaṃ ca gamayatyeva kyajādyantasya
analyzed: tayoḥ eva kṛtya kta khal arthāḥ sū 3470 iti sutreṇa bhāve pi tavyad ādīnām vidhānāt iti āśaṅkya astu evam tathā api bhāva śabdasya yat uttaram tavya ādayaḥ bhavanti tad vācya kriyā paratvāt kyac ādi antasya kriyā vācaka tva abhāve tat uttaram bhāve pi tavyad ādiḥ durlabhaḥ iti bhāve tavyad ādi vidhānam tad phalaka dhātu saṃjñā vidhānam ca gamayati eva kyac ādi antasya

original: kriyāvācakatāmiti samādhānamāha--bhāvo'pi kriyaiveti | nanu kyajādyantānāṃ kriyāvācakatvābhāve'pi svārthikatvena dravyavācitve'pi ca śabdāntaravācyakriyākārake tavyadādīnām utpattiḥ dhātusaṃjñāyāḥ phalam, yathā dravyavācivṛkṣaśabdāt dṛśikriyākarmatvavivakṣayā vṛkṣaṃ paśyetyādau dvitīyā ityāśaṅkyāha--parasādhane tviti |
analyzed: kriyā vācakatām iti samādhānam āha bhāvaḥ api kriyā eva iti nanu kyac ādi antānām kriyā vācaka tva abhāve pi svārthika tvena dravya vāci tve api ca śabda antara vācya kriyā kārake utpattiḥ dhātu saṃjñāyāḥ phalam yathā dravya vāci vṛkṣa śabdāt dṛśi kriyā karmatva vivakṣayā vṛkṣam paśya ityādau dvitīyā iti āśaṅkya āha para sādhane tu iti

original: sādhanaśabdasya sasaṃbandhikatvāt kasya sādhane tavyadādaya ityākāṅkṣāyāṃ yasya dhātorarthasya yat sādhanaṃ tasmāddhātoḥ pratyaya ityeva labhyate | yathā mātari vartitavyamityukte kasya mātari iti śaṅkāyāṃ svasyāṃ mātari iti labhyate tadvat |
analyzed: sādhana śabdasya sasaṃbandhika tvāt kasya sādhane tavyat ādayaḥ iti ākāṅkṣāyām yasya dhātoḥ arthasya yat sādhanam tasmāt dhātoḥ pratyayaḥ iti eva labhyate yathā mātari vartitavyam iti ukte kasya mātari iti śaṅkāyām svasyām mātari iti labhyate tadvat

original: tathā ca dvitīyādīnāṃ prātipadikādvidhānāt pratipadikasya ca dravyavācakatvāt vacanaprāmāṇyāt parasādhane utpattirbhavati | tavyadādayastu kriyāvāciṣu dhātvantareṣu svasādhane sāvakāśāḥ kyajādyantebhyaḥ parasādhane notpadyante | evaṃ ca svasādhane tavyadādiphalakaṃ dhātusaṃjñāvidhānamevaiṣāṃ kyajādyantānāṃ kriyāvācakatve mānamiti bhāvaḥ |
analyzed: tathā ca dvitīya ādīnām prātipadikāt vidhānāt pratipadikasya ca dravya vācaka tvāt vacana prāmāṇyāt para sādhane utpattiḥ bhavati tavyat ādayaḥ tu kriyā vāciṣu dhātu antareṣu sva sādhane sa avakāśāḥ kyac ādi antebhyaḥ para sādhane na utpadyante evam ca sva sādhane tavyat ādi phalakam dhātu saṃjñā vidhānam eva eṣām kyac ādi antānām kriyā vācaka tve mānam iti bhāvaḥ

analyzed: ātma māne sū 3283 tāseḥ parasya la sārvadhātukasya anudātta tva vidhānam jñāpayati sati śiṣṭaḥ api vikaraṇa svaraḥ sārvadhātuka svaram na bādhate iti ṭha ātama māne khas ca iti sūtre karma kartari ca iti vārtikena ātma karmaka manane vartamānāt manyateḥ supi upapade karma kartari arthe khas bhavati iti kathitam

original: evaṃ vaktuścāyamabiprāyaḥ yat asmin khaśi pare "karmavat karmaṇā tulyakriyaḥ' (sū.3-1-87) iti sūtreṇa karmavaddhāvāt "sārvadhātuke yak' (sū.3-2-67) iti yak bhavati | tathā ca darśanīyaṃmanya ityatra yakāraśravaṇaṃ phalamiti | tadupari evamāśaṅkā bhavati---atra karmakartṛgrahaṇaṃ māstu | kartaryevāyaṃ khaś vidhīyatām |
analyzed: evam vaktuḥ ca ayam abiprāyaḥ yat asmin kha śi pare karma vat karmaṇā tulya kriyaḥ sū 3187 iti sūtreṇa karma vat hāvāt sārvadhātuke ya k sū iti ya k bhavati tathā ca darśanīyaṃmanyaḥ iti atra yakāra śravaṇam phalam iti tad upari evam āśaṅkā bhavati atra karma kartṛ grahaṇam mā astu kartari eva ayam kha ś vidhīyatām

original: divāditvāt asya manadhātoḥ kartrarthake sārvadhātuke khaśi pare śyani darśanīyaṃmanya iti yakāraghaṭitaṃ rūpaṃ sidhyatyeva | na ca rūpaṃ yadyapi sidhyati, tathāpi svare bhedo bhavati yaki sati antodāttasvaraḥ pratyayasvareṇa, śyani sati "ñnityādirnityam' (sū.6-1-197) ityādyudāttasvaraḥ iti
analyzed: div ādi tvāt asya mana dhātoḥ kartṛ arthake sārvadhātuke kha śi pare śyani darśanīyaṃmanyaḥ iti yakāra ghaṭitam rūpam sidhyati eva na ca rūpam yadi api sidhyati tathā api svare bhedaḥ bhavati ya ki sati anta udātta svaraḥ pratyaya svareṇa śyani sati ityādi udātta svaraḥ iti

original: vācyam | khaśsvareṇa śyansvarasya bādhāt antodāttatvasiddheḥ | evamapi ādau khaś tasya svaraśca, tadanantaraṃ śyan tatprayukta svaraśceti śyansvarasya khaśsvare sati vihitatvāt balīyastvamityādyudāttatvameva bhavediti | asyāḥ śaṅkāyāḥ jñāpakasiddhaṃ vacanamālambya samādhānaṃ brūte---tāseḥ parasyeti |
analyzed: vācyam kha ś svareṇa śyan svarasya bādhāt anta udātta tva siddheḥ evam api ādau khaś tasya svaraḥ ca tad anantaram śyan tad prayukta svaraḥ ca iti śyan svarasya kha ś svare sati vihita tvāt balīyaḥ tvam ityādi udātta tvam eva bhavet iti asyāḥ śaṅkāyāḥ jñāpaka siddham vacanam ālambya samādhānam brūta itāseḥ parasya iti

original: atrāyamāśayaḥ--"tāsyanudāttenṅidadupadeśāllasārvadhātukamanudāttam' (sū.6-1-186) iti sūtreṇa tās ityataḥ parasya lasārvadhātukasyānudāttatvaṃ vidhīyate | yathā kartā ityādau "ā' ityasya tāsaḥ parasya luḍaḍḍatdh;ādeśasya anudāttatvaṃ bhavati | pratyayasvarasyāpavādo'yam |
analyzed: atra ayam āśayaḥ tāsi anudātta it ṅ it a t upadeśāt la sārvadhātukam anudāttam sū61186 iti sūtreṇa tās iti atas parasya la sārvadhātukasya anudātta tvam vidhīyate yathā kartā ityādau ā ityasya tāsaḥ parasya anudātta tvam bhavati pratyaya svarasya apavādaḥ yam

original: yadi sati śiṣṭaḥ svaraḥ balīyān syāt tarhi pratyayasvare sati śiṣṭaḥ tāssvaraḥ pratyayasvaraṃ bādhata iti tenaiva pratyayasyānudāttatve siddhe tāseḥ parasya lasārvadhātukasya anudāttavidhānaṃ nāvaśyakam | yato'nudāttatvaṃ vihitaṃ tenaivaṃ jñāpyate yat sati śiṣṭo'pi vikaraṇasvaraḥ sārvadhātukasvaraṃ na bādhate iti |
analyzed: yadi sati śiṣṭaḥ svaraḥ balīyān syāt tarhi pratyaya svare sati śiṣṭaḥ tās svaraḥ pratyaya svaram bādhate iti tena eva pratyayasya anudātta tve siddhe tāseḥ parasya la sārvadhātukasya anudātta vidhānam na āvaśyakam yatas unudātta tvam vihitam tena evam jñāpyate yat sati śiṣṭaḥ api vikaraṇa svaraḥ sārvadhātuka svaram na bādhate iti

original: tathā ca kartā ityādau pratyayasvaro bhavediti tadbādhanārthaṃ tāseḥ parasyānudāttavidhānam | evaṃ ca darśanīyaṃmanya ityādau yadi śyan tadā sa khakhsvaraṃ na bādhata itiantodāttataiva, yakyapi antodāttataiveti svare'pi bhedābhāvāt śyanaiveṣṭasiddheḥ kartaryevāyaṃ khaś ucita iti karmakartṛgrahaṇaṃ na kartavyamiti śthitam |
analyzed: tathā ca kartā ityādau pratyaya svaraḥ bhavet iti tad bādhana artham tāseḥ parasya anudātta vidhānam evam ca darśanīyaṃmanyaḥ ityādau yadi tadā sa khakhsvaram na bādhate iti anta udātta tā eva yaki api anta udātta tā eva iti svare pi bheda abhāvāt śyanā eva iṣṭa siddheḥ kartari eva ayam ucitaḥ iti karma kartṛ grahaṇam na kartavyam iti śthitam

original: jhrjñā.ṭa laṭ sme (sū.3-2-118)|| idaṃ jñāpayati--smalakṣaṇaḥ purālakṣaṇaścadyatane na bhavata iti | jhrvi.ṭa ṭhalaṭ sme' iti sūtrasya smābde upapade bhūtānadyatanaparokṣe laṭpratyayo bhavatītyarthaḥ | liṭo'yamapavādaḥ | nalena sma purādhīyata ityādikamudāharaṇam | tatra ca sūtre vārtikadvayam--"sma purā bhūtamātre, na sma purādyatane' iti |
analyzed: idam jñāpayati sma lakṣaṇaḥ purā lakṣaṇaḥ ca adyatane na bhavataḥ iti ṭhalaṭ sme iti sūtrasya sma abde upapade bhūta anadyatana parokṣe laṭ pratyayaḥ bhavati iti arthaḥ liṭaḥ yam apavādaḥ nalena sma purā ādhīyate iti ādikam udāharaṇam tatra ca sūtre vārttika dvayam sma purā bhūta mātre na sma purā adyatane iti

original: tasya cāyamarthaḥ--prathame vārtike smapurāśabdābhyāmādyantābhyāṃ "laṭ sme' "aparokṣeca' "nanau pṛṣṭaprativacane' "nanvorvibhāṣā' "puri luṅ cāsme' (sū.3-2-118-3-2-122) iti pañcasūtrī lakṣyate | tatra bhūtamātre pratyayo bhavati | smapurālakṣaṇastu pratyayaḥ adyatane na bhavati |
analyzed: tasya ca ayam arthaḥ prathame vārtike sma purā śabdābhyām ādi antābhyām laṭ sme aparokṣa i ca nanau pṛṣṭa prativacane na nvoḥ vibhāṣā puri luṅ ca a sme iti pañca sūtrī lakṣyate tatra bhūta mātre pratyayaḥ bhavati sma purā lakṣaṇaḥ tu pratyayaḥ adyatane na bhavati

original: arthāt "laṭ sme' "aparokṣe ca' "puri luṅcāsme' iti sūtratrayeṇa anadyatane bhūtaviśeṣe pratyayo vidhīyate | "nanau pṛṣṭaprativacane' "nanvorvibhāṣā' ityetābhyāṃ tu bhūtamātre pratyayo vidhīyata iti vyavasthā āśrayaṇīyā iti | iyaṃ ca vyavasthā sūtrato na labhyata iti vartikakārasyāśayaḥ |
analyzed: arthāt laṭ sme aparokṣe ca puri luṅ ca asme iti sūtra trayeṇa anadyatane bhūta viśeṣe pratyayaḥ vidhīyate nanau pṛṣṭa prativacane na nvoḥ vibhāṣā iti etābhyām tu bhūta mātre pratyayaḥ vidhīyate iti vyavasthā āśrayaṇīyā iti iyam ca vyavasthā sūtrataḥ na labhyate iti vartikakārasya āśayaḥ

original: vastutastu sūtrādeveyaṃ vyavasthā labhyata ityāha--idaṃ jñāpayatīti | "aparekṣe ca' (sū.3-2-119) iti uttarasūtrārambhāt "laṭ sme' (sū.3-2-118) iti sūtre parokṣagrahaṇamanuvartate ikati jñāyate | tataśca parokṣagrahaṇasaṃbaddhamanadyatanagrahaṇamapi tatra anuvartata iti "laṭ sme' iti sutraṃparokṣānadyatanaviṣayamiti sidhyati |
analyzed: vastutas tu sūtrāt eva iyam vyavasthā labhyate iti āha edam jñāpayati iti aparekṣe ca sū32119 iti uttara sūtra ārambhāt laṭ sme sū32118 iti sūtre parokṣa grahaṇam anuvartate i k ati jñāyate tatas ca parokṣa grahaṇa saṃbaddham anadyatana grahaṇam api tatra anuvartate iti laṭ sme iti sutram parokṣa anadyatana viṣayam iti sidhyati

original: "aparokṣe ca' (sū.3-2-119) ityayamaparokṣānadyatanaviṣayaḥ | "puri luṅ cāsme' (sū.3-2-122) ityatra tu luṅgrahaṇamahimnā anadyatanaviṣayakatvaṃ labhyate |
analyzed: aparokṣe ca sū32119 iti ayam aparokṣa anadyatana viṣayaḥ puri luṅ ca asme sū32122 iti atra tu luṅ grahaṇa mahimnā anadyatana viṣayaka tvam labhyate

original: yadi hyayaṃ bhūtamātre vidhiḥ syāt tadā "nanvorvibhāṣā' (sū.3-2-121) ityato vibhāṣāgrahaṇānuvṛttyā vikalpena laṭo vidhānāt tadabhācavapakṣe bhūtasāmānye vihito luṅ bhaviṣyatīti luṅgrahaṇamanarthakam | kṛtaṃ ca tat "puri' iti sūtrasyānadyatane luṅaḥ avidhānāt iti pakṣe luṅlābhārthaṃ luṅgrahaṇam |
analyzed: yadi hi ayam bhūta mātre vidhiḥ syāt tadā iti atas vibhāṣā grahaṇa anuvṛttyā vikalpena laṭaḥ vidhānāt bhūta sāmānye vihitaḥ luṅ bhaviṣyati iti luṅ grahaṇam anarthakam kṛtam ca tat puri iti sūtrasya anadyatane luṅaḥ avidhānāt iti pakṣe luṅ lābha artham luṅ grahaṇam

original: itthaṃ ceyaṃ trisūtrī anadyatanabhūtaviṣayiṇīti siddham | madhyamayoḥ "nanau pṛṣṭaprativacane' (sū.3-2-120) "nanvorvibhāṣā' (3-2-121) iti sūtrayostu parokṣagrahaṇasyāparokṣagrahaṇasya ca nivṛttyā tatsahacaritānadyatanagrahaṇasyāpi nivṛtterbhūtamātraviṣayakatvamiti viṣayavibhāgasya sūtreṇaiva lābhādvārtikamanavakaramiti bhāvaḥ |
analyzed: ittham ca iyam tri sūtrī anadyatana bhūta viṣayiṇī iti siddham madhyamayoḥ nanau pṛṣṭa prativacane sū 32120 nanvoḥ vibhāṣā iti sūtrayoḥ tu parokṣa grahaṇasya aparokṣa grahaṇasya ca nivṛttyā tad sahacarita anadyatana grahaṇasya api nivṛtteḥ bhūta mātra viṣayaka tvam iti viṣaya vibhāgasya sūtreṇa eva lābhāt vārtikam anavakaram iti bhāvaḥ

original: jhrjñā.ṭa nindahiṃsa (sū.3-2-146)|| nindādibhyo vuñvacanāt jñāpakāt tācchīlikeṣu sarvala eva tṛjādayo vāsarūpeṇa na bhavanti | jhrvi.ṭa nanu
analyzed: jhrjñāṭa ninda hiṃsa sū32146 nindā ādibhyaḥ vuñ vacanāt jñāpakāt tācchīlikeṣu sarvalaḥ eva tṛc ādayaḥ vāsa rūpeṇa na bhavanti nanu

original: "nindahiṃsa'(sū.3-2-146) ityādisūtreṇa nindādibhyo vuñvidhānamanarthakam | "ṇvultṛcau' (sū.3-2-133) iti sūtra vihitaṇvulaivaiṣṭasiddheḥ | rūpasvarayorviśeṣābhāvāt | nindaka ityatra ṇvulpakṣe "liti' (sū.6-2-193) iti sūtreṇa pratyayātpūrvamudāttaṃ bhavatīti dhātorikāraḥ udāttaḥ |
analyzed: ninda hiṃsa sū32146 ityādi sūtreṇa nindā ādibhyaḥ vuñ vidhānam anarthakam ṇvul tṛcau sū32133 iti sūtra vihita ṇvula eva eṣṭa siddheḥ rūpa svarayoḥ viśeṣa abhāvāt nindakaḥ iti atra ṇvul pakṣe sū62193 iti sūtreṇa pratyayāt pūrvam udāttam bhavati iti dhātoḥ ikāraḥ udāttaḥ

original: vuñpakṣe'pi "ñnityādirnityam'(sū.6-1-197) iti sūtreṇa samudāyādiḥ sa evodātta iti svare'pi bhedābhāvāt | na ca ekācdhātuviṣaye svare bhedo yadyapi nāsiti, tathāpyanekācdhātuviṣaye svarabhedo bhavatyeva | atra sūtre asūyadhāturapa nirdiṣṭaḥ | tato vuñi asūyakaśabde samudāyādirudāttaḥ |
analyzed: iti sūtreṇa samudāya ādiḥ saḥ eva udāttaḥ iti svare pi bheda abhāvāt na ca eka a c dhātu viṣaye svare bhedaḥ yadi api tathā api aneka a c dhātu viṣaye svara bhedaḥ bhavati eva atra sūtre nirdiṣṭaḥ tatas vuñi asūyaka śabde samudāya ādiḥ udāttaḥ

original: ṇvuli tu pratyayātpūrvaḥ sakārottara ūkāra udātta iti svare bhedo'stīti tadarthaṃ sūtramiti vācyam | tarhi "asūyo vuñ' ityeva sūtramastu nindādigrahaṇasya vyarthatvādityā śaṅkya vacanaviśeṣajñāpakatayā sārthakyamāha--nindādibhya iti | ayamarthaḥ--nindādighahaṇābhāve nindaka ityādirūpaṃ na sidhyati |
analyzed: ṇvuli tu pratyayāt pūrvaḥ sakāra uttaraḥ ūkāraḥ udāttaḥ iti svare bhedaḥ asti iti tad artham sūtram iti vācyam tarhi asūyaḥ iti eva sūtram astu nindā ādi grahaṇasya vyartha tvāt iti ā śaṅkya vacana viśeṣa jñāpaka tayā sārthakyam āha nindā ādibhyaḥ iti ayam arthaḥ nindā ādi ghahaṇa abhāve nindakaḥ ityādi rūpam na sidhyati

original: na ca vāsarūpanyoyena tṛnaḥ vikalpena ṇvulbādhakatvāt pakṣe ṇvul sidhyatīti vācyam | tarhi tata eveṣṭasiddheḥ nindādigrahaṇaṃ vyarthaṃ sat tacchīlādiṣvartheṣu vāsarūpanyāyo na pravartata iti jñāpayatīti tṛnā nityaṃ ṇvulo bādhā syāt | tathā ca nindaka ityasya rūpasya siddhyarthaṃ vuñasūtre nindādigrahaṇamiti svāṃśe cāritārthyam |
analyzed: na ca vikalpena ṇvul bādhaka tvāt pakṣe ṇvul sidhyati iti vācyam tarhi tatas eva iṣṭa siddheḥ nindā ādi grahaṇam vyartham sat tad śīla ādiṣu artheṣu vāsa rūpa nyāyaḥ na pravartate iti jñāpayati iti tṛnā nityam ṇvulaḥ bādhā syāt tathā ca nindakaḥ iti asya rūpasya siddhi artham vuña sūtre nindā ādi grahaṇam iti sva aṃśe cāritārthyam

original: anyatra prayojanaṃ tācchīlikaprakāraṇavihitapratyayaviṣaye sāmānyasūtraṃ na pravartata iti | vāsarūpanyāyena prāptāstṛjādayaḥ tācchīlikeṣu na bhavantītyanvayaḥ | jhrjñā.ṭa jucaṅkramya (sū.3-2-250)|| atra padagrahaṇāt jñāpakāt tācchīlikāstācchīlikeṣu vāsarupeṇa na bhavanti | "sūdadīpe' tyatra dīpagrahaṇāt jñāpakāt bhavati yuco reṇa samāveśaḥ |
analyzed: anyatra prayojanam tācchīlika prakāraṇa vihita pratyaya viṣaye sāmānya sūtram na pravartate iti vāsa rūpa nyāyena prāptāḥ tṛc ādayaḥ tācchīlikeṣu na bhavanti iti anvayaḥ atra pada grahaṇāt jñāpakāt tācchīlikāḥ tācchīlikeṣu vāsa rupeṇa na bhavanti sūda dīpe dīpa grahaṇāt jñāpakāt bhavati samāveśaḥ

original: jhrvi.ṭa nanu "jucaṅkramyadandramyasṛgṛdhijvalaśucalaṣapatapadaḥ' iti sūtreṇa juprabhṛtibhyo dhātubhyaḥ tacchīlādiṣu kartṛṣu "yuc' pratyayo vidhīyate | tatra padadhātorgrahaṇamanarthakam | tasya anudāttettvena halāditvena ca "anudāttetaśca halodeḥ'(sū.3-2-149) iti sāmānyasūtreṇaiva yucpratyayasiddheḥ |
analyzed: nanu iti sūtreṇa ju prabhṛtibhyaḥ dhātubhyaḥ tad śīla ādiṣu kartṛṣu yuc pratyayaḥ vidhīyate tatra pada dhātoḥ grahaṇam anarthakam tasya anudātta i t tvena ha l ādi tvena ca anudātta itaḥ ca iti sāmānya sūtreṇa eva yuc pratyaya siddheḥ

original: na ca "laṣapatapadasthābhūvṛṣahanakamagamaśṝbhya ukañ'(sū.3-2-154) iti viśeṣavihitena ukañā sāmānyavihitasya yuco bādhe prāpte ukañā saha samāveśasiddhyarthaṃ padeḥ atra yucsūtre grahaṇamiti vācyam | vāsarūpanyayona asarūpasya ukañaḥ vikalpena yucbādhakatvātpakṣe yuco'pi siddheḥ ityāśaṅkya jñāpanārtha padagrahaṇamityāha--atra padagrahaṇāditi |
analyzed: na ca laṣa pata pada sthā bhū vṛṣa hana kama gama śṝbhyaḥ ukañ sū iti viśeṣa vihitena ukañā sāmānya vihitasya yucaḥ bādhe prāpte ukañā saha samāveśa siddhi artham padeḥ atra yuc sūtre grahaṇam iti vācyam a sarūpasya ukañaḥ vikalpena yuc bādhaka tvāt pakṣe siddheḥ iti āśaṅkya jñāpana artha pada grahaṇam iti āha atra pada grahaṇāt iti

original: pūrvoktarītyā vyarthaṃ sat padagrahaṇamevaṃ jñāpayati yat tācchīlikeṣvapavādavidhiṣu tācchīlikā utsargavidhayaḥ vāsarūpanyāyena prasaktāḥ pratiṣiddhā bhavantīti | itthaṃ ca ukañā yucaḥ bādhāt yuco'pi siddhyarthaṃ padagrahaṇaṃ sārthakamiti bhāvaḥ | nanu yadyevaṃ jñāpyate tarhi "sūdadīpadīkṣaśva'(sū.3-2-153) iti sūtre dīpigrahaṇaṃ vyartham |
analyzed: pūrva ukta rītyā vyartham sat pada grahaṇam evam jñāpayati yat tācchīlikeṣu apavāda vidhiṣu tācchīlikāḥ utsarga vidhayaḥ vāsarūpa nyāyena prasaktāḥ pratiṣiddhāḥ bhavanti iti ittham ca ukañā bādhāt siddhi artham pada grahaṇam sārthakam iti bhāvaḥ nanu yadi evam jñāpyate tarhi iti sūtre dīpi grahaṇam vyartham

original: tena hi sūtreṇa dīperthuc niṣidhyate | yucca "anudāttetaśca halādeḥ' (sū 3-2-149) iti sūtreṇa prāptaḥ | tasya "namikampiramyajasakamahiṃsadīpo raḥ '(3-2-167) iti sūtravihito rapratyayaḥ apavādaḥ |
analyzed: tena hi sūtreṇa niṣidhyate yut ca anudātta itaḥ ca ha l ādeḥ sū 32149 iti sūtreṇa prāptaḥ tasya nami kampi ramya jasa kama hiṃsa dīpaḥ raḥ 32167 iti sūtra vihitaḥ ra pratyayaḥ apavādaḥ

original: ubhayorapi tācchīlikatvāt tācchīlikāpavādarapratyayaviṣaye tācchīlikasyotsargasya yucaḥ uktajñāpakamahimnā aprāpteḥ tanniṣedhasiddhyarthaṃ "sūdadīpadīkṣaśca' iti sūtre tīpighahaṇamanarthakamityāśaṅkya, ata eva "yuco reṇa samāveśaḥ' iti vacanajñāpanadvārā tat sārthakam ityāha--sūdadīpetyatreti |
