original: jhrjñā.ṭa ajādya (sū.4-1-4)|| "śūdrā cāmahatpūrvā' (vā) iti jñāpayati iha tadantavidhiriti | jhrvi.ṭa ṭhaajādyataṣṭāp' iti sūtre "sūdrā cāmahatpūrvā jātiḥ' iti vārtikam | tasya ca śūdrajātiḥ vācyā cet amahatpūrvaḥ śūdraśabdaḥ striyāṃ ṭāpaṃ labhate ityarthaḥ | ajādigaṇe paṭhitasya śūdraśabdasya ṭāp sāmānyataḥ prāptaḥ |
analyzed: śūdrā ca a mahā pūrvā vā iti jñāpayati iha tad anta vidhiḥ iti ṭha aja ādya taḥ ṭāp iti sūtre sūdrā ca a mahā pūrvā jātiḥ iti vārtikam tasya ca śūdra jātiḥ vācyā ced a mahā pūrvaḥ śūdra śabdaḥ striyām ṭāpam labhate iti arthaḥ aja ādi gaṇe paṭhitasya śūdra śabdasya ṭāp sāmānyatas prāptaḥ

original: tatra jātivācakatvaṃ mahacchabdapūrvakatvābhāvaśceti viśeṣaṇadvalayaṃ yadyasti śūdraśabdasya tadaiva ṭāp iti vyavakthā vārtikakṛtā kṛtā bhavati | tatra amahatpūrvā iti viśeṣaṇaṃ vyartham | mahāśūdraśabdasya ajādigaṇe pāṭhābhāvādeva ṭāpo'prasakteḥ | na ca śūdraśabdo'jādiṣu paṭhyate | tena ca tadantavidhinā mahāsūdraśabdo'pi gṛhyeteti vācyam |
analyzed: tatra jāti vācaka tvam mahat śabda pūrvakatva abhāvaḥ ca iti yadi asti śūdra śabdasya tadā eva ṭāp iti vyavakthā vārtika kṛtā kṛtā bhavati tatra a mahā pūrvāḥ iti viśeṣaṇam vyartham mahāśūdra śabdasya aja ādi gaṇe pāṭha abhāvāt eva na ca śūdra śabdaḥ ūja ādiṣu paṭhyate tena ca tad anta vidhinā mahāsūdra śabdaḥ api gṛhyeta iti vācyam

original: grahaṇavatā prātipadikena tadantavidhaḥ mahāśūdraśabdo'pi gṛhyeteti vācyam | grahaṇavatā prātipadikena tadantavidheḥ pratiṣedhāt ityāśaṅkya strīpratyayeṣu tadantavidhirastīti jñāpanārthaṃ tadityāha--śūdrā ceti | tathā ca tadantavidhinā śūdraśabdenamahāśūdrabdo'pi gṛhyeteti tadhdyāvṛttyarthamamahatpūrvagrahaṇam |
analyzed: grahaṇavatā prātipadikena tad anta vidhaḥ mahāśūdra śabdaḥ api gṛhyeta iti vācyam grahaṇavatā prātipadikena tad anta vidheḥ pratiṣedhāt iti āśaṅkya strī pratyayeṣu tad anta vidhiḥ asti iti jñāpana artham tat iti āha śūdrā ca iti tathā ca tad anta vidhinā śūdra śabdena mahāśūdra śabdaḥ api gṛhyeta iti tat hi āvṛtti artham amahat pūrva grahaṇam

original: jñāpanaprayojanaṃ tu "bhavatī' ityatra ugidantāt bhavacchabdāt yathā "ugitaśca' (sū.4-1-6) iti ṅīp tathā tadantavidhinā ugidantāt atibhavacchabdādapi ṅīp bhavatīti atibhavatīti rūpasiddhiḥ iti bhāvaḥ | iheti | strīpratyayaprakaraṇa ityarthaḥ |
analyzed: jñāpana prayojanam tu bhavatī iti atra u g it antāt bhavat śabdāt yathā u gitaḥ ca iti ṅīp tathā tad anta vidhinā u g it antāt atibhavat śabdāt api ṅīp bhavati iti atibhavati iti rūpa siddhiḥ iti bhāvaḥ iha iti strīpratyaya prakaraṇe iti arthaḥ

original: jhrjñā.ṭa ṭiḍḍḍatdh;ḍhāṇañ (sū.4-1-15) vāmadevāḍḍḍatdh;ḍaḍḍatdh;yaḍḍḍatdh;ḍaḍḍatdh;yau (sū.4-2-9) iti ḍiḍḍatdh;ttvam "ananubandhakagrahaṇe na sānubandhakagrahaṇam' "tadanubandhakagrahaṇe atadanubandhakagrahaṇaṃ na' iti paribhāṣayoḥ jñāpakam | jhrjñā.ṭa prāgdīvyato'ṇ (sū.4-1-83)| ayameva vikṛtanirdeśo jñāpayati--"ekadeśavikṛtamananyava" diti |
analyzed: jhrjñāṭa ṭ iṭ ḍat dh ḍha aṇ añ sū 4115 sū 429 iti ḍiṭ ḍat t tvam an anubandhaka grahaṇe na sa anubandhaka grahaṇam tad anubandhaka grahaṇe a tad anubandhaka grahaṇam na iti paribhāṣayoḥ jñāpakam jhrjñāṭa prāk dīvyataḥ ṭ sū 4183 ayam eva vikṛta nirdeśaḥ jñāpayati eka deśa vikṛtam ananya vat iti

original: jhrjñā.ṭa ṭhapīlāyā vā' (sū.4-1-118) iti vāgrahaṇaṃ jñāpakaṃ "nāpavādaviṣye'ṇ bhavati' iti | jhrvi.ṭa ṭhaprāgdīvyato'ṇa' (sū.4-1-83) iti sūtre kiṃ prāgdīvyato yāḥ prakṛtayaḥ tābhyaḥ aṇ iti vivakṣitam, āhosvit prāgdīvyato ye'rthāsteṣvaṇ iti vivakṣitam | ādyapakṣe apavādabhūta - iñādiviṣayepyaṇprasaṅgaḥ |
analyzed: vā sū41118 iti vā grahaṇam jñāpakam bhavati iti sū4183 iti sūtre kim prāk dīvyataḥ yāḥ prakṛtayaḥ tābhyaḥ aṇ iti vivakṣitam āhosvit prāk dīvyataḥ yāḥ ṛthāḥ teṣu aṇ iti vivakṣitam ādya pakṣe apavāda bhūtaḥ iñ ādi viṣaye pi aṇ prasaṅgaḥ

original: dvayorekaviṣayatvena vikalpa eva syānnabādhyabādhakabhāva iti | dvitīyapakṣe artheṣvidamaṇvidhānamiti prakṛtyantare sāvakāśo'ṇpratyayaḥ ekasminnarthe prakṛtiviśeṣādutpadyamāneneñādinā bādhyeteti na doṣo bhavati | tatra prathamapakṣe'pi doṣo nāstīti sādhayitumāha--pīlāyā veti vāgrahaṇamiti |
analyzed: dvayoḥ eka viṣaya tvena vikalpaḥ eva syāt na bādhya bādhaka bhāvaḥ iti dvitīya pakṣe artheṣu idam aṇu vidhānam iti prakṛti antare sa avakāśa uṇ pratyayaḥ ekasmin arthe prakṛti viśeṣāt utpadyamānena iñ ādinā bādhyeta iti na doṣaḥ bhavati tatra prathama pakṣe api doṣaḥ na asti iti sādhayitum āha pīlāyāḥ vā iti vā grahaṇam iti

original: yadyapavādaviṣaye'pyaṇ bhavet, tarhi "pīlayā vā' iti sūtre vāgrahaṇamanarthakam | pīlāśabdāt apatyārthe "dvyacaḥ' (sū.4-1-121) iti aṇapavāde ḍhaki prāpte tadapavādatayā punaraṇ vikalpena vidhīyate "pīlāyā vā' iti sūtreṇa |
analyzed: yadi apavāda viṣaye api aṇ bhavet tarhi pīlayā vā iti sūtre vā grahaṇam anarthakam pīlā śabdāt apatya arthe dvi a caḥ sū 41121 iti aṇ apavāde ḍhaki prāpte tad apavāda tayā punar aṇ vikalpena vidhīyate pīlāyāḥ vā iti sūtreṇa

original: yadyapavādaviṣayeṣvapyaṇ syāt vāgrahaṇaṃ athavā etatsūtramapyantareṇa aṇḍhakoḥ vikalpena samāveśasiddhyā sūtraṃ vyarthaṃ bhavediti apavādaviṣaye aṇ na bhavatīti jñāpyate | ataḥ iñādiviṣaye aṇo na prasaktiriti bhāvaḥ | jhrjñā.ṭa prāk ṭhakaḥ iti vaktavye "prāgdīvyataḥ' (sū.4-1-83) ityuktirjñāpayati artheṣvayamiti |
analyzed: yadi apavāda viṣayeṣu api aṇ syāt vā grahaṇam athavā etat sūtram api antareṇa vikalpena samāveśa siddhyā sūtram vyartham bhavet iti apavāda viṣaye aṇ na bhavati iti jñāpyate atas iñ ādi viṣaye aṇaḥ na prasaktiḥ iti bhāvaḥ prāk ṭhakaḥ iti vaktavye prāk dīvyataḥ iti uktiḥ jñāpayati artheṣu ayam iti

original: jhrvi.ṭa nanu "prāgdīvyataḥ' ityasya sthāne "prākṭhakaḥ' ityeva lāghavāt kuto noktam | ṭhakśabdena ca "prāgvahateṣṭhak' (sū.4-4-1) iti sūtraṃ parāmṛśyate ityāśaṅkya--prāgdīvyato ye'rthāḥ teṣvaṇ bhavatīti jñāpanārthaṃ prāgdīvyata ityuktam | tena "prāgdīvyataḥ' (sū.4-4-2) iti sūtrapūrvabhāviṭhagarthe'pyaṇ bhavatīti labhyate |
analyzed: nanu prāk dīvyataḥ iti asya sthāne prāk ṭhakaḥ iti eva lāghavāt kutas na uktam ṭhak śabdena ca sū iti sūtram parāmṛśyate iti āśaṅkya prāk dīvyataḥ ye ṛthāḥ teṣu aṇ bhavati iti jñāpana artham prāk dīvyataḥ iti uktam tena prāk dīvyataḥ sū iti sūtra pūrva bhāvi ṭhak arthe ipi aṇ bhavati iti labhyate

original: tatra ca prāk ṭhaka ityukte ṭhagviṣaye aṇ na prāpnuyāditi prāgdīvyata ityuktiścaritārthā | evaṃ jñāpanasya prayojanaṃ tu samāne'rthe ekasyāḥ prakṛterdvayoḥ aṇañpratyayoḥ prasaktau prakṛtyantare sāvakāśasyāṇaḥ iñ bādhaka iti
analyzed: tatra ca prāk ṭhakaḥ iti ukte ṭhak viṣaye aṇ na prāpnuyāt iti prāk dīvyataḥ iti uktiḥ caritārthā evam jñāpanasya prayojanam tu samāna īrthe ekasyāḥ prakṛteḥ dvayoḥ a ṇ añ pratyayoḥ prasaktau prakṛti antare sa avakāśasya aṇaḥ iñ bādhakaḥ iti

original: bādhyabādhakabhāvo nirṇīto bhavatīti ityāśayavānāha--prāk ṭhaka iti vaktavya iti | ayamiti | aṇityarthaḥ | jhrjñā.ṭa yūni luk (sū.4-1-90)|| "gotrokṣoṣṭra' (sū.4-2-39) iti vuñūvidhau rājanyamanuṣyagrahaṇaṃ jñāpakaṃ laukikaṃ paraṃ gotramiti | yuvā ca loke gotramityupacaryate | kiṃ gotro'si māṇavaka ! gārgyāyaṇaḥ |
analyzed: bādhya bādhaka bhāvaḥ nirṇītaḥ bhavati iti iti āśayavān āha prāk ṭhakaḥ iti vaktavyaḥ iti ayam iti aṇ iti arthaḥ yūni luk sū gotra ukṣa uṣṭra sū iti vuñ ū vidhau rājanya manuṣya grahaṇam jñāpakam laukikam param gotram iti yuvā ca loke gotram iti upacaryate kim māṇavaka gārgyāyaṇaḥ

original: jhrvi.ṭa ṭhayūni luk' iti sūtrasya prāgdīvyatīye'jādau pratyaye vivakṣite yuvapratyayasya lugbhavati, tasminnivṛtte sati yo yataḥ prāpnoti sa tato bhavatītyarthaḥ | tasya prayojanaparigaṇanavelāyāṃ "iñṇyau sarvatra' iti vārtiṃkaṃ pravṛttam | iñaḥ udāharaṇam aupagavīyāḥ ita |
analyzed: ṭha yūni luk iti sūtrasya prāk dīvyatīya ic ādau pratyaye vivakṣite yuva pratyayasya luk bhavati tasmin nivṛtte sati yaḥ yatas prāpnoti sa tatas bhavati iti arthaḥ tasya prayojana parigaṇana velāyām iñ ṇyau sarvatra iti vārtiṃkam pravṛttam iñaḥ udāharaṇam aupagavīyāḥ ita ita ita ita ita ita ita ita ita ita ita ita ita ita ita ita ita ita ita ita ita ita ita ita ita ita ita ita ita ita ita ita ita ita ita ita ita ita ita ita ita ita ita ita ita ita ita ita ita ita ita i

original: atra upagorapatyamityaṇ aupagavaḥ, tataḥ yuvāpatye iñi aupagaviḥ, tataḥ chapratyaye vivakṣite ādau iñaḥ yuvapratyayasya luk, tasmin lupte chapratyayaḥ aupagavīyāḥ iti sidhyati |
analyzed: atra upagoḥ apatyam iti aṇ aupagavaḥ tatas yuva apatye iñi aupagaviḥ tatas cha pratyaye vivakṣite ādau iñaḥ yuva pratyayasya luc tasmin lupte cha pratyayaḥ aupagavīyāḥ iti sidhyati

original: atra lukaḥ kiṃ prayojanam ? iñyalupte'pi vṛddhalakṣaṇe che aupagavīyā iti rūpasiddherityāśaṅkāyāṃ bhāṣyakāreṇa--"vṛddhavadatideśe sati iño gotra ityaṇ prāpnoti' iti proktam | tasyāyamarthaḥ---"prāgdīvyato'dhikāre yūno vṛddhavadatideśaḥ' iti vārtikena yuvapratyayasya gotravatkāryātideśāt iño lugabhāve "iño gotre'(sū.4-2-112) ityaṇ prapnuyāt |
analyzed: atra lukaḥ kim prayojanam vṛddha lakṣaṇe che aupagavīyāḥ iti rūpa siddheḥ iti āśaṅkāyām bhāṣyakāreṇa vṛddha vat atideśe sati iñaḥ gotre iti aṇ prāpnoti iti proktam tasya ayam arthaḥ prāk dīvyataḥ adhikāre yūnaḥ vṛddha vat atideśaḥ iti vārtikena yuva pratyayasya gotra vat kārya atideśāt iñaḥ luk abhāve iñaḥ iti aṇ prapnuyāt

original: asmābhistu chapratyaya iṣyate | ataḥ iño lugvaktavyaḥ iti | tadupari "naiṣa doṣaḥ, pratyākhyāyate'sāvatideśaḥ ' iti bhāṣyam | tathā ca yūno gotravadatideśābāvāt iñaḥ lugabhāve'pi "iño gotre' ityaṇ na bhaviṣyati, api tu vṛddhalakṣaṇaścha eva bhaviṣyatītīṣṭasiddheḥ "yūni luk' iti lukaḥ aupagavīyā ityetadudāharaṇaṃ na bhavitumarhatīti bhāṣyāśayaḥ |
analyzed: asmābhiḥ tu cha pratyayaḥ iṣyate atas iñaḥ luc vaktavyaḥ iti tad upari na eṣa doṣaḥ pratyākhyāyate saḥ atideśaḥ iti bhāṣyam tathā ca yūnaḥ gotra vat atideśa abāvāt iñaḥ luc abhāve pi iñaḥ gotre iti aṇ na bhaviṣyati api tu vṛddha lakṣaṇaḥ chaḥ eva bhaviṣyati iti iṣṭa siddheḥ yūni luc iti lukaḥ aupagavīyāḥ iti etat udāharaṇam na bhavitum arhati iti bhāṣya āśayaḥ

original: tataḥ yadi yūno vṛddhavadatideśaḥ (gotravadatideśaḥ) pratyākhyāyate tadā gotravadatideśasya yāni prayojanānyuktāni teṣāṃ kaṃtha siddhiḥ iti śaṅkāyāṃ--"tāni jñāpakena siddhāni' iti bhāṣyakṛtā abhihitam |
analyzed: tatas yadi yūnaḥ vṛddha vat atideśaḥ gotra vat atideśaḥ pratyākhyāyate tadā gotra vat atideśasya yāni prayojanāni uktāni teṣām siddhiḥ iti śaṅkāyām tāni jñāpakena siddhāni iti bhāṣyakṛtā abhihitam

original: ayamatrāśayaḥ--gārgyāṇānāṃ samūhaḥ gārgyāyaṇakam, gārgyāyaṇakānāṃ kiṃcidgārgyāyaṇakam, gārgyāyaṇo bhaktirasya gārgyāyaṇakaḥ, gotraśrayo vuñ yathā syāditi yūno vṛddhavadatideśasya prayojanānyuktāni | tatra prathame udāharaṇe gargasyāpatyaṃ gotraṃ gārgyaḥ gargādibhyo yañ | gārgyāsyāpatyaṃ yuvā gārgyāyaṇaḥ "yañiñośca' (sū.4-1-101)iti phak |
analyzed: ayam atra āśayaḥ gārgyāṇānām samūhaḥ gārgyāyaṇakam gārgyāyaṇakānām kiṃcid gārgyāyaṇakam gārgyāyaṇaḥ bhaktiḥ asya gārgyāyaṇakaḥ gotra śrayaḥ yathā syāt iti yūnaḥ vṛddha vat atideśasya prayojanāni uktāni tatra prathame udāharaṇe gargasya apatyam gotram gārgyaḥ garga ādibhyaḥ yañ gārgya asya apatyam yuvā gārgyāyaṇaḥ yañ iñoḥ ca sū 41101 iti phak

original: tataḥ samūhārthe "gotrokṣoṣṭrorabhra' (sū.4-1-39) iti vuñ, gārgyāṇakam iti rūpaṃ bhavati | atra phakaḥ yuvapratyayasya gotravadbhāve satyeva tataḥ "gotrokṣoṣṭrorabhra' iti sūtreṇa samūhorthe vṛñ bhavet iti | etacca atideśasya prayojanaṃ jñāpakena sādhayitvā atideśaḥ pratyākhyātaḥ |
analyzed: tatas samūha arthe gotra ukṣa uṣṭraḥ abhra iti gārgyāṇakam iti rūpam bhavati atra yuvapratyayasya gotravat bhāve sati eva tatas gotra ukṣa uṣṭraḥ abhraḥ iti sūtreṇa samūha arthe bhavet iti etat ca atideśasya prayojanam jñāpakena sādhayitvā atideśaḥ pratyākhyātaḥ

original: tathā hi--"gotrokṣoṣṭrorabhrarājarājanyarājaputravatsamanuṣyājādvuñ' (4-2-39) iti sūtre rājanyamanuṣyaśabdau śāstrīyagotrābhidhāyinau | "rājaśvaśurādyat' (sū.4-1-161) iti sūtreṇa yatpratyaye manuṣyaśabdaḥ sidhyati | tatra "gotrokṣoṣṭro' iti sūtre gotragrahaṇenaiva rājanyamanuṣyābhyāṃ vuñaḥ siddheḥ kiṃ pṛthak rājanyamanuṣyagrahaṇena |
analyzed: tathā hi gotra ukṣa uṣṭra urabhra rāja rājanya rājaputra vatsa manuṣya a jāt vuñ iti sūtre rājanya manuṣya śabdau śāstrīya gotra abhidhāyinau rāja śvaśurāt yat sū 41161 iti sūtreṇa yat pratyaye manuṣya śabdaḥ sidhyati tatra gotra ukṣa uṣṭraḥ iti sūtre gotra grahaṇena eva rājanya manuṣyābhyām vuñaḥ siddheḥ kim pṛthak rājanya manuṣya grahaṇena

original: gṛhītau tu jñāpayataḥ apatyadhikārāduttaraṃ gotragrahaṇaṃ laukikagotraparamiti | laukikaṃ ca gotramapatyamātram | kiṃgotro'si māṇavaka! gārgyāyaṇa ityādau yuvāpatye'pi gotraśabdasya loke prayogāt |
analyzed: gṛhītau tu jñāpayataḥ apati adhikārāt uttaram gotra grahaṇam laukika gotra param iti laukikam ca gotram apatya mātram kiṃgotraḥ asi māṇavaka gārgyāyaṇaḥ ityādau yuva apatye api gotra śabdasya loke prayogāt

original: rājanyamanuṣyaśabdau ca laukike prayoge jātiviśeṣavācinau laukikagotrābhidhāyinau na bhavata iti gotragrahaṇena grahītumaśakyatvāt tayoḥ pṛthaggrahaṇam |
analyzed: rājanya manuṣya śabdau ca laukike prayoge jāti viśeṣa vācinau laukika gotra abhidhāyinau na bhavataḥ iti gotra grahaṇena grahītum aśakya tvāt tayoḥ pṛthak grahaṇam

original: itthaṃ ca gārgyāyaṇaśabdasya yuvāpatyārthakaphakpratyayāntasyāpi laukikagotrārthakatvāt gotravadbhāvātideśaṃvināpi gotragrahaṇena grahaṇāt tataḥ samūhārthe "gotrokṣo' iti sūtreṇa vuñaḥ siddhatvāt atideśaḥ pratyākhyāyata iti | tadetat sarvaṃ manasikṛtyāha--iti vuñvidhāvityādinā | paramiti | apatyādhikārāduttaramityarthaḥ |
analyzed: ittham ca gārgyāyaṇa śabdasya yuva apatya arthaka phak pratyaya antasya api laukika gotra arthaka tvāt gotravat bhāva atideśam vinā api gotra grahaṇena grahaṇāt tatas samūha arthe iti sūtreṇa vuñaḥ siddha tvāt atideśaḥ pratyākhyāyate iti tat etat sarvam manasikṛtya āha eti vuñ vidhau ityādinā param iti apatya adhikārāt uttaram iti arthaḥ

original: jhrjñā.ṭa anṛṣyānantarye (sū.4-1-104)|| ṛṣāvanantare

original: atra pūrvāḍhaddhaṭhṭhaḍaṇāparāḍhaddhaṭhṭhaḍaṇābhyāṃ saptamīśravaṇārthaṃ tayoḥ sūbantatvaṃ vaktavyamiti vārtikakāraḥ akathayat | tasya ca"ṅyāpprātipadikāt' (sū.4-1-1) ityadhikārāt prātipādikādeva taddhita ityāśayaḥ | bhāṣyakārastu subantāt taddhitotpattiṃ jñāpakena prasādhya vārtikaṃ pratyācakhyau | tadāha--ghakālataneṣviti |

original: "dhakālataneṣu kālanāmnaḥ' (sū.6-3-17) iti sūtreṣakālavācakaśabdāt parasyāḥ saptamyāḥ ghakālaneṣu parataḥ alugvacanāt sūbantāt taddhitotpattiriti jñāpyate | kathamanyathā saptamyā evābhāvāt lukaḥ aluko vā prasaktiḥ iti bhāvaḥ | nanu na jñāpakasādhyametat |
analyzed: iti sūtra iṣa kāla vācaka śabdāt parasyāḥ saptamyāḥ paratas a luk vacanāt sūpa antāt taddhita utpattiḥ iti jñāpyate katham anyathā saptamyāḥ eva abhāvāt lukaḥ vā prasaktiḥ iti bhāvaḥ nanu na jñāpaka sādhyam etat

original: "samarthānāṃ prathamā' dityadhikāre taddhitavidhānāt "kiṃ punaḥ samartham arthābhidhāne yacchaktaṃ kṛtavarṇānupūrvīkaṃ padam ' iti samarthasūtre bhāṣyoktyā sūbantapadādeva taddhitotpattilābhādityatrāha--yadyapīti | tathāpītyādi | ṅyāpprātipadikādityapyanuvartate taddhitaprakaraṇe | atastadanuguṇatayā samarthaśabdārtho vaktavyaḥ |
analyzed: samarthānām prathamā t iti adhikāre taddhita vidhānāt kim punar samartham artha abhidhāne yat śaktam kṛta varṇa ānupūrvīkam padam iti samartha sūtre bhāṣya uktyā sūp anta padāt eva taddhita utpatti lābhāt iti atra āha yadi api iti tathā api ityādi ṅī āp prātipadikāt iti api anuvartate taddhita prakaraṇe atas tad anuguṇa tayā samartha śabda arthaḥ vaktavyaḥ

original: sa ca yatad supi sati arthabodhe śaktaṃ tatsamarthamiti | tathā ca supi sati arkhabodhe śaktāt prathamāt prātipadikāt taddhita ityarthaḥ |
analyzed: sa ca yatat supi sati artha bodhe śaktam tat samartham iti tathā ca supi sati arkha bodhe śaktāt prathamāt prātipadikāt taddhitaḥ iti arthaḥ

original: tataśca prātipadikābhyāṃ pūrvāḍhaddhaṭhṭhaḍaṇāparāḍhaddhaṭhṭhaḍaṇābhyāṃ ṭyuṭyuloḥ satoḥ saptamīśravaṇaṃ na syāditi pūrvoktajñāpakamahimnā subantāt taddhitotpattiṃ prasādhya "ghakālataneṣu' ityanena alukā saptamīśravaṇaṃ samarthanīyamiti bhāvaḥ | jhrjñā.ṭa tasya vyākhyāna (sū.4-3-66)|| vyākhyānaṃ śabdagranthaviṣaya eva prasiddhamiti bhāṣye |

original: jhrvi.ṭa nanu "tasya vyākhyāna iti ca vyākhyātavyanāmnaḥ' iti sūtreṇa vyākhyātavyavācinaḥ ṣaṣṭhayantāt vyākhyāne'bhidheye yathāprāptaṃ taddhito bhavatīti kathanāt supāṃ vyākhyānaḥ saupo grantha ityādāviva pāṭaliputrasya vyākhyānī sukosalā ityādāvapi taddhitaḥ syāt |yādṛśaḥ sukośalāyāṃ prākāradisanniveśaḥ tādṛśaḥ pāṭaliputre ityevaṃ pāṭaliputraṃ
analyzed: nanu tasya vyākhyāne iti ca vyākhyātavya nāmnaḥ iti sūtreṇa vyākhyātavya vācinaḥ ṣaṣṭhay antāt vyākhyāna ibhidheye yathāprāptam taddhitaḥ bhavati iti kathanāt supām vyākhyānaḥ saupaḥ granthaḥ ityādau iva pāṭaliputrasya vyākhyānī sukosalāḥ ityādau api taddhitaḥ syāt yādṛśaḥ sukośalāyām prākāra di sanniveśaḥ tādṛśaḥ pāṭaliputre iti evam pāṭaliputram

original: sukosalayā vyākhyāyata iti sūtrapravṛttiyogyatāyāḥ saddhāvādityāśaṅkya, vyākhyātavyanāmna ityatra nāmagrahaṇāt vyākhyātavyatvena prasiddhasya śabdātmakasya granthasya yannāma tata eva taddhatiḥ ato noktadoṣa ityāśayavānāha--vyākhyānaṃ śabdagranthaviṣaya eveti | śabdātmako yo granthaḥ tadviṣaya evetyarthaḥ |
analyzed: sukosalayā vyākhyāyate iti sūtra pravṛtti yogyatāyāḥ saddhāvāt iti āśaṅkya vyākhyātavya nāmnaḥ iti atra nāma grahaṇāt vyākhyātavya tvena prasiddhasya śabda ātmakasya granthasya yat nāma tatas eva tad hatiḥ atas na ukta doṣaḥ iti āśayavān āha vyākhyānam śabda grantha viṣayaḥ eva iti śabda ātmakaḥ yaḥ granthaḥ tad viṣayaḥ eva iti arthaḥ

original: evakāreṇa aśabdātmakapāṭaliputrādeḥ vyavacchedaḥ | jhrjñā.ṭa

original: jhrjñā.ṭa anudāttādeśca (sū.4-3-140)|| bhikṣādiṣu garbhiṇīśabdapāṭho jñāpayati yāvatyeva dvitīyasvarasya prādurbhāvastāvatyeva pūrvanidhātaḥ (pratīkṣeta) jhrpravartetaṭa tarhi garbhaśabdādādyudāttādini tato ṅīpi tadantādaṇeva prāpnoti nānudāttalakṣaṇo'ñiti taddhaiyarthyaṃ spaṣṭameva | padagrahaṇaṃ parimāṇārtham vākyasya mā bhūditi |
analyzed: anudātta ādeḥ ca sū 43140 bhikṣā ādiṣu garbhiṇī śabda pāṭhaḥ jñāpayati yāvatī eva dvitīya svarasya prādurbhāvaḥ tāvatī eva pūrva nidhātaḥ pratīkṣeta tarhi garbha śabdāt ādi udātta ādini tatas ṅīpi tad antāt aṇ iva prāpnoti na anudātta lakṣaṇa uñ iti tat haiyarthyam spaṣṭam eva pada grahaṇam parimāṇa artham vākyasya mā bhūt iti

original: jhrvi.ṭa ṭhaanudāttādeśca' iti sutrasya anudāttādeḥ prātipadikāt vikārāvayavayorarthayorañpratyayo bhavatītyarthaḥ | dādhitthaṃ kāpitthamityādikamudāharaṇam | tatra ca sūtre "anudāttāderaño vidhāne ādyudāttānṅīṣa upasaṃkhyānam ' iti vārtikam | tasya cāyamarthaḥ--ādyudāttaprakṛtikaṅīṣantādapyañ bhavati vikārāvayavayorarthayoriti vaktavyamiti |
analyzed: iti sutrasya anudātta ādeḥ ca iti sutrasya anudātta ādeḥ prātipadikāt vikāra avayavayoḥ arthayoḥ añ pratyayaḥ bhavati iti arthaḥ dādhittham kāpittham iti ādikam udāharaṇam tatra ca sūtre anudātta ādeḥ añaḥ vidhāne ādi udāttāt ṅīṣaḥ upasaṃkhyānam iti vārtikam tasya ca ayam arthaḥ ādi udātta prakṛtika ṅīṣ antāt api añ bhavati vikāra avayavayoḥ arthayoḥ iti vaktavyam iti

original: kuvalyā vikāraḥ kauvalamityudāharaṇam, kuvalaśabdo "grāmādīnāṃ ca' (phiṭsūtra) ityādyudāttaḥ tataḥ gaurāditvānṅīṣ | tataḥ vikāre añ | nanu ādyudāttātkuvalaśabdānṅīṣi ṅīṣaḥ pratyayasvarema udāttatbe śeṣanighātena kuvalīśabdasyānudāttatvaṃ vartata iti sūtreṇaivātra añaḥ siddheḥ vārtikasya kā āvasyakateti cenna |
analyzed: kuvalyāḥ vikāraḥ kauvalam iti udāharaṇam kuvala śabdaḥ grāma ādīnām ca phiṭsūtraḥ iti ādi udāttaḥ tatas gauḥ ādi tvāt ṅīṣ tatas vikāre añ nanu ādi udāttāt kuvala śabdāt ṅīṣi ṅīṣaḥ pratyaya svarema udātta tbe śeṣa nighātena kuvalī śabdasya anudātta tvam vartate iti sūtreṇa eva atra añaḥ siddheḥ vārtikasya kā āvasyaka tā iti ced na

original: ṅīṣaḥ udāttatve'pi śeṣanidhātasyātrāpravṛtteḥ | "anudāttaṃ padamekavarjam' (sū.3-1-158) iti hi, atra śeṣasyānudātto vaktavyaḥ | tacca sūtraṃ padaviṣayam | kuvalīśabdaśca na padam, sūbantatvābhāvāt ityāśayāt | tadupari "na vā samarthasyānudāttāditvāt ' iti vārtikam | tasyacāyamarthaḥ--"anudāttādeḥ' ityetat na ṅyāpprātipadikāt ityasya viśeṣaṇam |
analyzed: udātta tve api udātta tve api atra apravṛtteḥ anudāttam padam eka varjam sū 31158 iti hi atra śeṣasya anudāttaḥ vaktavyaḥ tat ca sūtram pada viṣayam kuvalī śabdaḥ ca na padam sūp anta tva abhāvāt iti āśayāt tad upari na vā samarthasya anudātta ādi tvāt iti vārtikam tasya ca ayam arthaḥ anudātta ādeḥ iti etat na ṅī āp prātipadikāt iti asya viśeṣaṇam

original: yena kuvalīśabdasya ṅyantasya pūrvektarītyā anudāttāditvaṃ nāstīti kathaṃ tataḥ añ syāditi śaṅkāyā avasaro bhavet | apa tu samarthasya viśeṣaṇam | samartha ca subantameva | tataśca anudāttādeḥ subantāt añ iti sūtrārthaḥ | ataḥ kuvalīśabdāt subutpattyanantaraṃ subantādañ |

original: subantasya ca padatvāt "anudāttaṃ padamekavarjam' iti sūtrapravṛttyā īkāra ekaḥ udāttaḥ anyatsarvamanudāttamiti kuvalī ṅas ityasya anudāttāditvāsadbhāvāt tataḥ añi kauvala iti rūpaṃ sidhyati sūtrarītyaiveti | bhāṣyakārastu anudāttāderityetat ṅyāpprātipadikādityasyaiva viśeṣaṇam, na subantādityasya |
analyzed: sup antasya ca pada tvāt anudāttam padam eka varjam iti sūtra pravṛttyā īkāraḥ ekaḥ udāttaḥ anyat sarvam anudāttam iti kuvalī iti asya anudātta ādi tva asadbhāvāt tatas añi kauvalaḥ iti rūpam sidhyati sūtra rītyā eva iti bhāṣyakāraḥ tu anudātta ādeḥ iti etat ṅī āp prātipadikāt ityasya eva viśeṣaṇam na sup antāt ityasya

original: tathā sati vāco vikāraḥ ityatrāpi "sāvekācaḥ' (sū.6-1-186) iti vibhakterudāttatayā sūbantasyānudāttaditvādañ prāpnuyāt | tarhi kuvalī iti ṅyantasya padatvābhāvenaśepanidhātāprāptyā anudāttāditavā bhāvāt kathaṃ tataḥ añ sidhyediti śaṅkāyāṃ evaṃ samādhīyate |
analyzed: tathā sati vācaḥ vikāraḥ iti atra api sau eka a caḥ sū 61186 iti vibhakteḥ udātta tayā sūp antasya anudātta di tvāt añ prāpnuyāt tarhi kuvalī iti ṅī antasya bhāvāt katham tatas añ sidhyet iti śaṅkāyām evam samādhīyate

original: kasmiṃścit śabde yāvatyeva dvitīyasya svarasya prādurbhāvaḥ tāvatyeva pūrvapravṛttasya svarasya sthāne anudātto bhavatītyāśrīyate | kuvalaśabdaḥ "grāmādīnāṃ ca' iti ādyudāttaḥ | tataḥ ṅīṣi īkārasya udāttaḥ | asmin dvitīṃye svare prādurbhūte pūrvasyādyudāttasya nivṛttiḥ anudāttaśca bhavati |

original: tathā ca kuvalīśabdasyānudāttāditvāt sūtreṇaiva añ sidhyati | yāvatyeva dvitīyasya svarasyetyādyāśrayaṇe kiṃ pramāṇamiti ceta-- bhikṣādaṣiu gārbhiṇīśabdapāṭha iti gṛhāṇa | garbhiṇīnāṃ samūha ityarthe
analyzed: tathā ca kuvalī śabdasya anudātta ādi tvāt sūtreṇa eva sidhyati yāvatī eva dvitīyasya svarasya ityādi āśrayaṇe kim pramāṇam iti ceta gārbhiṇī śabda pāṭhaḥ iti gṛhāṇa garbhiṇīnām samūhaḥ iti arthe

original: "anudāttāderañ' (sū.4-2-44) ityañi prāpte tadapavādatayā aṇsiddhyarthaṃ bhikṣādigaṇe (sū.4-2-38) garbhiṇīśabdaḥ paṭhyate | yadi padasya nighātaḥ tarhi tatpāṭho vyarthaḥ | tathā hi harbhaśabdaḥ "artigṝbhyāṃ man' (u.sū. ) ityuṇādisūtreṇa mannantatvāt ādyudāttaḥ | tataḥ in | tataḥ nāntalakṣaṇaḥ ṅīp |
analyzed: anudātta ādeḥ añ sū 4244 iti añi prāpte tad apavāda tayā aṇ siddhi artham bhikṣā ādi gaṇe sū garbhiṇī śabdaḥ paṭhyate yadi padasya nighātaḥ tarhi tad pāṭhaḥ vyarthaḥ tathā hi harbha śabdaḥ man iti uṇādi sūtreṇa man anta tvāt ādi udāttaḥ tatas in tatas na anta lakṣaṇaḥ ṅīp

original: garbhiṇī iti ṅyantasya sūbantatvābhāvena padatvabhāvāt "anudāttaṃ padam ' iti sūtrapravṛttau ādyudāttatvaṃ garbhiṇībhabdasya nāpaitīti "anudāttāderañ' iti sūtrāpravṛttyā kiṃbhikṣādiṣu garbhiṇīśabdasya añbādhanārthapāṭhena | kṛtaśca pāṭhaḥ jñāpayati yāvatyeva dvitīyasya svarasaya prādurbhāvaḥ tadaiva pūrvapravṛttasvaraḥ nighāto bhavatīti |
analyzed: garbhiṇī iti ṅī antasya sūpa anta tva abhāvena pada tva bhāvāt anudāttam padam iti sūtra pravṛttau ādi udātta tvam garbhiṇī bhabdasya na apaiti iti anudātta ādeḥ añ iti sūtra apravṛttyā kiṃbhikṣā ādiṣu garbhiṇī śabdasya kṛtaḥ ca pāṭhaḥ jñāpayati yāvatī eva dvitīyasya prādurbhāvaḥ tadā eva pūrva pravṛtta svaraḥ nighātaḥ bhavati iti

original: tathā ca insvarakāle pūrvapravṛttaḥ ādyudāttaḥ nighāto bhavatīti anudāttāditvalakṣaṇāñprāptau tadbādhanāya garbhiṇīśabdasya bhikṣādigaṇe pāṭhaḥ caritārthaḥ | prayojanaṃ tu kauvalaityādāvañsiddharata pratyapādayat | sarvametanmanasikṛtyāha--bhikṣādiṣviti | yāvatyeveti yadaivetyarthaḥ | tāvatyeveti | tadaivetyarthaḥ | tarhīti | anyathetyarthaḥ |
analyzed: tathā ca in svara kāle pūrva pravṛttaḥ ādi udāttaḥ nighātaḥ bhavati iti anudātta ādi tva lakṣaṇa āñprāptau tad bādhanāya garbhiṇī śabdasya bhikṣā ādi gaṇe pāṭhaḥ caritārthaḥ prayojanam tu pratyapādayat sarvam etat manasi kṛtya āha bhikṣā ādiṣu iti yāvatī eva iti yadā eva iti arthaḥ tāvatī eva iti tadā eva iti arthaḥ tarhi iti anyathā iti arthaḥ

original: anudāttalakṣaṇo'ñiti | "anudāttāderañ' (sū.4-2-44) iti sūtreṇeti śeṣaḥ | tarhi "anudāttaṃ padamekavarjam' (sū.6-1-158) iti sūtre padagrahaṇamanarthakam | subanatpatteḥ pūrvamapi dvitīyasvaraprāptikāle śeṣanidhātasyopapāditatvādityata āha--padagrahaṇamiti | parimāṇārthamiti |
analyzed: anudātta lakṣaṇa uñ iti anudātta ādeḥ añ sū4244 iti sūtreṇa iti śeṣaḥ tarhi anudāttam padam eka varjam sū61158 iti sūtre pada grahaṇam anarthakam pūrvam api dvitīya svara prāpti kāle śeṣa nidhātasya upapādita tvāt iti atas āha pada grahaṇam iti parimāṇa artham iti

original: yasya padatvaṃ bhaviṣyati tasyaiva ekavarjamanudāttaṃ yathā syāt padasamūhasya mā bhūdityetadarthaṃ padagrahaṇamiti bhāvaḥ || iti caturtho'dhyāyaḥ |
analyzed: yasya pada tvam bhaviṣyati tasya eva eka varjam anudāttam yathā syāt pada samūhasya mā bhūt iti etad artham pada grahaṇam iti bhāvaḥ iti caturthaḥ udhyāyaḥ

original: || atha pañcamo'dhyāyaḥ ||
analyzed: atha pañcamaḥ udhyāyaḥ

original: jhrjñā.ṭa prākkrītācchaḥ (sū.5-1-1)|| "asamāse niṣkādibhyaḥ' (sū.5-1-20) | niṣkādiṣvasamāsagrahaṇaṃ jñāpakaṃ pūrvatra tadantavidheḥ pratiṣedho neti | jhrvi.ṭa nanu "asamāse niṣkādibhyaḥ' iti sūtre asamāsagrahaṇaṃ vyartham | na ca tadabhāve paramaniṣkaśabdātsamāsādapyanena ṭhak syāt , ṭhañeveṣyate |
analyzed: prāk krītāt śaḥ sū511 asamāse niṣka ādibhyaḥ sū511 niṣka ādiṣu asamāsa grahaṇam jñāpakam pūrvatra tad anta vidheḥ pratiṣedhaḥ na iti nanu asamāse niṣka ādibhyaḥ iti sūtre asamāsa grahaṇam vyartham na ca tad abhāve parama niṣka śabdāt samāsāt api anena ṭhak syāt ṭhañ eva iṣyate

original: tathā ca paramaniṣkaśabdavyāvartanārthaṃ asamāsagrahaṇamiti vācyam | grahaṇavatā pratipadikena tadantavidhaḥ pratiṣedhāt niṣkādibhyo vidhīyamānaṣṭhak niṣkādyantānna bhaviṣya tīti asamāsagrahaṇamantareṇāpi paramaniṣkadivyāvṛttisiddherityāśaṅkya, etatsūtrātprāktaneṣu sūtreṣu prātipadikagrahaṇena tadantadasyāpi grahaṇamiti jñāpanārtham
analyzed: tathā ca parama niṣka śabda vyāvartana artham asamāsa grahaṇam iti vācyam grahaṇavatā pratipadikena tad anta vidhaḥ pratiṣedhāt niṣka ādibhyaḥ niṣka ādi antāt na iti asamāsa grahaṇam antareṇa api parama niṣka di vyāvṛtti siddheḥ iti āśaṅkya etad sūtrāt prāktaneṣu sūtreṣu prātipadika grahaṇena tad anta dasya api grahaṇam iti jñāpana artham

original: asamāsagrahaṇam | tathā ca tannyāyenātra sūtre'pi tadantavidhiprāptau paramaniṣkādibhya'pi ṭhak syāditi tadvāraṇārthamasamāsagrahaṇaṃ sārthakam | jñāpanaprayojanam tu "khalayavamāṣatilavṛṣabrahmaṇaśca' (sū.5-1-7) iti sutreṇa khalādibhyo vidhīyamānaḥ hitārthe yatpratyayaḥ khalādyantādapi bhavati |
analyzed: asamāsa grahaṇam tathā ca tad nyāyena atra sūtre api tad anta vidhi prāptau parama niṣka ādibhiḥ api ṭhak syāt iti tad vāraṇa artham asamāsa grahaṇam sārthakam jñāpana prayojanam tu khala yava māṣa tila vṛṣa brahmaṇaḥ ca sū 517 iti sutreṇa khala ādibhyaḥ vidhīyamānaḥ hita arthe yad pratyayaḥ khala ādi antāt api bhavati

original: tena kṛṣṇatilebhyo hitaḥ kṛṣṇatilyaḥ rājamāṣebhyo hitaṃ rājamāṣyamityādikaṃ sidhyati | sarvamidamabhipretyāha--niṣkādiṣviti | jhrjñā.ṭa viṃśatitriṃśadbhyām (sū.5-1-24)|| viṃśatikātkhaḥ (sū.5-1-32) iti kapratyayāntoccāraṇaṃ jñāpayati bhavatyetatsūtropāttābhyāṃ kanniti |
analyzed: tena kṛṣṇa tilebhyaḥ hitaḥ kṛṣṇa tilyaḥ rājamāṣebhyaḥ hitam rājamāṣyam iti ādikam sidhyati sarvam idam abhipretya āha niṣka ādiṣu iti viṃśati triṃśadbhyām sū5124 viṃśatikāt khaḥ sū5132 iti ka pratyaya anta uccāraṇam jñāpayati bhavati etat sūtra upāttābhyām kan iti

original: jhrvi.ṭa nanu "viṃśatitriṃśadbhyāṃ ḍḍḍatdh;vunnasaṃjñāyām' itā sūtreṇa ārhīyeṣvartheṣu viṃśatitriṃśadbhyāṃ ḍḍḍatdh;vunpratyayo vidhīyate | viṃśakaḥ triṃśakaḥ ityudāharaṇam | tatrāsaṃjñāyāmityanuktau saṃjñāyāṃ viṣaye'pi ḍḍḍatdh;vun bhavet, kaneva tu tatra viṃśatikaḥ triṃśatkaḥityevamiṣyate | ataḥ asaṃjñāyāmityuktamiti vaktavyam |
analyzed: nanu viṃśati triṃśadbhyām sūtreṇa ārhīyeṣu artheṣu viṃśati triṃśadbhyām ḍḍḍatdhvun pratyayaḥ vidhīyate viṃśakaḥ triṃśakaḥ iti udāharaṇam tatra asaṃjñāyām iti anuktau saṃjñāyām viṣaye pi bhavet tu tatra viṃśatikaḥ triṃśatkaḥ iti evam iṣyate atas asaṃjñāyām iti uktam iti vaktavyam

original: paraṃ tu pratyudāharaṇe viṃśatikaḥ triṃśatkaḥ ityubhayatrāpi kan durlabhaḥ | "saṃkhyāyā atiśadantāyāḥkan' (sū.5-1-22) iti sūtre tyantāyāḥ śadantāyāśca kanpratiṣedhādityāśaṅkya,"viṃśatikātkhaḥ' iti sūtre kanpratyayāntatayā uccāraṇena viṃśatitriṃśadbhyāṃ kan bhavatiti jñāpanānna doṣa ityāha--kapratyayāntoccāraṇamiti |
analyzed: param tu pratyudāharaṇe viṃśatikaḥ triṃśatkaḥ iti ubhayatra api kan durlabhaḥ saṃkhyāyāḥ ati śat antāyāḥ kan sū5122 iti sūtre ti antāyāḥ śat antāyāḥ ca kan pratiṣedhāt iti āśaṅkya viṃśatikāt khaḥ iti sūtre kan pratyaya anta tayā uccāraṇena viṃśati triṃśadbhyām kan bhavati iti jñāpanāt na doṣaḥ iti āha ka pratyaya anta uccāraṇam iti

original: na ca viṃśatikaśabda eva sūtrakāreṇoccāritaḥ | tena ca viṃśatikaśabdasya sādhutvāvagame'pi triṃśatkaśabdasya kathaṃ sādhutvamavagamyeta iti vācyam | viṃśatikaśabdena viṃśatiśabdaghaṭitasūtropalakṣaṇena tatsūtropāttābhyāṃ viṃśatitriṃśadbhyāmubābhyāmapi kanpratyayasya jñāpanādityāśayaḥ | yogāpekṣatvāt jñāpakatvasyeti yāvat |
analyzed: na ca viṃśatika śabdaḥ eva sūtrakāreṇa uccāritaḥ tena ca viṃśatika śabdasya sādhu tva avagame pi triṃśatka śabdasya katham sādhu tvam avagamyeta iti vācyam viṃśatika śabdena viṃśati śabda ghaṭita sūtra upalakṣaṇena tad sūtra upāttābhyām viṃśati triṃśadbhyām ubābhyām api kanpratyayasya jñāpanāt iti āśayaḥ yoga apekṣa tvāt jñāpaka tvasya iti yāvat

original: jhrjñā.ṭa tatra tasyeva (sū.5-2-116)|| asmādeva jñāpakādivaśabdena saptamī bhavati | jhrvi.ṭa nanu "tatra tasyeva' iti sūtreṇa saptamyantāt ṣaṣṭyantācca ivārthe vatipratyayo vidhīyate | mathurāyāmiva mathurāvat strughre prākāraḥ, devadattasyeva devadattavat yajñadattasya gāvaḥ ityādikamudāharaṇam |
analyzed: tatra tasya iva sū52116 asmāt eva jñāpakāt iva śabdena saptamī bhavati nanu tatra tasya iva iti sūtreṇa saptamī antāt ṣaṣṭi antāt ca iva arthe vati pratyayaḥ vidhīyate mathurāyām iva mathurā vat prākāraḥ devadattasya iva devadatta vat yajñadattasya gāvaḥ iti ādikam udāharaṇam

original: tatrevaśabaḍhaddhaṭhṭhaḍadayoge sambandhasāmānye ṣaṣṭhyāḥ sbhave'pi ivayoge kenāpi sūtreṇa saptamyāḥ avidhānena saptamyantādivārthe vatividhānaṃ kathaṃ saṅgacchata ityāśaṅkya, asmādeva ivārthe saptamyantādvatividhānāt jñāpakāt ivayoge saptamīvibhaktirbhavatīti jñāpanāt na ko'pi doṣa iti samādhatte--asmādeveti | ivaśabdeneti | yoga iti śeṣaḥ|
analyzed: tatra iva śaba ḍhad dhaṭh ṭhaḍada yoge sambandha sāmānye ṣaṣṭhyāḥ iva yoge kena api sūtreṇa saptamyāḥ avidhānena saptamī antāt iva arthe vati vidhānam katham saṅgacchate iti āśaṅkya asmāt eva iva arthe saptamī antāt vati vidhānāt jñāpakāt iva yoge saptamī vibhaktiḥ bhavati iti jñāpanāt na kaḥ api doṣaḥ iti samādhatte asmāt eva iti iva śabdena iti yoge iti śeṣaḥ

original: jñāpanasya phalaṃ tu deveṣviva nāma brāhmaṇeṣviva nāma ityādiprayoga upapanno bhavatīti | jhrjñā.ṭa kimidaṃbhyām (sū.5-2-40)|| etadeva jñāpayati kimidaṃbyāṃ vatubiti | jhrvi.ṭa nanu "kimidaṃbhyāṃ ve ghaḥ' iti sūtraṃ kimidaṃbhyāṃ parasya vatupo vakārasya ghatvaṃ vidhatte | kiyān iyān ityudāharaṇam |
analyzed: jñāpanasya phalam tu deveṣu iva nāma brāhmaṇeṣu iva nāma ityādi prayogaḥ upapannaḥ bhavati iti jhrjñāṭa kim idaṃbhyām sū5240 etat eva jñāpayati kim idaṃbyām vatup iti nanu kim idaṃbhyām ve ghaḥ iti sūtram kim idaṃbhyām parasya vatupaḥ vakārasya gha tvam vidhatte kiyān iyān iti udāharaṇam

original: tatra kimidaṃbyāṃ vatupo durlabhatvāt dhatvavidhānamasaṃgatam | "yattadetebyaḥ parimāṇe vatup ' (sū.5-2-39) iti sūtre yattadetacchabdebya eva
analyzed: tatra kim idam byām vatupaḥ durlabha tvāt dha tva vidhānam asaṃgatam yat tat etebyaḥ parimāṇe vatup sū 5239 iti sūtre yat tat etad śabdebyaḥ eva

original: vatupo vidhānādityā śaṅkyāha--etadeveti | kimidaṃbhyāṃ vatupo'bhāve tadavayavavakārasya ghatvavidhānamanupapannamiti ādeśavidhānānyathānupapacyā vatuppratyayaḥ kimidaṃbyāṃ bhavatītyanumīyata iti bhāvaḥ | jhrjñā.ṭa (ṣaṣṭhāde) jhrṣaṣṭhyādeṭa ścāsaṃ (sū.5-2-58)|| asaṃkhyāderityetat jñāpayati (bhavati) hi jhrbhavatīhaṭa tadantavidhiriti |
analyzed: vatupaḥ vidhānāt iti ā śaṅkya āha etat eva iti kim idam bhyām tad avayava vakārasya gha tva vidhānam anupapannam iti ādeśa vidhāna anyathā anupapacyā vatup pratyayaḥ kim idam byām bhavati iti anumīyate iti bhāvaḥ ṣaṣṭha āde sū5258 asaṃkhya ādeḥ iti etat jñāpayati bhavati hi tad anta vidhiḥ iti

original: tenaikaviṃśatitamaḥ siddhaḥ | jhrvi.ṭa nanu ṣaṣṭhyādeścāsaṃkhyādeḥ' iti sūtreṇāsaṃkhyādeḥ ṣaṣṭiprabhṛteḥ saṃkhyāvācakaśabdāt parasya ḍaḍḍatdh;ṭastamaḍaḍḍatdh;āgamo nityaṃ vidhīyate | ṣaṣṭitama ityādikamudāharaṇam |
analyzed: tena ekaviṃśatitamaḥ siddhaḥ jhrviṭa nanu ṣaṣṭhī ādeḥ ca a saṃkhyā ādeḥ iti sūtreṇa a saṃkhyā ādeḥ ṣaṣṭi prabhṛteḥ saṃkhyā vācaka śabdāt parasya nityam vidhīyate ṣaṣṭitamaḥ iti ādikam udāharaṇam

original: tatrāsaṃkhyāderityanuktau ekaṣaṣṭitamaḥ ityatrāpi nityaṃ tamaḍaḍḍatdh;āgamaḥ syāt, "viṃśatyādibhyastamaḍaḍḍatdh;nyatarasyāṃ' (sū.5-2-56) ityanena vikalpena tu tamaḍiḍḍatdh;ṣyate iti asaṃkhyāderityasya prayojanaṃ vaktavyam | tanna yuktam |
analyzed: tatra asaṃkhyā ādeḥ iti anuktau ekaṣaṣṭitamaḥ iti atra api nityam tamaḍ aṭ ḍatdha āgamaḥ syāt viṃśati ādibhyaḥ tamaḍ aṭ ḍatdh nyatarasyām sū 5256 iti anena vikalpena tu iti asaṃkhyā ādeḥ iti asya prayojanam vaktavyam tat na yuktam

original: grahaṇavatā prātipadikena tadantavidhipratiṣedhāt ṣaṣṭiśabdena ṣaṣṭiśabdāntasya ekaṣaṣṭiśabdasya grahaṇāsaṃbhavādeva tataḥ etatsūtrāpravṛtteḥ ityāśaṅkyāha-asaṃkhyāderatyietaditi | tathā ca pūrvoktarītyā vyarthaṃ sat asaṃkhyāderityetat iha tamaṭprakaraṇe tadantavidhirastīti jñāpayati |
analyzed: grahaṇavatā prātipadikena tad anta vidhi pratiṣedhāt ṣaṣṭi śabdena ṣaṣṭi śabda antasya ekaṣaṣṭi śabdasya grahaṇa asaṃbhavāt eva tatas etad sūtra apravṛtteḥ iti āśaṅkya āha asaṃkhya ādeḥ ati i etat iti tathā ca pūrva ukta rītyā vyartham sat asaṃkhya ādeḥ iti etat iha tamaṭ prakaraṇe tad anta vidhiḥ asti iti jñāpayati

original: tataśca ekaṣaṣṭiśabdādapi tadantavidhinā anena sūtreṇa nityaṃ ḍaḍḍatdh;ṭastamaḍaḍḍatdh;āgamaprasaktau tadvāraṇārthaṃ asaṃkhyāderiti | ekaṣaṣṭiśabdasya saṃkhyāvācakaikaśabdādyavayavakatvenāsaṃkhyāditvaṃ nāstīti na doṣaḥ | jñāpanaphalavamāha-tenaikaviṃśatitamaḥ siddha iti |
analyzed: tatas ca ekaṣaṣṭi śabdāt api tad anta vidhinā anena sūtreṇa nityam ḍaṭ ḍatdhṭastama ḍaḍḍatdha āgama prasaktau tad vāraṇa artham asaṃkhyā ādeḥ iti ekaṣaṣṭi śabdasya saṃkhyā vācaka eka śabda ādi avayavaka tvena asaṃkhyā ādi tvam na asti iti na doṣaḥ siddhaḥ iti

original: "viṃśatyādiṃbhyastamaḍaḍḍatdh;nyatarasyāṃ' (sū.5-2-56) iti sūtre tadantavidhinā viṃśatyādyantasyāpi grahaṇāt ekaṣaṣṭiśabdādapi tena ḍaḍḍatdh;ṭastamaṭi ekaṣaṣṭitama iti sidhyati |
analyzed: iti sūtre tad anta vidhinā viṃśati ādi antasya api grahaṇāt ekaṣaṣṭi śabdāt api tena ekaṣaṣṭitamaḥ iti sidhyati

original: ḍaḍḍatdh;ṭastamaṭprakaraṇe tadantavidhyabhāve tu ṣaṣṭiśabdāntasya ekaṣaṣṭiśabdasya "viṃśatyādibhyaḥ' iti sūtre grahaṇābhāvāt ḍaḍḍatdh;ṭastamaṭ na syāt ekaṣaṣṭha ityeva rūpaṃ bhavediti bhāvaḥ | jhrjñā.ṭa sidhmādibhyaśca (sū.4-2-97)|| adantapicchāditundādyanyatarapāṭhenaiva siddhe bhedena pāṭho jñāpayati lajanyatarasyāmiti samuccaya iti |
analyzed: ḍaṭ ḍat dhṭas tamaṭ prakaraṇe tad anta vidhi abhāve tu ṣaṣṭi śabda antasya ekaṣaṣṭi śabdasya viṃśati ādibhyaḥ iti sūtre grahaṇa abhāvāt na syāt ekaṣaṣṭhaḥ iti eva rūpam bhavet iti bhāvaḥ sidhma ādibhyaḥ ca sū adanta piccha ādi tunda ādi anyatara pāṭhena eva siddhe bhedena pāṭhaḥ jñāpayati lac anyatarasyām iti samuccayaḥ iti

original: "keśādvo'nyatarasyāṃ' (sū.5-2-109) ityanyatarasyāṃgrahaṇasya punaḥ karaṇācyedaṃ samuccayārtham | dyudrubhyāṃ nityārthameke etadanyatarasyāṃgrahahaṇamicchanti vibhāṣayormadhye ye vidhayaste vityā bhavantīti | jhrvi.ṭa nanu "sidhmādibhya' iti sutre "prāṇisthādāto lajanyatarasyāṃ' (sū.5-2-96) iti sūtrādanyatarasyāmityanuvartate |
analyzed: sū52109 iti anyatarasyām āṃgrahaṇasya punar samuccaya artham dyu drubhyām nitya artham eke etat anyatarasyām āṃgrahaṇam icchanti vibhāṣayoḥ madhye ye vidhayaḥ te bhavanti iti nanu sidhma ādibhyaḥ iti sutre prāṇi sthā dātaḥ la c anyatarasyām sū5296 iti sūtrāt anyatarasyām iti anuvartate

original: tathā ca sidhmādibyaḥ matvarthe'nyatarasyāṃ lac bhavatīti sūtrārtho labhyate | evaṃ sati sidhyādigaṇe yānyakārāntāni tebhyo vikalpena laci vihite lajabhāvapakṣe "ata iniṭhanau' (sū.5-2-115) iti sūtreṇa iniṭhanāvapi prāpnutaḥ | matubeveṣyate | kathametatsidhyatītyāśaṅkyāha-adantetyādinā |
analyzed: tathā ca sidhma ādibyaḥ bhavati iti sūtra arthaḥ labhyate evam sati sidhyādi gaṇe yāni akāra antāni tebhyaḥ vikalpena laci vihite laja bhāva pakṣe atas ini ṭhanau sū52115 iti sūtreṇa ini ṭhanau api prāpnutaḥ matup eva iṣyate katham etat sidhyati iti āśaṅkya āha adanta ityādinā

original: ayamāśayaḥ--nipātānāmanekārthatvādatra sūtre'nuvalṛttaḥ anyatarasyāṃśabdaḥ samuccayārthakaḥ na vikalpārthakaḥ | ataḥ anyatarasyāṃgrahaṇena prakṛtaḥ matup samuccīyate | sidhmādibapyaḥ lac matup ca bavataḥ iti sūtrārthaḥ | ataḥ iniṭhanoḥ na prasaktiḥ |

original: yadyanyatarasyāgrahaṇānuvṛttyā pratyayacatuṣṭayaṃ sidhmādibyo'pi bhavet tarhi asyaivānyatarasyāṃśabdasya "lomādipāmādipicchādibyaḥ śanelacaḥ' (sū.5-2-200) iti sūtre'pyanuvṛttyā piccādabhyio'pi catvāraḥ pratyayā bhaveyuḥ | tathā sati tundādīnāṃ picchādigaṇe pāṭhenaiva tundādibyaḥ "lomādipāmādi' iti pratyayacatuṣṭayasiddheḥ

original: "tundādibya ilacca' iti pṛthaksūtramanarthakam | yadvā tundādigaṇe picchādīnāṃ pāṭhenaiva picchādibyaḥ "tundādibhyaḥ ilacca' iti sūtreṇa pratyayacatuṣṭayasiddau "lomādipāmādi' sūtre picchādigrahaṇamanarthakam |
analyzed: tunda ādibyaḥ ilac ca iti pṛthak sūtram anarthakam yat vā tunda ādi gaṇe piccha ādīnām pāṭhena eva piccha ādibyaḥ tunda ādibhyaḥ ilac ca iti sūtreṇa pratyaya catuṣṭaya siddau loma ādi pāma ādi sūtre piccha ādi grahaṇam anarthakam

original: evaṃ cānayoḥ picchāditundādyoḥ pṛthakpāṭhaḥ pūthagyogakaraṇaṃ cāyukta miti "sidhmādibhyaśca' iti sūtre anyatarasyāṃśabdaḥ samuccayārtho na vikalpārtha iti jñāpayati | tathā ca prakṛtasya matupaḥ samuccayena pratyayadvayasiddhāvapi pratyayacatuṣṭayaṃ tundādibhyo na sidhyediti picchādibhyaḥ pṛthakkṛtya "tundādibya ilacca' iti sūtraṃ praṇītam |
analyzed: evam ca anayoḥ picchā ādi tunda ādyoḥ pṛthak pāṭhaḥ pūthak yoga karaṇam ca ayuktam iti sidhma ādibhyaḥ ca iti sūtre anyatarasya aṃśabdaḥ samuccaya arthaḥ na vikalpa arthaḥ iti jñāpayati tathā ca prakṛtasya matupaḥ samuccayena pratyaya dvaya siddhau api pratyaya catuṣṭayam tunda ādibhyaḥ na sidhyet iti picchā ādibhyaḥ pṛthakkṛtya tunda ādibhyaḥ ilac ca iti sūtram praṇītam

original: tasya ca iniṭhanbyāmanantaraṃ pravṛttatvāt cakāreṇa matup iniṭhanau ca samuccīyete iti pratyayacatuṣṭayasiddhiḥ | sidhmādipicchādisūtrayostu iniṭhanoḥ pūrvaṃ pāṭhāt samuccayārthakenānyatarasyāṃgrahaṇena pūrvakṛto matubeva samuccīyata iti tebhyaḥ pratyayadvayameveti vyavasthā sidhyati |
analyzed: tasya ca ini ṭhanbyām anantaram pravṛtta tvāt cakāreṇa matup ini ṭhanau ca samuccīyete iti pratyaya catuṣṭaya siddhiḥ sidhma ādi piccha ādi sūtrayoḥ tu ini ṭhanoḥ pūrvam pāṭhāt samuccaya arthakena anyatarasya āṃgrahaṇena pūrva kṛtaḥ matup eva samuccīyate iti tebhyaḥ pratyaya dvayam eva iti vyavasthā sidhyati

original: vikalpārthakatvāpakṣe tu abhāvapakṣe pūrveṇa pareṇa vā vihitāḥ sarve'pi pratyāyā yathāprāptaṃ bhaveyuriti bhāvaḥ |"sidhmādibhyasca' (5-1-97) iti sūtre'nuvṛttaṃ anyatarasyāṃgrahaṇaṃ samuccayārthakamityatra jñāpakāntaramupanyasyati "keśādvaḥ' ityādinā | "kesādvo'nyatarasyām' (sū.5-1-109) iti sūtre'nyatarasyāṃgrahaṇānuvṛttyaiva tatphalasiddheḥ |
analyzed: vikalpa arthaka tva apakṣe tu abhāva pakṣe pūrveṇa pareṇa vā vihitāḥ sarve api pratyāyāḥ yathāprāptam bhaveyuḥ iti bhāvaḥ sidhma ādibhyaḥ ca 5197 iti sūtre nuvṛttam anyatarasyāṃgrahaṇam samuccaya arthakam iti atra jñāpaka antaram upanyasyati keśāt vaḥ ityādinā iti sūtre nyatarasyāṃgrahaṇa anuvṛttyā eva tad phala siddheḥ

original: ataḥ vyarthaṃ sat tat pūrvatra anyatarasyāṃgrahaṇaṃ samuccayārthakamiti jñāpayati | tathā ca tasya keśādva ityatrānuvṛttau samuccayārtha eva labhyeta | vikalpārthastivaṣyate | tena iniṭhanāvapi prāpyete | ata eva keśavaḥ keśī keśikaḥ keśavāniti rūpacatuṣṭayaṃ sidhyati iti bhāvaḥ |
analyzed: atas vyartham sat tat pūrvatra anyatarasyāṃgrahaṇam samuccaya arthakam iti jñāpayati tathā ca tasya iti atra anuvṛttau samuccaya arthaḥ eva labhyeta tena ini ṭhanau api prāpyete atas eva keśavaḥ keśī keśikaḥ keśavān iti rūpa catuṣṭayam sidhyati iti bhāvaḥ

original: anye tu-"keśādvo'nyatarasyām' (sū.5-2-109) iti sūtre anyatarasyāṃgrahaṇaṃ "dyudrubyāṃ maḥ' (sū.5-2-107) iti pūrvasūtrasya nityatvajñāpanāya | anyathā tatrāpi anyatarasyām ityasyānuvṛttau tasyāpyanityatvāpatteḥ | tathā ca tatra sūtre'nyatarasyāmityasya nivṛttiṃ sūcayati | etadeva vibāṣayormadhye ye vidhayaste nityā bhavantīti śabdāntaremoktam |
analyzed: anye tu keśa dvaḥ nyatarasyām sū52109 iti sūtre anyatarasyāṃgrahaṇam dyu drubyām maḥ sū52107 iti pūrva sūtrasya nitya tva jñāpanāya anyathā tatra api anyatarasyām ityasya anuvṛttau tasya api anitya tva āpatteḥ tathā ca tatra sūtre nyatarasyām ityasya nivṛttim sūcayati etat eva vibāṣayoḥ madhye ye vidhayaḥ te nityāḥ bhavanti iti śabda antareṇa uktam

original: tathā ca "keśādva' iti sūtrasthānyatarasyāṃgrahaṇasya prayojanāntarasadbhāvāt tatkathaṃ samuccayārthe jñāpakaṃ bhavediti vadanti | tadanuvadati--dyudrubhyāṃ nityārthameka iti |
analyzed: tathā ca keśāt vaḥ iti sūtrastha anyatarasya aṃgrahaṇasya prayojana antara sadbhāvāt tat katham samuccaya arthe jñāpakam bhavet iti vadanti tat anuvadati dyu drubhyām nitya artham ekaḥ iti

original: vastutastu-"dyudrubhyāṃ mo nityaṃ' iti nityapadaṃ saṃyojya nityatve sādhayituṃ śakye sati tadarthaṃ uttarasūtre anyatarasyāṃgrahaṇopādānamityetanna yujyate iti anyatarasyāṃgrahaṇaṃ jñāpakameva | idamevāsvārasyam eke ityanena sucitamityavadheyam | jhrjñā.ṭa ekagopūrvāt (sū.5-2-117)|| nityagrahaṇaṃ jñāpayati prāgetasmādyogādvibhāṣānuvartata iti |
analyzed: vastutas tu dyu drubhyām maḥ nityam iti nitya padam saṃyojya nitya tve sādhayitum śakye sati tad artham uttara sūtre anyatarasyāṃgrahaṇa upādānam iti etat na yujyate iti anyatarasyāṃgrahaṇam jñāpakam eva idam eva asvārasyam eke iti anena sucitam iti avadheyam jhrjñāṭaḥ eka go pūrvāt sū52117 nitya grahaṇam jñāpayati prāk etasmāt yogāt vibhāṣā anuvartate iti

original: jhrvi.ṭa nanu "ekagopūrvāṭṭhañ nityam' iti sūtre nityagrahaṇaṃ vyartham | na ca tadabhāve "keśādvo'nyatarasyāṃ' (sū.5-2-109) iti sūtrāt anyatarasyāmityanuvarteta | tataśca pakṣe matubapi syāditi tannivṛttyarthaṃ nityagrahaṇamiti vācyam | pūrvasūtra eva anyatarasyāmityasya nivṛtteratrānuvṛttyasambhavādityataḥ jñāpakārthaṃtvamāha--nityagrahaṇamiti |
analyzed: nanu eka go pūrvāt ṭhañ nityam iti sūtre nitya grahaṇam vyartham na ca tad abhāve sū52109 iti sūtrāt anyatarasyām iti anuvarteta tatas ca pakṣe matup api syāt iti tad nivṛtti artham nitya grahaṇam iti vācyam pūrva sūtre eva anyatarasyām ityasya nivṛtteḥ atra anuvṛtti asambhavāt iti atas jñāpaka arthaṃtvam āha nitya grahaṇam iti

original: yato'tra sūtre nityagrahaṇaṃ kṛtaṃ tena pūrvasūtre'nyatarasyāṃgrahaṇamanuvartata iti jñāpayati | evaṃ cātrāpi tadanuvṛttau pakṣe matup syāditi tannivṛttyarthaṃ nityagrahaṇamiti bhāvaḥ | jñāpanaphalaṃ tu "vrīhyādibhyaśca'(sū.5-1-116) iti sūtrasya vaikalpikatvamiti | jhrjñā.ṭa praśasyasya śraḥ (sū.5-3-60)||
analyzed: yatas utra sūtre nitya grahaṇam kṛtam tena pūrva sūtre nyatarasya āṃgrahaṇam anuvartate iti jñāpayati evam ca atra api tad anuvṛttau pakṣe matup syāt iti tad nivṛtti artham nitya grahaṇam iti bhāvaḥ jñāpana phalam tu iti sūtrasya vaikalpika tvam iti praśasyasya śraḥ sū5360

original: ajādyoretadādeśavidhānaṃ jñāpayatyetebhyo'guṇavacanebhyo'pyajādī iti | jhrvi.ṭa nanu "praśasyasya śraḥ' iti sūtre "ajādī guṇavacanā
analyzed: ac ādyoḥ etat ādeśa vidhānam jñāpayati etebhyaḥ guṇavacanebhyaḥ pi a c ādī iti nanu praśasyasya śraḥ iti sūtre ac ādī guṇavacanā

original: yuvan śabdāt śasi yuvan as iti sthite vakārasya "śvayuvamaghonāmataddhite' (sū.6-4-133) iti sūtrema samprasāraṇe ukāre yuu an iti sthite "samprasāraṇācca' (sū.6-1-108) iti pūrvarūpe yu un iti sthite savarṇadīrghe yūnaḥ iti rūpaṃ sidhyati |
analyzed: yuvan śabdāt śasi yuvan as iti sthite vakārasya śva yuva maghavnām a taddhite sū64133 iti sūtre ma samprasāraṇe ukāre yuu an iti sthite samprasāraṇāt ca sū61108 iti pūrvarūpe yu u un iti sthite savarṇa dīrghe yūnaḥ iti rūpam sidhyati

original: tatra yakārasyāpi samprasāraṇe prāpte "na samprasāraṇe' iti sūtreṇa vakārasthānike ukārarūpe samprasāraṇe pare yakārasya saṃprasāraṇaṃ na bhavatīti niṣidhyate | tadetat tadā ghaṭate yadi yuvanśabde vakārasya pūrvaṃ samprasāraṇaṃ syāt | yadā tu ādau yakārasya samprasāraṇaṃ kriyate tadā samprasāraṇa parakatvābhāvānniṣedho na pravarteta |

original: tathā ca ādau yakārasya samprasāraṇaṃ paścadvakārasyetyevamubhayoḥ samprasāraṇaṃ prasajyata ityāśaṅkyāha--ayameva niṣedho jñāpayatīti | yadi hi dvayoḥ samprasāraṇaṃ syāt niṣedhārambho vyartho bhavet | niṣedhamahimnā ca parasya yaṇaḥ pūrvaṃ samprasāraṇaṃ na pūrvasyeti jñāpayati |

original: tataśca parasya samprasāraṇe kṛte pūrvasyāpi prāptau satyāṃ niṣedha ārabhyate iti niṣedhasya caritārthateti bhāvaḥ | jhrjñā.ṭa prathamayoḥ pūrva (sū.6-1-102)|| atra vibhaktyorgrahaṇe "tasmācchaso naḥ'(6-1-103) iti pūrvalasavarṇadīrghaparāmarśakaṃ tasmāditi jñāpakam |

original: atra bāvyamānasya ukārasya savarṇagrāhakatvena sthānyāntarthāt ukāre prāpte tannivartakatayā ut iti taparakaraṇaṃ sārthakamiti bhāvaḥ | anyatra prayojanaṃ tu amūbhyāmiti | nanu "diva ut' iti sūtravihitasya ukārasya tittvena "titsvaritaṃ' iti svaritavāraṇāya titi pratyayaghahaṇaṃ kartavyamenetyata āha--titi pratyayagrahaṇamiti|

original: tathā ca "diva ud' iti sūtre'pi ud ityeva ādeśaḥ | tathā ca tittvābāvenaiva svaritasvaro na prāpsyatīti pratyayaghahaṇamanāvaśyakamiti bhāvaḥ | nanu yadi ud ityādeśastadā "taparastatkālasya' (sū 1-1-70) iti sūtrāpravṛttyā ūkāro'pyādeśo bhavedityāśaṅkyāha--taparasūtra iti | tathā ca dtaparaḥ ityatra dakārasya rcatvena ttapara iti sūtram |

analyzed: tathā ca anādeśaḥ iti pratiṣedha apravṛttyā śasi dadyoḥ api e tvā abhyāsa lopayoḥ prāptau tad pratiṣedha artham na śasa dadi iti sūtre śasi dadi grahaṇam iti bhāvaḥ prayojanam tu pecatuḥ ityādau anādeśa ādeḥ iti pratiṣedha apravṛttyā e tvā abhyāsa lopayoḥ siddhiḥ iti

original: natvevamapi danbhadhātorliṭi debaturityatra danb danbh aturiti sthite halādiśeṣe "aniditām' (sū.6-4-24) iti nalope ca kṛte "asiddhavadatrābhāt' (sū.6-4-22) iti nalopasyāsiddhatvāt akārasya saṃyuktahalmadhyasthatvādekāraḥ abyāsalopaśca na sidhyatītyāśaṅkyāha--śnasoracva iti |
analyzed: na tu evam api danbha dhātoḥ liṭi debatuḥ iti atra danp danbh atuḥ iti sthite ha l ādi śeṣe an it itām sū6424 iti na lope ca kṛte asiddha vat atra ābhāt sū6422 iti na lopasya asiddha tvāt akārasya saṃyukta ha l madhya stha tvāt ekāraḥ a byāsa lopaḥ ca na sidhyati iti āśaṅkya āha śnasoḥ a cvaḥ iti

original: "śnasorallopaḥ' (sū.6-4-111) iti sūtre at iti taparakaraṇam āsan ityatra āṭaḥ loṃpanivṛttyarthaṃ kriyate | atra lope kartavye "asiddhavadatrābhāt ' iti sūtreṇa āṭaḥ asiddhatvāt ākārasya lopo na baviṣyatīti ākāravyāvṛttyarthaṃ kriyamāṇaṃ taparakaraṇaṃ vyarthaṃ sat asiddhatvamanityamiti jñāpayati |
analyzed: iti sūtre a t iti ta para karaṇam āsan iti atra āṭaḥ loṃpa nivṛtti artham kriyate atra lope kartavye asiddha vat atra ābhāt iti sūtreṇa āṭaḥ asiddha tvāt ākārasya lopaḥ na baviṣyati iti ākāra vyāvṛtti artham kriyamāṇam ta para karaṇam vyartham sat asiddha tvam anityam iti jñāpayati

original: tena āṭaḥ asiddhatvābhāvāt tasya lopo mā bhūditi taparakaraṇamiti svāṃśe cāritārthyaṃm | anyatra prayojanaṃ tu debhaturityādau nalopasyāsiddhatvābhāvāt etvābhyāsalopau sidhyata iti iti bhāvaḥ | jhrjñā.ṭa ṭhathali ca seṭi' (sū.6-4-121)|| "tṝphalabhaja' (sū.6-4-122) iti tṝgrahaṇāt jñāpakāt lulavithetyādau naitvābhyāsalopau |
analyzed: tena āṭaḥ asiddha tva abhāvāt tasya lopaḥ mā bhūt iti ta para karaṇam iti sva aṃśe cāritārthyam anyatra prayojanam tu debhatuḥ ityādau na lopasya asiddha tva abhāvāt e tvā abhyāsa lopau sidhyataḥ iti iti bhāvaḥ ṭha tha li ca sa iṭi sū 64121 iti tṝ grahaṇāt jñāpakāt lulavitha ityādau na e tva abhyāsa lopau

original: jhrvi.ṭa ṭhathali ca seṭi' iti sūtreṇa vidhīyamānau etvābyāsalopau lulavithetyatrāpi bhavetām | avādeśe kṛte akārasyāsaṃyuktahalmadhyasthatvāt etvasya prāpteḥ ityāśaṅkyāha--tṝphaletyādinā | teritha ityatrāpi
analyzed: ṭha thali ca sa iṭi iti sūtreṇa vidhīyamānau lulavitha iti atra api bhavetām ava ādeśe kṛte akārasya asaṃyukta ha l madhya stha tvāt e tvasya prāpteḥ iti āśaṅkya āha tṝ phala ityādinā iti atra api

original: ṛkārasya guṇe kṛte akārasya "ata ekahalmadhye' (sū.6-4-120) ityanenaiva etvasiddhau tadarthaṃ tṝgrahaṇamanarthakam | kṛtaṃ ca tat guṇe kṛte yo'kāraḥ tasya etvaṃ na bhavatīti jñāpayati | tataśca etvāpravṛttau tadarthaṃ tṝgrahaṇaṃ sārthakam | lulavithetyādau ca guṇasampannākārasya etvaṃ na bhavatīti bhāvaḥ |
analyzed: ṛkārasya guṇe kṛte akārasya atas eka ha l madhye sū 64120 iti anena eva e tu asiddhau tad artham tṝ grahaṇam anarthakam kṛtam ca tat guṇe kṛte ya ukāraḥ tasya e tvam na bhavati iti jñāpayati tatas ca e tu apravṛttau tad artham tṝ grahaṇam sārthakam lulavitha ityādau ca guṇa sampanna akārasya e tvam na bhavati iti bhāvaḥ

original: jhrjñā.ṭa bilvakādibya(sca) jhrśchasyaṭa (sū.6-4-153) atra (ca) jhrchaṭa grahaṇaṃ jñāpayati saṃniyogaśiṣṭānāmanyatarāpāye ubhayorapyapāya iti | "jyādādīyasaḥ' (sū.64-160) lopānuvṛcyaiva siddhe ātvavidhānaṃ jñāpayati aṅgavṛtte punarvṛttāvavidhiriti | akāravidhānena siddhe ākāravidhānaṃ bhāvyamānena savarṇānāṃ grahaṇaṃ netyasya jñāpakam |
analyzed: bilvaka ādi byas ca sū64153 atra ca grahaṇam jñāpayati saṃniyoga śiṣṭānām anyatara apāye ubhayoḥ api apāyaḥ iti sū64160 lopa anuvṛcya eva siddhe ātva vidhānam jñāpayati aṅga vṛtte punar vṛttau avidhiḥ iti akāra vidhānena siddhe ākāra vidhānam bhāvyamānena savarṇānām grahaṇam na iti asya jñāpakam

original: "kārmastācchīlye' (sū.6-4-172) "nastaddhite' (sū.6-4-144) ityeva siddhe idaṃ nipātanaṃ jñāpayati tācchīlikeṣvaṇkṛtāni bhavantīti | jhrvi.ṭa etāḥ paribhāṣā iti hetoriha na vivriyante | jhrjñā.ṭa dāṇḍiḍḍatdh;nāyana (sū.6-4-174)|| "hanasto'ciṇṇaloḥ' (sū.7-3-32) ityeva bhrauṇahatye tatve siddhe tacvanipātanaṃ taddhite tatvapratiṣedhasya jñāpakam |
analyzed: kārmaḥ tācchīlye sū64172 naḥ taddhite sū64144 iti eva siddhe idam nipātanam jñāpayati tācchīlikeṣu aṇ kṛtāni bhavanti iti jhrviṭaḥ etāḥ paribhāṣāḥ iti hetoḥ iha na vivriyante jhrjñāṭa dāṇḍiḍḍatdhnāyana sū64174 hanaḥ tociṇ ṇaloḥ sū7332 iti eva bhrauṇa hatye ta tve siddhe ta cva nipātanam taddhite ta tva pratiṣedhasya jñāpakam

original: jhrvi.ṭa nanu "dāṇḍiḍḍatdh;nāyana'--ityādisūtre dāṇḍiḍḍatdh;nāyanādayaḥ śabdāḥ nipātyante | tatra "bhroṇahatya' ityapi kaścana śabdaḥ nirdiṣṭaḥ | tatra kiṃ nipātyate iti codyaṃ prasajati |
analyzed: nanu dāṇḍiḍḍatdhnāyana etyādi sūtre dāṇḍiḍḍatdhnāyana ādayaḥ śabdāḥ nipātyante tatra bhroṇahatye iti api kaścana śabdaḥ nirdiṣṭaḥ tatra kim nipātyate iti codyam prasajati

original: na ca bhrūṇaṃ hantīti bhrūṇahā bhrūṇaghno bhāvaḥ ityarthe brāhmaṇāditvāt bhrūṇahanśabdāt ṣyañi ādivṛddhau bhrauṇahan ya iti sthite nakārasya takāro nipātyata iti vācyam |
analyzed: na ca bhrūṇam hanti iti bhrūṇa hā bhrūṇa ghnaḥ bhāvaḥ iti arthe brāhmaṇa ādi tvāt bhrūṇa han śabdāt ādi vṛddhau bhrauṇa han yaḥ iti sthite nakārasya takāraḥ nipātyate iti vācyam

original: "hanasto'ciṇṇaloḥ' (sū.7-3-32) iti sāmānyasūtreṇaiva ciṇṇalbhinne ñiti ṇiti ca pare hantestakārādeśavidhāyakena ñiti ṣyañi pare'pi takārādeśasiddhestakāranipātanavairyathyādityata āha--ityeveta | tathā ca tatvanipātanaṃ taddhite pare hanteḥ "hanasto'ciṇṇaloḥ' ityanena takārādeśo na bhavatīti jñāpayati |
analyzed: sū iti sāmānya sūtreṇa eva ciṇ ṇal bhinne ñ iti ṇ iti ca pare hanteḥ takāra ādeśa vidhāyakena ñ iti ṣyañi pare pi takāra ādeśa siddheḥ takāra nipātana vairyathyāt iti atas āha eti eva ita tathā ca tatva nipātanam taddhite pare hanteḥ iti anena takāra ādeśaḥ na bhavati iti jñāpayati

original: ataḥ ṣyañi tatvāprāptau tannipātyate iti svāṃśe cāritārthyam | anyatra prayojanaṃ tu bhrauṇaghno vārtraghna ityādāvaṇi taddhite pare hanternakārasya tatvaṃ na bhavatīti bhāvaḥ | || iti ṣaṣṭho'dhyāyaḥ ||
analyzed: atas ṣyañi ta tva aprāptau tat nipātyate iti sva aṃśe cāritārthyam anyatra prayojanam tu bhrauṇaghnaḥ vārtraghnaḥ ityādau aṇi taddhite pare hanteḥ nakārasya ta tvam na bhavati iti bhāvaḥ iti ṣaṣṭhaḥ udhyāyaḥ

original: || atha saptamo'dhyāyaḥ ||
analyzed: atha saptamaḥ udhyāyaḥ

original: jhrjñā.ṭa āyane (sū.7-1-2)|| "ghacchau ca' (sū.4-4-117) iti citkaraṇaṃ jñāpakam āyannādaya upadeśe bhavantīti | jhrvi.ṭa nanu "āyaneyī' iti sūtreṇa pratyayādīnāṃ ph ityādīnāṃ āyannādayaḥ ādeśā ucyante | tatra naḍaḍḍatdh;śabdāt phaki naḍaḍḍatdh; pha iti sthite pratyayasvareṇa svararahito bhavet |
analyzed: āyane sū712 ghacchau ca sū44117 iti cit karaṇam jñāpakam āyan ādayaḥ upadeśe bhavanti iti nanu āyaneyī iti sūtreṇa pratyaya ādīnām ph ityādīnām āyan ādayaḥ ādeśāḥ ucyante tatra naḍaḍḍatdh śabdāt phaki naḍaḍḍatdh pha iti sthite pratyaya svareṇa svara rahitaḥ bhavet

original: tataśca nāḍaḍḍatdh;āyanaśabde antodātta eva bhavet iṣyate tu āyanaḥ ākārasyodāttatvam | tasya siddhimārgaḥ ka ityāśaṅkyāha--ghacchau ceti citkāraṇamiti | pratyayopadeśāvasthāyāmeva svarapravṛtteḥ pūrvameva pratyayādīnāṃ phādīnāmāyannādaya ādeśā bhavanti | ādeśānantaraṃ ca svaraḥ pravartate |
analyzed: tatas ca anta udāttaḥ eva bhavet iṣyate tu āyanaḥ ākārasya udātta tvam tasya siddhi mārgaḥ kaḥ iti āśaṅkya āha ghacchau ca iti cit kāraṇam iti pratyaya upadeśa avasthāyām eva svara pravṛtteḥ pūrvam eva pratyaya ādīnām pha ādīnām āyanna ādayaḥ ādeśāḥ bhavanti ādeśa anantaram ca svaraḥ pravartate

original: sa ca ādyudāttaḥ san āyana ityādeśadyavarṇasya ākārāderudāttatve paryavasyati | atrārthe jñāpakaṃ tu "ghacchau ca' iti sūtre ghacaścitkaraṇam | tathā hi agraśabdāt ghaci ghakārasyeyādeśe agriyaśabde antimasyākārasya udāttatvāsiddhaye ghacaścitkaraṇaṃ kriyate | tadetat upadeśāvasthāyāmeva ghakārasya iyādeśe sati dhaṭate |
analyzed: sa ca ādi udāttaḥ san āyanaḥ iti ādeśa dya varṇasya ākāra ādeḥ udātta tve paryavasyati atra arthe jñāpakam tu ca iti sūtre gha caḥ cit karaṇam tathā hi agra śabdāt gha ci ghakārasya iya ādeśe agriya śabde antimasya akārasya udātta tva asiddhaye gha caḥ cit karaṇam kriyate tat etat upadeśa avasthāyām eva ghakārasya iya ādeśe sati dhaṭate

original: tadā hi iyādeśānantaraṃ pratyayasvareṇa sārthakaṃ bhavati | yada copadesāvasthāyāmādeśo na bhavati tadā gha ityatrākārasya pratyayasvareṇodāttatve tataḥ gh ityasyāsvarakasya bhavanniyādeśo'pyasvaraka eva bhaviṣyati pūrvapravṛttaḥ akārasvaraḥ sthāsyati tathā ca agriyaśabdasyārthādanttodāttatvamapi setsayati | ato ghacaścitkaraṇamanarthakaṃ syāt |
analyzed: tadā hi iyādeśa anantaram pratyaya svareṇa sārthakam bhavati ca upadesa avasthāyām ādeśaḥ na bhavati tadā ghaḥ iti atra ākārasya pratyaya svareṇa udātta tve tatas eva bhaviṣyati pūrva pravṛttaḥ akāra svaraḥ sthāsyati tathā ca agriya śabdasya arthāt antta udātta tvam api atas atas gha caḥ cit karaṇam anarthakam syāt

original: tatsārmathyācca upadeśāvasthāyāmeva āyannādaya ādeśā bhavantīti jñāpyata iti bhāvaḥ | jhrjñā.ṭa ṅeprathamayoḥ (sū.7-1-28)|| atra vibhaktyorgrahaṇe yuṣmadasmadoranādeśe "dvitīyāyāṃ' ca iti jñāpakam |
analyzed: tad sārmathyāt ca upadeśa avasthāyām eva āyanna ādayaḥ ādeśāḥ bhavanti iti jñāpyate iti bhāvaḥ ṅe prathamayoḥ sū 7128 atra vibhaktyoḥ grahaṇe yuṣmad asmadoḥ an ādeśe dvitīyāyām ca iti jñāpakam

original: (sū.7-2-86,87) jhrvi.ṭa nan "ṅeprathamayoram' iti sūtreṇa prathamayorityanena kiṃ prathamayorvibhaktyorgrahaṇaṃ uta prathamayoḥ pratyayoḥ iti saṃdeho jāyate | pratyayayorgrahaṇamiti pakṣe su au anayorevāmādeśaḥ syāt | sandehabījaṃ tu yadi prathamayoriti strīliṅganirdeśaḥ tadā vibhaktyorgrahaṇam |
analyzed: sū 72 87 nan ṅe prathamayoḥ am iti sūtreṇa prathamayoḥ iti anena kim prathamayoḥ vibhaktyoḥ grahaṇam uta prathamayoḥ pratyayoḥ iti saṃdehaḥ jāyate pratyayayoḥ grahaṇam iti pakṣe su au anayoḥ eva am ādeśaḥ syāt sandeha bījam tu yadi prathamayoḥ iti strī liṅga nirdeśaḥ tadā vibhaktyoḥ grahaṇam

original: yadā tu puṃliṅgena nirdeśaḥ tadā prathamayoḥ pratyayayorgrahaṇamiti | yadā tu puṃliṅgena nirdeśaḥ tadā prathamayoḥ pratyayayorgrahaṇamiti | ataḥ kathamatra nirṇetavyamiti tatrāha--atra vibhaktyoriti | "ṅeprathamayo' rityatra prathamayorvibhaktyoreva grahaṇaṃ na tu pratyayayoḥ| tatra jñāpakaṃ tu "dvitīyāyāṃ ca' iti sūtram |
analyzed: yadā tu pum liṅgena nirdeśaḥ tadā prathamayoḥ pratyayayoḥ grahaṇam iti yadā tu pum liṅgena nirdeśaḥ tadā prathamayoḥ pratyayayoḥ grahaṇam iti atas katham atra nirṇetavyam iti tatra āha atra vibhaktyoḥ iti ṅe prathamayoḥ iti atra prathamayoḥ vibhaktyoḥ eva grahaṇam na tu pratyayayoḥ tatra jñāpakam tu dvitīyāyām ca iti sūtram

original: tasya ca sūtrasya dvitīyāvibhaktau parataḥ yuṣmadasmadorākāraḥ syādityarthaḥ | yadi ca "ṅeprathamayoram' iti sūtreṇa prathamayoḥ pratyayayoḥ su au ityanayoḥ amādeśo vidhīyeta tadā dvitīyāvibhakteramādeśābhāvāt yuṣmadasmadbhyāmanādeśarūpaiva dvitīyāvibhaktirbhaviṣyatīti tasyāṃ parataḥ "yuṣmadasmadoranādeśe' (sū.7-2-86) ityanenaiva ākārādeśe sidde
analyzed: tasya ca sūtrasya dvitīyā vibhaktau paratas yuṣmad asmadoḥ ākāraḥ syāt iti arthaḥ yadi ca ṅe prathamayoḥ am iti sūtreṇa prathamayoḥ pratyayayoḥ su au iti anayoḥ am ādeśaḥ vidhīyeta tadā dvitīyā vibhakteḥ am ādeśa abhāvāt yuṣmad asmadbhyām anādeśa rūpā eva dvitīyā vibhaktiḥ bhaviṣyati iti tasyām paratas yuṣmad asmadoḥ anādeśe iti anena eva ākāra ādeśe sidde

original: "dvitīyāyāṃ ca' iti sūtraṃ vyarthaṃ bhavet | tasmāt "dvitīyāyāṃ ca' iti sūtraṃ "ṅeprathamayoḥ' iti sūtre prathamayorityanena prathamādvitīyāvibhaktyorgrahaṇamiti jñāpayati | tathā ca dvitīyāvibhakterapi tena amādeśavidhānāt yuṣmadasmadbhyāṃ parā am iti ādeśarūpaiva vibhaktirbhaviṣyati |
analyzed: dvitīyāyām ca iti sūtram vyartham bhavet tasmāt dvitīyāyām ca iti sūtram ṅe prathamayoḥ iti sūtre prathamayoḥ iti anena prathamā dvitīyā vibhaktyoḥ grahaṇam iti jñāpayati tathā ca dvitīyā vibhakteḥ api tena am ādeśa vidhānāt yuṣmad asmadbhyām parā am iti ādeśa rūpā eva vibhaktiḥ bhaviṣyati

original: tasyāṃ ca anādeśa iti pratiṣedhe prāpte ākāravivānārthaṃ "dvitīyāyāṃ ca' iti sūtramiti bhāvaḥ | jhrjñā.ṭa neḍḍḍatdh;vaśi kṛti (sū.7-2-8)|| "kṛsṛbhṛ' iti sūtre vṛñvṛṅorgrahaṇaṃ jñāpakaṃ pratyayāśrayo'pīṭpratiṣedho niyamyata iti | jhrvi.ṭa nanu "neḍḍḍatdh;vaśi kṛti' iti sūtre kṛdgrahaṇaṃ māstu |
analyzed: tasyām ca anādeśaḥ iti pratiṣedhe prāpte ākāra vivāna artham dvitīyāyām ca iti sūtram iti bhāvaḥ na iṭ ḍat dhvaśi kṛti sū728 kṛ sṛ bhṛ iti sūtre vṛñ vṛṅoḥ grahaṇam jñāpakam pratyaya āśraya upi iṭ pratiṣedhaḥ niyamyate iti nanu na iṭ ḍat dhvaśi kṛti iti sūtre kṛt grahaṇam mā astu

original: na ca tadabhāve bibhidiva bibhidima ityatra vaśādestiṅo'pi iḍaḍḍatdh;āgamaniṣedhaḥ syāditi vācyam | "kṛsṛbhṛvṛstudrustuśruvo liṭi' (sū.7-2-23) iti sūtreṇa krādibhya eva parasyeṇniṣedha iti niyamāt bibhidiva
analyzed: na ca tad abhāve bibhidiva bibhidima iti atra vaśa ādeḥ tiṅaḥ upi syāt iti vācyam kṛ sṛ bhṛ vṛ stu dru stu śruvaḥ liṭi sū7223 iti sūtreṇa kra ādibhyaḥ eva parasya iṭ niṣedhaḥ iti niyamāt bibhidiva

original: ityādāviṇniṣedhāpravṛtteḥ | na ca sa niyamaḥ prakṛtiviśeṣamāśritya pravṛtto ya iṇniṣedhastadviṣayakaḥ | "neḍḍḍatdh;vaśi' iti tu pratyayāśrayo niṣedhaḥ | etaṃ ca niṣedhaṃ krādiniyamo na spṛśati | tathā ca bibhidivetyatrāpi iṇniṣedhaḥ syāditi tadvāraṇāya kṛdgrahaṇamāvaśyakamiti vācyam |
analyzed: ityādau iṇ niṣedha apravṛtteḥ na ca sa niyamaḥ prakṛti viśeṣam āśritya pravṛttaḥ yaḥ iṇ niṣedhaḥ tad viṣayakaḥ iti tu pratyaya āśrayaḥ niṣedhaḥ etam ca niṣedham kra ādi niyamaḥ na spṛśati tathā ca bibhidivā iti atra api iṇ niṣedhaḥ syāt iti tad vāraṇāya kṛt grahaṇam āvaśyakam iti vācyam

original: krādiniyamo na prakṛtilakṣaṇaniṣedhamātraviṣayaḥ, kiṃ tu prakṛtyāśrayaḥ pratyayāśrayo vā yāvāniṇniṣedhaḥ sa liṭi cet tarhi krādibhya eveti viyamāt bibhidiva ityatra iṇniṣedhāpravṛtteḥ kṛtītyasya vairyathyāt |
analyzed: kra ādi niyamaḥ na prakṛti lakṣaṇa niṣedha mātra viṣayaḥ kim tu prakṛti āśrayaḥ pratyaya āśrayaḥ vā yāvān iṇ niṣedhaḥ sa liṭi ced tarhi kra ādibhyaḥ eva iti viyamāt bibhidivaḥ iti atra iṇ niṣedha apravṛtteḥ kṛti ityasya vairyathyāt

original: prakṛtipratyayobhyalakṣaṇasyāpi iṇniṣedhasya krādiniyamaḥ ityatra jñāpakaṃ tu "kṛsṛbhṛvṛ' (sū.7-2-13) iti sūtre vṛ iti sāmānyena vṛṅvṛñorubhayorgrahaṇam | tayorgrahaṇasya prayojanaṃ hi vavṛmahe ityādāviṇmā bhūditi |
analyzed: prakṛti pratyaya ubhya lakṣaṇasya api iṇ niṣedhasya kra ādi niyamaḥ iti atra jñāpakam tu kṛ sṛ bhṛ vṛ sū7213 iti sūtre vṛ iti sāmānyena vṛṅ vṛñoḥ ubhayoḥ grahaṇam tayoḥ grahaṇasya prayojanam hi vavṛmahe ityādau iṇ mā bhūt iti

original: yadi ca krādiniyamaḥ prakṛtyāśrayameva pratiṣedhaṃ bādheta na pratyayāśrayaṃ tadā "neḍḍḍatdh;vaśi kṛti' (sū.7-2-8) "rśyukaḥ kiti' (sū.7-2-11) iti sūtrābhyāmeva iṭpratiṣedhasya siddhatvāt nārtho vṛgrahaṇena | tatkriyamāṇaṃ pratyayāśrayasyāpi pratiṣedhasya nivṛttiṃ jñāpayati |
analyzed: yadi ca kra ādi niyamaḥ prakṛti āśrayam eva pratiṣedham bādheta na pratyaya āśrayam tadā na iṭ ḍat dhva śi kṛti sū728 rśi ukaḥ k iti sū7211 iti sūtrābhyām eva iṭ pratiṣedhasya siddha tvāt na arthaḥ vṛ grahaṇena tat kriyamāṇam pratyaya āśrayasya api pratiṣedhasya nivṛttim jñāpayati

original: tathā ca vṛgrahaṇābhāve krādibhinnatvena vṛṅvṛñoḥ, tataḥ pratyayāśrayaḥ "neṅvaśi' itīṇniṣedho'pi krādibhya eveṇniṣedha iti niyamena vyāvartitaḥ syāt | tataśca vavṛmahe ityādau iṇniṣedho na sidhyet | tatrāpīṇniṣedhasya siddhaye krādisūtre vṛgrahaṇamarthavadbhavati |
analyzed: tathā ca vṛ grahaṇa abhāve kra ādi bhinna tvena vṛṅ vṛñoḥ tatas pratyaya āśrayaḥ na iṅ vaśi iti iṇ niṣedhaḥ api kra ādibhyaḥ eva iṇ niṣedhaḥ iti niyamena vyāvartitaḥ syāt tatas ca vavṛmahe ityādau iṇ niṣedhaḥ na sidhyet tatra api iṇ niṣedhasya siddhaye kra ādi sūtre vṛ grahaṇam arthavat bhavati

original: tataśca krādiniyamādeva bibhidivetyādāviṇniṣedho na bhaviṣyatīti tatreṇniṣedhāpravṛttiphalakatvaṃ "neḍḍḍatdh;vaśi kṛti' iti sūtre kṛdgrahaṇasya na yujyata iti sthitam | sarvametanmanasi kurvannāha---kṛsṛbhṛ iti sūtra iti | jhrjñā.ṭa ghuṣiraviśabdane (sū.7-2-23)|| viśabdane curādiṇicā siddhe aviśabdana ityuktirghuṣervibhāṣā ṇico jñāpikā |
analyzed: tatas ca kra ādi niyamāt eva bibhidivā ityādau iṭ niṣedhaḥ na bhaviṣyati iti tatra iṭ niṣedha apravṛtti phalaka tvam na iṭ ḍat dhvaśi kṛti iti sūtre kṛt grahaṇasya na yujyate iti sthitam sarvam etat manasi kurvan āha kṛ sṛ bhṛ iti sūtre iti jhrjñāṭa ghuṣiḥ aviśabdane sū7223 viśabdane curādi ṇicā siddhe aviśabdane iti uktiḥ ghuṣeḥ vibhāṣā ṇicaḥ jñāpikā

original: tena jughuṣuḥ (puṣyamāṇā vā) jhrpuṣyamāṇavāḥṭa iti siddham | jhrvi.ṭa nanu "ghuṣiraviśabdane' iti sūtre aviśabdana iti māstu | ghuṣirhi aviśabdanārthakaḥ bvādau paṭhyate | curādau ca ghuṣirviśabdane iti paṭhyate | sa ca ṇijantaḥ | sūtre ca ghuṣiriti nirdeśāt bhauvādikasyāviśabdanārthakasyaiva grahaṇaṃ na curādeḥ |
analyzed: tena jughuṣuḥ puṣyamāṇāḥ vā iti siddham nanu ghuṣiḥ aviśabdane iti sūtre aviśabdanaḥ iti mā astu ghuṣiḥ hi a viśabdana arthakaḥ bvādau paṭhyate curādau ca ghuṣiḥ viśabdane iti paṭhyate sa ca ṇic antaḥ sūtre ca ghuṣiḥ iti nirdeśāt bhauvādikasya a viśabdana arthakasya eva grahaṇam na curādeḥ

original: tadā hi "ghoṣiḥ' iti nirdeṣṭavyaṃ syāt | evaṃ ca ghuṣiriti nirdeśabalādeva viśabdanārthakacurādighuṣadhātuvyāvṛttipūrvakaṃ aviśabdanārthakasya bhauvādikaghuṣadhātoreva grahaṇaṃ bhaviṣyatīti aviśabdana iti vyartha ityāśaṅkyāha--viśabdana ityādinā | siddha iti |
analyzed: tadā hi ghoṣiḥ iti nirdeṣṭavyam syāt evam ca ghuṣiḥ iti nirdeśa balāt eva viśabdana arthaka curādi ghuṣa dhātu vyāvṛtti pūrvakam a viśabdana arthakasya bhauvādika ghuṣa dhātoḥ eva grahaṇam bhaviṣyati iti a viśabdanaḥ iti vyarthaḥ iti āśaṅkya āha viśabdanaḥ ityādinā siddhaḥ iti

original: aviśabdane ityasminnaṃśe siddha ityarthaḥ |tathā ca aviśabdana ityetat vyarthaṃ sat ghuṣeścaurādikasya vikalpena ṇic bhavatīti jñāpayati | ṇijabhāvapakṣe ca ghuśiriti igantena viśabdanārthakasya caurādikasyāpi grahaṇaṃ prayojanaṃ tu viśabdanārthakacaurādikadhātoḥ ṇijrahitatayā "jughuṣuḥ' iti prāmāṇikaprayogaḥ upapanno bhavatīti |
analyzed: a viśabdane iti asmin aṃśe siddhaḥ iti arthaḥ tathā ca a viśabdane iti etat vyartham sat ghuṣeḥ caura ādikasya vikalpena ṇic bhavati iti jñāpayati ṇic abhāva pakṣe ca ghuśiḥ iti i k antena viśabdana arthakasya caura ādikasya api grahaṇam prayojanam tu viśabdana arthaka caura ādika dhātoḥ ṇic rahita tayā jughuṣuḥ iti prāmāṇika prayogaḥ upapannaḥ bhavati iti

original: bhāṣye--- "mahīpālavacaḥ śrutvā jughuṣuḥ puṣyamāṇavāḥ' iti vākyaṃ pramāṇatayā uddhṛtam | svābhiprāyasya śabdena prakaṭīkaraṇaṃ viśabdanam | tathā ca aviśabdanārthe iṇniṣedhaḥ ghuṣṭā rajjuriti | viśabdena tu iṭ ghuṣitaṃ vākyamiti | jhrjñā.ṭa pratyayottara (sū.7-2-97)||
analyzed: bhāṣye mahīpāla vacaḥ śrutvā jughuṣuḥ puṣyamāṇavāḥ iti vākyam pramāṇatayā uddhṛtam sva abhiprāyasya śabdena prakaṭīkaraṇam viśabdanam tathā ca a viśabdana arthe ghuṣṭā rajjuḥ iti viśabdena tu ghuṣitam vākyam iti jhrjñāṭa pratyaya uttara sū 7297

original: idameva jñāpayati atra maparyantānuvṛttirvā jñāpayati antaraṅgānapi vidhīn bahiraṅgo lugbādhata iti | jhrvi.ṭa paribhāṣeyam | jhrjñā.ṭa mṛjervṛddhiḥ (sū.7-2-114)|| bhrauṇahatye tatvanipātanaṃ dhātoḥ kāryamucyamānaṃ tatpratyaye bhavatītyasyārthasya jñāpakam | jhrvi.ṭa iyamapi paribhāṣā | jhrjñā.ṭa svāderiñi (sū.7-3-8)||
analyzed: idam eva jñāpayati atra ma paryanta anuvṛttiḥ vā jñāpayati antaraṅgān api vidhīn bahis aṅgaḥ luc bādhate iti jhrviṭa paribhāṣā iyam jhrjñāṭa mṛjeḥ vṛddhiḥ sū72114 bhrauṇa hatye ta tva nipātanam dhātoḥ kāryam ucyamānam tad pratyaye bhavati iti asya arthasya jñāpakam jhrviṭa iyam api paribhāṣā jhrjñāṭa sva ādeḥ iñi sū72114

original: pratiṣedhe śvādigrahaṇaṃ jñāpakaṃ anyatra śvangrahaṇe tadādigrahaṇasya | śauvahānaṃ nāma nagaram, śauvādaṃṣṭro maṇirityartham | jhrvi.ṭa ṭhaśvāderiñi' iti sūtrasya yasya śvaśabdaḥ ādiḥ tasmāt iñi pare "dvārādīnāṃ ca' (sū.7-3-4) iti sūtravihitaḥ aica na bhavatītyarthaḥ | śvabhastrasyāpatyaṃ śvābastriḥ ityudāharaṇam |
analyzed: pratiṣedhe śva ādi grahaṇam jñāpakam anyatra tad ādi grahaṇasya śauvahānam nāma nagaram iti artham iti sūtrasya yasya śva śabdaḥ ādiḥ tasmāt iñi pare dvāra ādīnām ca iti sūtra vihitaḥ na bhavati iti arthaḥ śva bhastrasya apatyam śvābastriḥ iti udāharaṇam

original: nanu "dvārādīnāṃ ca' iti sūtreṇa dvārādigaṇapaṭhitānāṃ śabdānāmāderaco vṛddhirna bhavati, paraṃ tu yvābhyāṃ pūrvamaijāgamo bhavatīti vidhīyate | dvārādigaṇe ca ścanśabdaḥ paṭhyate |
analyzed: nanu dvāra ādīnām ca iti sūtreṇa dvāra ādi gaṇa paṭhitānām śabdānām ādeḥ a caḥ vṛddhiḥ na bhavati param tu y vābhyām pūrvam ai c āgamaḥ bhavati iti vidhīyate dvāra ādi gaṇe ca ścan śabdaḥ paṭhyate

original: tathā ca ścanśabdasyāvayavāt vakārāt pūrvamaijāgamasya tena prāptāvapi śvabhastraśabdāvayavaviṣaye ejāgamo na tena prāpnoti tathā ca prāptyabhāvāt pratiṣedho'narthaka ityāśaṅkyāha--pratiṣedhe śvādigrahaṇamiti | uktarītyā vyarthaṃ sat śvādisūtraṃ śvangrahaṇena śvanśabdādyavayavakasya śabdasyāpi grahaṇamiti jñāpayati |
analyzed: tathā ca ścan śabdasya avayavāt vakārāt pūrvam ai c āgamasya tena prāptau api śva bhastra śabda avayava viṣaye e c āgamaḥ na tena prāpnoti tathā ca prāpti abhāvāt pratiṣedhaḥ ūnarthakaḥ iti āśaṅkya āha pratiṣedhe śva ādi grahaṇam iti ukta rītyā vyartham sat śva ādi sūtram śvan grahaṇena śvan śabda ādi avayavakasya śabdasya api grahaṇam iti jñāpayati

original: tataśca śvabhastraśabapdasyāpi śvangrahaṇena grahaṇāt "dvārādīnāṃ ca' iti sūtreṇa aijāgame prāpte tanniṣedhārthaṃ "śvāderiñi' iti sūtram | jñāpanaphalaṃ tu--śauvahānam śauvādaṃṣṭra ityādāvaijāgamasiddhiḥ | tathā hi-jihate'sminnityarthe "o hāṅ gatau' iti dhātoḥ adhikaraṇe lyuṭ hānam | śunāṃ hānaṃ śvahānam |
analyzed: tatas ca śva bhastra śapa pdasya api śvan grahaṇena grahaṇāt dvāra ādīnām ca iti sūtreṇa ai c āgame prāpte tad niṣedha artham śva ādeḥ iñi iti sūtram jñāpana phalam tathā hi jihate smin iti arthe hāṅ gatau iti dhātoḥ adhikaraṇe lyuṭ hānam śunām hānam śva hānam

original: śvahānamasminnastītyarthe "tadasminnastīti deśe tannāmni (sū.4-2-67) iti sūtreṇāṇ | "dvārādīnāṃ ca' sūtreṇa vṛddhiniṣedhaḥ aijāgamaśca | śauvahānamiti rūpam | evaṃ śuno daṃṣṭrā śvādaṃṣṭrā | "śuno dantadaṃṣṭrā ' (vā.6-3-130) iti vārtikena dīrghaḥ | tatra bhava ityaṇ | dvārādīnāṃ ceti vṛddhiniṣedhaḥ aijāgamaśca | śauvādaṃṣṭra iti rūpam |
analyzed: śva hānam asmin asti iti arthe tat asmin asti iti deśe tad nāmni iti sūtreṇa aṇ dvāra ādīnām ca sūtreṇa vṛddhi niṣedhaḥ ai c āgamaḥ ca śauva hānam iti rūpam evam śunaḥ daṃṣṭrā śvādaṃṣṭrā śunaḥ danta daṃṣṭrā vā iti vārtikena dīrghaḥ tatra bhavaḥ iti aṇ dvāra ādīnām ca iti vṛddhi niṣedhaḥ ai c āgamaḥ ca śauvādaṃṣṭraḥ iti rūpam

original: atraubhayatrāpi śvanśabdena tadādergrahaṇe satyeva tatsūtraṃ pravarteteti tadādigrahaṇaphalamavaseyamiti bhāvaḥ | jhrjñā.ṭa ṭhaprācāṃ grāmanagarāṇām' (sū.7-3-14) prācāṃ grāmāṇāmityeva siddhe nagaragrahaṇaṃ jñāpayati grāmagrahaṇe nagaragrahaṇaṃ neti |
analyzed: atra aubhayatrāpi śvan śabdena tad ādeḥ grahaṇe sati eva tat sūtram pravarteta iti tad ādi grahaṇa phalam avaseyam iti bhāvaḥ ṭha prācām grāma nagarāṇām sū 7314 prācām grāmāṇām iti eva siddhe nagara grahaṇam jñāpayati grāma grahaṇe nagara grahaṇam na iti

original: tattu--"udīcyagrāmāt' (sū.4-2-109) "vāhīkagrāmebhyaśca' (4-2-117) "dikśabdā grāma' (sū.6-2-103)--iti sthalatraye nagaragrahaṇakartavyatāpacyā bhāṣye dūṣitam | "viśiṣṭaliṅga' (sū.2-4-7) ityatra tu nagarapratiṣedho'vaktavya eveti bhāṣye spaṣṭam | jhrvi.ṭa nanu janasamūhanivāsavācinau grāmanagaraśabdau |
analyzed: tat tu udīcya grāmāt sū 42109 vāhīka grāmebhyaḥ ca 42117 diś śabdāḥ grāma sū 62103 iti sthala traye nagara grahaṇa kartavya tā āpacyā bhāṣye dūṣitam viśiṣṭa liṅga sū 247 iti atra tu nagara pratiṣedhaḥ vaktavyaḥ eva iti bhāṣye spaṣṭam nanu jana samūha nivāsa vācinau grāma nagara śabdau

original: tatra grāmaśabdenaiva janasamūhanivāsatvāviśeṣāt nagarasyāpi grahaṇe siddhe "prācāṃ grāmanagarāṇām' iti sūtre nagarapadopādānaṃ vyarthamityāśaḍhaddhaṭhṭhaḍakya, ata evātra vyākaraṇe grāmapadena nagaragrahaṇaṃ neti jñāpayatītyāha--prācāṃ grāmāṇāmityeveti |
analyzed: tatra grāma śabdena eva jana samūha nivāsa tva aviśeṣāt nagarasya api grahaṇe siddhe prācām grāma nagarāṇām iti sūtre nagara pada upādānam vyartham iti āśaḍhat dhaṭh ṭhaḍakya atas eva atra vyākaraṇe grāma padena nagara grahaṇam na iti jñāpayati iti āha prācām grāmāṇām iti eva iti

original: paraṃ tvevaṃ jñāpaṃna "udīcyagrāmāt' ityādisūtratraye grāmaśabdena nagaragrahaṇasyāpīṣṭatvāt tanna ghaṭeteti bhāṣye dūṣitamityāha--tattu iti |
analyzed: param tu evam udīcya grāmāt ityādi sūtra traye grāma śabdena nagara grahaṇasya api iṣṭatvāt tat na ghaṭeta iti bhāṣye dūṣitam iti āha tat tu iti

original: nanu grāmagrahaṇena nagarasyāpi grahaṇamiṣṭaṃ cet "viśiṣṭaliṅgo nadīdeśo'grāmāḥ' (sū.2-4-7) iti sūtre grāmapratiṣedhenaiva nagarapratiṣedhasyāpi lābhāt vārtikakāreṇa yaduktaṃ nagarasyāpi pratiṣedho vaktavya iti tadānavaśyakamityāśaṅkyoṣṭāpattyā pariharati--viśiṣṭaliṅga ityatra tu iti |
analyzed: nanu grāma grahaṇena nagarasya api grahaṇam iṣṭam ced viśiṣṭa liṅgaḥ nadī deśaḥ grāmāḥ sū iti sūtre grāma pratiṣedhena eva nagara pratiṣedhasya api lābhāt vārtikakāreṇa yat uktam nagarasya api pratiṣedhaḥ vaktavyaḥ iti tadā ānavaśyakam iti āśaṅkya uṣṭa āpattyā pariharati viśiṣṭa liṅgaḥ iti atra tu iti

original: tathā ca tatra sūtre nagarapratiṣedho na vaktavya evetyarthaḥ | jhrjñā.ṭa ṭhasaṃkhyāyāssaṃ' (sū.7-3-15)|| parimāṇāntasyāsaṃjñeti siddhe saṃvatsaragrahaṇaṃ jñāpayati parimāṇagrahaṇena kālagrahaṇaṃ neti | tena dvivarṣetyādau"aparimāṇa' iti paryudāso na |
analyzed: tathā ca tatra sūtre nagara pratiṣedhaḥ na vaktavyaḥ eva iti arthaḥ sū 7315 sū 7315 sū 7315 sū 7315

original: jhrvi.ṭa nan "saṃkhyāyāḥ saṃvatsarasaṃkhyasya ca' (sū.7-3-15) iti sūtreṇa saṃkhyāvācakaśabdāt parasya saṃvatsaraśabdasya saṃkhyāvācakaśabdasya cottarapadavṛddhirvidhīyate ñidādau taddhite pare | dvisāṃvatsarikaḥ dviṣāṣṭika ityādikaṃ udāharaṇam |
analyzed: saṃkhyāyāḥ saṃvatsara saṃkhyasya ca sū 7315 iti sūtreṇa saṃkhyā vācaka śabdāt parasya saṃvatsara śabdasya saṃkhyā vācaka śabdasya ca uttara pada vṛddhiḥ vidhīyate ñ it ādau taddhite pare dvisāṃvatsarikaḥ dviṣāṣṭikaḥ iti ādikam udāharaṇam

original: tatra saṃvatsaragrahaṇaṃ māstu, tadabhāve'pi saṃvatsaraśabdasya kālarūpaparimāṇavācakasya "parimāṇāntasyāsaṃjñāśāṇayoḥ' (sū 7-3-17) iti sūtreṇaivottarapadavṛddheḥ siddheḥ | kālo'pi hi kriyāparicchedahetutvātparimāṇamityāśaḍhaddhaṭhṭhaḍakya, ata eva parimāṇagrahaṇena kālarūpaparimāṇagrahaṇaṃ neti jñāpayatītyāha-- parimāṇāntasyāsaṃjñeti siddha iti |
analyzed: tatra saṃvatsara grahaṇam mā astu tad abhāve api saṃvatsara śabdasya kāla rūpa parimāṇa vācakasya parimāṇa antasya asaṃjñā śāṇayoḥ sū 7317 iti sūtreṇa eva uttara pada vṛddheḥ siddheḥ kālaḥ api hi kriyā pariccheda hetu tvāt parimāṇam iti āśaḍhat dhaṭh ṭhaḍakya atas eva parimāṇa grahaṇena kāla rūpa parimāṇa grahaṇam na iti jñāpayati iti āha parimāṇa antasya asaṃjñā iti siddhaḥ iti

original: tathā hi yasmin pratyaye nimitte aḍhaddhaṭhṭhaḍagasaṃjñā tannimittako yo'bhyāsaḥ tannimittakadvayoḥ pūrva iti yāvat | tataḥ parasya hasya kutvamiti sūtraṃ vyākhyāyate | ṇau hinotiraṅgaṃ, caṅi abhyāsa iti aṅgatvābyāsatvayoḥ samānanimittakatvābhāvāt prājīhayadityatra kutvaṃ na bhaviṣyati |

original: tathā ca acaṅītyetat ṇyantasyāpi kutvaṃ bhavatīti jñāpayati | aṅgatvasya ṇic nimittam abhyāsasya caṅ nimittamiti nimittabhede satyāpi kutvaṃ bhavatīti yāvat | tathā ca prājīhayadityatrāpi kutve prāpte tadvāraṇāya acaṅītyuktam | tena caṅo'nyasmin dvitvanimitte pare ṇyantasya kutvamabhyanujñāyate |
analyzed: tathā ca a caṅi iti etat ṇi antasya api ku tvam bhavati iti jñāpayati aṅga tvasya ṇic nimittam abhyāsasya caṅ nimittam iti nimitta bhede satyā api ku tvam bhavati iti yāvat tathā ca prājīhayat iti atra api ku tve prāpte tad vāraṇāya a caṅi iti uktam tena caṅaḥ nyasmin dvi tva nimitte pare ṇi antasya ku tvam abhyanujñāyate

original: tasya phalaṃ tuprajighāyayiṣati ityatra ṇijantāddhinoteḥ sani kutvasiddhiriti | "prakṛtigrahaṇe ṇyaghikasyāpi grahaṇam' iti paribhāṣārūpeṇeyaṃ paribhāṣenduśekhare paṭhitā | jhrjñādṛṭa ṭhajñājanorjñā' (sū 7-3-79) dīrghoccāraṇaṃ jñāpayatyaṅgavṛttaparibhāṣām | "ṇau caṅyu' (sū.7-4-1) oṇerṛditkaraṇāt jñāpakāt dvirvacanāddhrasvatvaṃ balīya iti |

analyzed: na a c lopi sū iti sūtre a c iti pratyāhāra grahaṇāt jñāpakāt vṛddheḥ lopaḥ balīyān tasmāt ṇeḥ ṇici upasaṃkhyānam kāryam nanu mā bhavān aṭiṭat iti atra aṭa dhātoḥ ṇi antāt luṅi caṅi aṭ i at iti sthite upadhā vṛddhau āṭ i at iti jāte ṇau caṅi upadhāyāḥ hrasvaḥ iti sūtreṇa ākārasya hrasve aṭi at iti jāte a t ādeḥ dvitīyasya

original: (sū.6-1-2) iti ṭiśabdasya dvitve aṭi ṭi at sthiteṇilope aṭiṭat iti rūpamiṣyate | tanna sidhyati | āṭi at ityasyāmavasthāyāṃ paramapyupadhāhrasvaṃ bādhitvā nityatvāt ṭiśabdasya dvitve āṭiṭi at ityatra prathamasya ṇicaḥ pareṇa ṇicā vyavadhānena caṅparakatvābhāvāt upadhāhrasvatvāpravṛtteḥ āṭiṭat ityeva rūpaprāpterityāśaṅkyāha--oṇerṛditkaraṇāditi |

original: oṇerṛditkaraṇāt dvirvacanāt hrasvatvaṃ balīya iti jñāpyate | tathā ca hrasvatvasya balavattaratvāt ādāvupadhāhrasvatve kṛte tadanantaraṃ dvitve ca aṭiṭat ityeva rūpamiti bhāvaḥ |

original: tathā ca hrasve kṛte tato dvitve ca mā bhavānuṇiṇat ityeva bhavet mā bhavānoṇiṇat iti ceṣyate | tadarthaṃ oṇerṛdatkiraṇam | tena "nāglopi' iti hrasvaniṣeghāt iṣṭarūpasiddhiriti svāṃśe cāritārthyam | anyatra prayojanaṃ tu mā bhavānaṭiṭat iti pūrvoktam iti bhāvaḥ | "ṇau caṅi' iti sūtre "upadhāhrasve ṇorṇicyupasaṃkhyānaṃ' iti vārtikam |

original: ṇijantāṇṇici tato luṅi caḍiḍḍatdh; ca upadhāhrasvatvaṃ bhavatīti vaktavyamiti tadarthaḥ | vāditavantaṃ prayojitavānavīvadadvīṇāṃ devadattena iti codāharaṇaṃ bhāṣye pradarśitam |

original: vaderṇijantāt vādi ityasmāt ṇici luṅi caṅi aḍaḍḍatdh;āgame avād i i at ityatra prathamasya ṇicaḥ dvitīyena ṇicā vyavadhānāt caṅparakatvaṃ nāstīti upadhāhrasvatvamaprāptaṃ vārtikakāreṇa vidhīyate | nanvatra dvitīyasya ṇicaḥ "ṇeraniṭi' (sū.6-4-51) iti lope kṛte vyavadhānābhāvāt sūtreṇaiva hrasvatvaṃ setsyati |
